text.title: 女神护佑着你
text.objectives: 去达拉然找大法师卡德加。
text.description: 我可能找到了解开圣光之心的“钥匙”，$n。$B$B我之前在查阅一些宇宙学古代典籍时，发现了让我非常困惑一段文字。这段文字暗示，始祖纳鲁是由艾露恩在光暗大定序时创造出来的。$B$B如果确实是艾露恩创造了泽拉，那么我们也许就能用艾露恩之泪去解开圣光之心的秘密。$B$B这是一次豪赌，但我们已经没什么可失去的了。$B$B来达拉然找我吧。我会准备好艾露恩之泪。
text.completion: If this works, then perhaps there is still hope for Turalyon and the Army of the Light.

english.title: Goddess Watch Over You
english.objectives: Meet Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
english.description: I may have found a "key" to unlock Light's Heart, $n.$B$BI was going through some ancient cosmology tomes when I stumbled upon a passage indicating that the prime naaru may have been created by Elune during the great ordering of Light and Shadow.$B$BIf Elune did create Xe'ra, then it stands to reason that we could use the Tears of Elune to unlock the secrets of Light's Heart.$B$BIt's a long shot, but we've got nothing left to lose.$B$BMeet me in Dalaran. I will ready the Tears of Elune for you.
english.completion: If this works, we may have a chance to save Turalion and the Army of Light.

text.title: 女神护佑着你
text.objectives: 从瓦尔莎拉找回艾露恩之泪。
text.description: 我可能找到了解开圣光之心的“钥匙”，$n。$B$B我之前在查阅一些宇宙学古代典籍时，发现了让我非常困惑一段文字。这段文字暗示，始祖纳鲁是由艾露恩在光暗大定序时创造出来的。$B$B如果确实是艾露恩创造了泽拉，那么我们也许就能用艾露恩之泪去解开圣光之心的秘密。$B$B现在我们得靠你去从瓦尔莎拉取回艾露恩之泪了。
text.completion: If this works, then perhaps there is still hope for Turalyon and the Army of the Light.

english.title: Goddess Watch Over You
english.objectives: Recover the Tears of Elune from Val'sharah.
english.description: I may have found a "key" to unlock Light's Heart, $n.$B$BI was going through some ancient cosmology tomes when I stumbled upon a passage indicating that the prime naaru may have been created by Elune during the great ordering of Light and Shadow.$B$BIf Elune did create Xe'ra, then it stands to reason that we could use the Tears of Elune to unlock the secrets of Light's Heart.$B$BNow it falls upon you to recover the Tears of Elune from Val'sharah.
english.completion: If this works, then perhaps there is still hope for Turalyon and the Army of the Light.

text.title: 最后一次冒险
text.objectives: 告诉伊墨瑞尔你是否要去追寻下一件神器。
text.description: 还有最后一条你可以践行的道路——又一件你可以挥舞的武器。$B$B如果你希望追寻它，就说一声。
text.completion: So it shall be.

english.title: One Last Adventure
english.objectives: Let Emmarel know if you'd like to pursue another artifact.
english.description: There is still one last path you may yet walk - one more weapon you might wield.$B$BIf you wish to seek it out, just say the word.
english.completion: So it shall be.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第三件神器

text.title: 集齐你的武器
text.objectives: 告诉泰罗索斯你是否要去寻找下一件神器。
text.description: 大领主，还有一件武器可以帮助你对抗燃烧军团。$B$B如果你有兴趣的话，我很乐意为你重新研读最新的情报，找出它的所在。
text.completion: Agreed. We must seek it out at once.

english.title: Completing Your Arsenal
english.objectives: Let Tyrosus know if you'd like to pursue another artifact.
english.description: Highlord, there is still one last weapon out there that would aid you against the Legion.$B$BIf you would like, I would be happy to go over our latest information on its whereabouts.
english.completion: Agreed. We must seek it out at once.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第三件神器

text.title: 最终之刃
text.objectives: 如果要去寻找下一件神器，就去告诉乔拉齐。
text.description: 你一定还记得，我们还保存着取得强力武器的最后一套计划。$B$B当然，我不是催你，但如果你想要寻找它的话，就告诉我吧。
text.completion: I couldn't agree more.

english.title: The Final Blade
english.objectives: Let Jorach know if you'd like to pursue another artifact.
english.description: As I'm sure you recall, we have retained our final set of plans to obtain a weapon of immense power.$B$BNo pressure, of course, but if you wish to pursue it just let me know.
english.completion: Не могу не согласиться.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第三件神器

text.title: 追寻力量
text.objectives: 告诉奥图里斯你是否要去寻找下一件神器。
text.description: 就在我们触手可及的地方，还有一对足以帮你对抗燃烧军团的战刃。$B$B如果你想要找到它们的话，就告诉我。
text.completion: Good idea. There is no more dependable ally than a worthy blade.

english.title: In Pursuit of Power
english.objectives: Let Altruis know if you'd like to pursue another artifact.
english.description: There is one more pair of blades still within reach that would aid you against the Legion.$B$BIf you wish to pursue them, just let me know.
english.completion: Good idea. There is no more dependable ally than a worthy blade.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第二件神器

text.title: 追寻力量
text.objectives: 告诉凯恩你是否要去寻找下一件神器。
text.description: 还有一对战刃，若是在你手上，它们同样能在之后的战斗中派上大用场。$B$B如果你想要找到它们的话，我能为你汇总下手头的信息。
text.completion: I think that is wise. We need every weapon we can gather to defeat the Legion once and for all.

english.title: In Pursuit of Power
english.objectives: Let Kayn know if you'd like to pursue another artifact.
english.description: There is still one other pair of blades that could be of great use to you in the battles to come.$B$BI can brief you on what we know if you would like to pursue them.
english.completion: Мудрое решение. Чтобы расправиться с Легионом раз и навсегда, нам понадобится любое оружие, которое мы сможем добыть.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第二件神器

text.title: 突袭紫罗兰监狱：紫色的痛
text.objectives: 击退对紫罗兰监狱的突袭。
text.description:
又来！又发生了这种事情！

没错，这回是军团策划了越狱，但我*告诉*过他们，在城市监狱里囚禁几个艾泽拉斯最危险的生物，实在是糟糕透顶的主意！

迁址的问题待会儿我们再谈。现在嘛，我们有一些……安抚工作要做。

你能帮个忙吗？
text.completion: Whew. That's a SECOND invasion dealt with. Well done.$B$BNow, who do I talk to about getting this place shut down?

english.title: Assault on Violet Hold: Purple Pain
english.objectives: Repel the Assault on Violet Hold.
english.description:
Again! It happened again!

Sure, it's the Legion that staged the prison breakout this time, but I *told* them it was a bad idea to keep some of the most dangerous beings on Azeroth in a prison inside our city!

We can talk about relocating later, I suppose. Right now, we've got some... pacification to tend to.

Can you help?
english.completion: Whew. That's a SECOND invasion dealt with. Well done.$B$BNow, who do I talk to about getting this place shut down?

objectiveDetails.description: 击退紫罗兰监狱的入侵

text.title: 全能神兵
text.objectives: 告诉兰克拉尔公爵你是否要去寻找下一件神器。
text.description:
我们的盟友巫妖王向我们提供了一些线索，可以找到最后一件兵器，让我们的进攻选择更加多元化。

告诉我你的想法吧。
text.completion: Very well.

english.title: A Weapon For Every Occasion
english.objectives: Let Duke Lankral know if you'd like to pursue another artifact.
english.description:
Our ally, the Lich King, has offered to provide you with a lead on a final weapon should you desire to maximize our offensive options.

Let me know how you would like to proceed.
english.completion: Very well.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第三件神器

text.title: 阿格娜的引导
text.objectives: 在艾泽拉斯之心的风暴之眼瞭望台找到阿格娜。
text.description: $ct，你见过萨满阿格娜了吗？她出生在外域这个破碎的世界，并从那里的玛格汉兽人处学会了元素之道。在大灾变的前夕，她亲自帮助萨尔完成了萨满训练。年轻的新兵们能有她作为导师真是太幸运了。$b$b如果你想找到第二件神器，阿格娜一定能帮到你。她正在我们上方的风暴之眼瞭望台训练新兵。
text.completion: I have been waiting for you, Farseer.
text.giverWindow: 阿格娜兰，大家叫她阿格娜。

english.title: Aggra's Guidance
english.objectives: Seek out Aggra at the Storm's Eye Overlook within the Heart of Azeroth.
english.description: $ct, have you met the shaman Aggra? Born of a shattered world, she learned the ways of the elements among the Mag'har orcs of Outland. On the eve of the Cataclysm she took it upon herself to complete Thrall's shamanistic training. Our younger initiates are fortunate to have her among us to guide them.$b$bIf you wish to seek out a second artifact, Aggra can assist you. She is training new recruits above us on the Storm's Eye Overlook.
english.completion: Я ждала тебя, |3-6($ct).

text.title: 第三个传奇
text.objectives: 和阿隆索斯·法奥对话来追寻第三件神器。
text.description:
你用来对抗燃烧军团的神器已经不是一件，而是两件了！但是你有没有想过拿到第三件？想象一下吧，那样的话你能用它做些什么！

我们来探讨一下吧？
text.completion: That was probably the easiest decision you've had to make! Let's get started.

english.title: The Third Legend
english.objectives: Speak with Alonsus Faol to pursue a third artifact.
english.description:
You have not one but TWO powerful artifacts to use against the Legion. But can you imagine a world where you have three? Think of what you could do in such a world!

Shall we look at the possibilities?
english.completion: Недолго пришлось раздумывать, да? Начнем же.

text.title: 诡异的嗡鸣水晶
text.objectives: 把诡异的嗡鸣水晶带给达拉然的卡德加。
text.description: <你把水晶放在耳边，只听到一阵杂乱的喧闹，仿佛有上百个声音同时在说话>。也许卡德加会知道些有关这个奇怪宝石的事情。
text.completion: Such a cacophony! I could hear it before you pulled it from your pack.$B$BWhat you've got there is a highborne memory crystal, somehow still intact. Created by ancient sorcery, they were used to store memories, stories, music, history, and whatnot.$B$BQuite rare! With a little... tinkering... I should be able to create something useful with it.

english.title: Strange Humming Crystal
english.objectives: Take the Strange Humming Crystal to Khadgar in Dalaran.
english.description: <You place the crystal to your ear and hear the disharmonious din of hundreds of voices speaking at once. Perhaps Khadgar might know more about this strange gem.>
english.completion: Such a cacophony! I could hear it before you pulled it from your pack.$B$BWhat you've got there is a highborne memory crystal, somehow still intact. Created by ancient sorcery, they were used to store memories, stories, music, history, and whatnot.$B$BQuite rare! With a little... tinkering... I should be able to create something useful with it.

text.title: 敌人无处不在
text.objectives: 消灭潜伏在达拉然的渗透者。
text.description: 稍等一下，$n。在我帮你研究这个球体的时候，能否请你也帮我解决一些麻烦？$b$b我很久以前就怀疑达拉然被渗透了。但经过了和一位本地花匠的尴尬对质之后，我决定在能够完全肯定之前先保留我的指控。$b$b你有没有注意到，出现在我们身边的市民有点太过于平凡了？平凡得没有人味？他们是间谍，侍奉邪恶主子的间谍。他们在监视我们，等着我们露出背后的要害。铲除他们，但尽量别闹出大动静。
text.completion: I appreciate your discretion, $n.$B$BNow, look here! I have imparted all of my substantial worldly wisdom into this globe, in addition to my ruggedly handsome features. No doubt you will find my counsel invaluable in your travels.$B$BI could only get it to say a handful of phrases, however, so be VERY SPECIFIC in your questions.

english.title: Enemies Everywhere
english.objectives: Defeat the hidden infiltrators in Dalaran.
english.description: Hold a moment, $n. While I look into this orb of yours, why don't you look into something for me?$b$bI have long suspected an infiltration of Dalaran but after an embarrassing encounter with a local florist I've withheld my accusations until I'm absolutely certain.$b$bHave you noticed citizens among us that seem just too mundane? Almost inhumanly so? Spies, serving dark masters, watch and wait until our backs are turned. Root them out, but try and keep it quiet.
english.completion: I appreciate your discretion, $n.$B$BNow, look here! I have imparted all of my substantial worldly wisdom into this globe, in addition to my ruggedly handsome features. No doubt you will find my counsel invaluable in your travels.$B$BI could only get it to say a handful of phrases, however, so be VERY SPECIFIC in your questions.

text.title: 洛瑟鲁斯的邪裔
text.objectives: 击败洛瑟鲁斯
text.description:
这些邪裔无穷无尽！不快点把他们解决的话，陵墓里这个恐惧魔王就要溜走了。

伊利丹大人，你能和我一起来击败洛瑟鲁斯吗？
text.completion: We've done it! Without you, I fear I would have eventually succumbed to the onslaught.

english.title: Felspawns of Lothros
english.objectives: Defeat Lothros.
english.description:
These Felspawns are endless! I can't cut them down quickly enough to get to the dreadlord within the mausoleum.

Master Illidan, will you come with me so we can take down Lothros together?
english.completion: We've done it! Without you, I fear I would have eventually succumbed to the onslaught.

text.title: 赤斧
text.objectives: 关闭不稳定的传送门，并找到“赤斧”布洛克斯加。
text.description:
“赤斧”布洛克斯加在桥上被包围了。不知道他愿不愿意拉下脸来求救，但我想我们一定得去帮他一把。

如果你想协助我们的盟友，我将追随你一同奋战。
text.completion: A wise warrior welcomes all allies. You fight with the strength of an orc.

english.title: The Red Axe
english.objectives: Close the Unstable Portals and make your way to Broxigar the Red.
english.description:
Broxigar the Red is cornered on the bridge. I am not sure he would ever admit that he needs our help, but I feel it only proper to lend him our aid.

If you wish to assist our ally, I would be humbled to accompany you in this endeavor.
english.completion: A wise warrior welcomes all allies. You fight with the strength of an orc.

text.title: 暗夜猎手
text.objectives: 击败马文格罗斯
text.description:
真是一次辉煌的战斗！

如果我没猜错的话，我们得随时注意，准备好面对一些更致命的敌人。

军团经常用这些东西当做炮灰，来为更强大的敌人铺路。

我的斧子已经准备好斩杀敌人了。
text.completion: The spirits honor us with a day of glorious combat! You have my well-earned respect, Illidan Stormrage. I will gladly follow you into any battle.

english.title: Hunter of Night
english.objectives: Defeat Malvingeroth
english.description:
A glorious battle indeed!

If I am correct, we can expect something a bit more deadly at any moment.

The Legion often uses fodder such as these to prepare the way for a more worthy foe.

My axe is sharp and ready.
english.completion: The spirits honor us with a day of glorious combat! You have my well-earned respect, Illidan Stormrage. I will gladly follow you into any battle.

text.title: 又一个传奇
text.objectives: 和奥丁对话来追寻另一件神器。
text.description:
两件很不错，但三件当然更好。你应该再去找来一件神器放进你的武器库里。

你怎么说？
text.completion: That will definitely increase your power greatly.

english.title: One More Legend
english.objectives: Speak with Odyn to pursue another artifact.
english.description:
Two is good, but three would be better. You should pursue another artifact to add to your armory.

What say you?
english.completion: That will definitely increase your power greatly.

text.title: 畸形畸体
text.objectives: 使用卡德加的水晶中和达拉然的畸体。
text.description: 在我们原本的计划中，把达拉然移到现在的位置只是暂时的手段，但现在我们需要提前离开了。$b$b让一座城市瞬间移动到新的位置可不是轻松的工作。这其中需要调动的能量之大……可能会导致意料之外的副作用。$b$b奥术畸体正在在城市的各个角落造成意外事件，这样下一次传送就无法正常进行。$b$b我们没有时间让它们自生自灭了，$n。我有一台仪器，可以用来加速它们消亡的过程。
text.completion: Good work. There are still some stray anomalies floating about, but you've negated enough interference that we should no longer be prevented from relocating the city.$b$bNow we just need to determine our destination.

english.title: Anomalous Anomalies
english.objectives: Use Khadgar's crystal to neutralize anomalies in Dalaran.
english.description: Dalaran's move to this location was intended to be a temporary measure, but we may need to depart sooner than expected.$b$bBlinking a city across the world is no mean feat. The magnitude of energies involved can lead to... unexpected side effects.$b$bArcane anomalies are causing mischief throughout the city. Their presence could destabilize any attempt to blink again.$b$bWe don't have time to let them dissipate on their own, $n. I have a device that will help speed things along.
english.completion: Good work. There are still some stray anomalies floating about, but you've negated enough interference that we should no longer be prevented from relocating the city.$b$bNow we just need to determine our destination.

text.title: 三途三修
text.objectives: 选择你要追寻的第三件神器。
text.description:
我们在搜索中找到了一条线索，指向另一件你可能用得上的神器。

来，让我给介绍一下我的发现吧。如果你对它感兴趣，就直接告诉我。
text.completion: A wise choice.

english.title: Three Paths, Three Weapons
english.objectives: Choose a third artifact to pursue.
english.description:
We've searched and found a lead upon another artifact that you might find helpful.

Here, let me show you what I've found. If it interests you then simply let me know.
english.completion: A wise choice.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第三件神器

text.title: 更多的远古武器
text.objectives: 选择你要追寻的第三件神器。
text.description: 在对抗燃烧军团的战争中，你的表现相当出色，但是你应该准备好迎接今后的各种挑战。$b$b你应该考虑一下获取另一件远古神器，让你在战斗中占据更大的优势。$b$b告诉我你有什么打算。
text.completion: A sound choice.

english.title: More Weapons of Old
english.objectives: Choose a third artifact to pursue.
english.description: You've had great success against our foes, but you should be ready for any challenge they send your way.$b$bYou would be wise to consider obtaining yet another of the weapons of old to aid in our conflict.$b$bLet me know how you'd like to proceed.
english.completion: A sound choice.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第三件神器

text.title: 远古半神的武器
text.objectives: 选择你要追寻的第四件神器。
text.description: 你已经证明了自己是一位出类拔萃的德鲁伊，但如果想要彻底打败燃烧军团，就必须把握所有能够让我们取得优势的机会。$b$b还有最后一件上古神兵，或许你应该考虑一下。它可以让你挖掘出最强大的潜力，从容面对燃烧军团的一切阴谋诡计。$b$b告诉我你有什么打算。
text.completion: A sound choice.

english.title: Weapons of the Ancients
english.objectives: Choose a fourth artifact to pursue.
english.description: You've proven yourself to be a druid without equal, but if we are to succeed in our battles against the Burning Legion you need you to take advantage of every opportunity to stay ahead of our foes.$b$bYou should consider obtaining one final weapon of the Ancients. Its powers will maximize your ability to adapt to whatever the Legion can throw our way.$b$bLet me know how you'd like to proceed.
english.completion: A sound choice.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第四件神器

text.title: 在光与影的大厅
text.objectives: 将艾露恩之泪带到职业大厅中的圣光之心处。
text.description: 艾露恩之泪已经准备好了，$n。我不知道在这儿能对它做些什么。将这件圣物带回你的职业大厅，并试着对圣光之心使用它。$B$B也许要让它们互相接触到才行？说实话，我也只是在猜测而已。$B$B希望这能行得通！
text.progress: Any news?
text.completion: Dead? The titans are dead?$B$B<Khadgar ponders the news for a minute.>$B$BIt explains so much, yet I cannot help but feel an overwhelming sense of sadness. We have been on our own all along. Our gods killed before we were born.$B$BAs for the Army of the Light and Illidan, I am at a loss. I have never felt so powerless.$B$BIllidan is dead and the Golden Army fights an endless war in our name from across the cosmos.$B$BI need a moment, $n. This is too much bad news for an old man to bear.

english.title: In the House of Light and Shadow
english.objectives: Take the Tears of Elune to Light's Heart in your Order Hall.
english.description: The Tears of Elune are ready for you, $n. I am uncertain what to do from here. Take the relic back to your order hall and try to use it on Light's Heart.$B$BMaybe make them touch? Honestly your guess is as good as mine.$B$BLet's hope this works!
english.progress: Any news?
english.completion: Мертвы? Титаны мертвы?$B$B<Кадгар на минуту погружается в раздумья.>$B$BЭто многое объясняет... и все же чувствую бесконечную скорбь. Значит, мы все время были одни. text.title: 觉醒
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉见证伊利丹·怒风的觉醒。
text.description: 圣光之心将作为伊利丹·怒风复活的容器：这也是我最后一次为圣光奉献了。$B$B但伊利丹已死，他的灵魂也迷失在了虚空中。在尝试找回他的灵魂之前，我们必须准备好容器。$B$B在两个世界上有不少伊利丹过去的回响。你必须找到那些回响。$B$B从生命的起源：他的出生之地开始寻找，$n。在瓦尔莎拉找到伊利丹的出生地。唤醒回忆。
text.progress: Когда наш труд будет завершен, я затеряюсь в Великой тьме.
text.completion: An auspicious start to a life of tragedy. Perhaps one of the few joyous memories Illidan would have in his life. While the years that followed tested the prophesied child, they would never break him. You must remember that, despite what you may see as our journey continues.$B$BThere is much more to be done, but I am not yet ready. I will call for you when it is time.

Before we may attempt to recover his soul, we must prepare the vessel for his return.$B$BAcross two worlds exist echoes of Illidan's past. Но хотя грядущие годы принесли ребенку, чье рождение было предсказано пророчеством, много тяжких испытаний, они не сломили его. Помни это, что бы ты ни $gувидел:увидела; во время нашего путешествия.$B$BПредстоит еще многое сделать, но сперва мне нужно подготовиться. Я призову тебя, когда придет время.

text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉的梦境林地见证伊利丹的坚韧经历。

text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉的黑鸦堡垒体验拉文凯斯的遗产。
text.description: 许多年之后，上古之战的战火愈燃愈烈，燃烧军团即将掌控这个世界。伊利丹结识了一位军队将领，他的名字叫库塔洛斯·拉文凯斯。他也看到了伊利丹的潜力，最终将他提拔为月之守卫的队长，率领着这群强大的暗夜精灵法师战斗。$B$B我们必须到黑鸦堡垒去体验这段记忆。堡垒位于瓦尔莎拉的西海岸。
text.completion: The line between good and evil is thin, and resides in a place where intention means little.$B$BIllidan wondered how those around him could be so blind to the threat of the Burning Legion. Fate is not without a sense of irony.

He too would see the potential within Illidan, eventually promoting him to captain of the Moon Guard: a powerful group of night elf sorcerers.$B$BWe must experience this memory in Black Rook Hold, located on the western shores of Val'sharah.
english.completion: The line between good and evil is thin and hardly depends on our intentions. $B$BIllidan marveled at how blind his comrades-in-arms were to the threat of the Legion.  Fate is no stranger to irony.

text.title: 在我父的家里
text.objectives: 在卡利姆多的艾萨拉见证伊利丹的牺牲。
text.description: 大多数凡人无法理解燃烧军团的真正面目。那些能够意识到真相的人往往会拒绝接受其中的意义。这样的知识是如此的沉重，凡人的心灵无法承担。做出了那样的自我牺牲之后，他的灵魂也开始改变。$B$B在你们那些最伟大的英雄之中，很少有人能够理解这样的牺牲。就让我们通过伊利丹的眼睛见证这一切吧。$B$B我们需要到卡利姆多大陆的艾萨拉去。
text.completion: Illidan sought out the truth and was blinded by what he saw. He was beginning to understand his destiny, but there was one final sacrifice that he had yet to make.

Such knowledge carries a weight that the mortal frame cannot bear. To sacrifice that much of ones self changes the soul.$B$BAmong your greatest heroes, a rare few understood that type of sacrifice. Let us witness it through Illidan's eyes.$B$BWe must go to Azshara, on the continent of Kalimdor.
english.completion: Illidan sought out the truth and was blinded by what he saw. He was beginning to understand his destiny, but there was one final sacrifice that he had yet to make.

text.title: 吞噬者恐翼
text.objectives: 消灭吞噬者恐翼。
text.description: 感谢你把我从牢狱中解救出来，$n。$b$b无论如何，阿佐兰可不仅仅是恶魔。他是一个强大的艾瑞达，在燃烧军团内部拥有极高的地位。$b$b在我们对付他之前，还有别的东西需要先消灭掉。吞噬者恐翼是魔蝠中最强大的一只。将蜥蜴肉放在北边的祭坛上，等她现身时将她击杀。然后，带着她的头回来找我。我一定要报仇。
text.progress: What news do you bring of Grimwing the Devourer?
text.completion: Grimwing was a formidable demon... I must say I am always impressed with your skill, $n.$B$BThere are many more demons here to kill. It is good to be at your side once more.

english.title: Grimwing the Devourer
english.objectives: Slay Grimwing the Devourer.
english.description: You have my thanks for rescuing me from captivity, $n.$b$bHowever, Azoran is no mere demon. He is a powerful eredar who commands great rank within the Burning Legion.$b$bBefore we can get to him, there is another that must be destroyed.$b$bGrimwing the Devourer is the strongest of the felbats. Place the basilisk flesh upon the altar to the north and slay Grimwing when she appears.$b$bThen, return to me with her head. My thirst for vengeance must be quenched.
english.progress: What news do you bring of Grimwing the Devourer?
english.completion: Grimwing was a formidable demon... I must say I am always impressed with your skill, $n.$B$BThere are many more demons here to kill. It is good to be at your side once more.

text.title: 魔网学徒
text.objectives: 与奥术师瓦尔托伊谈一谈。
text.description:
干得好！你找到了那些额外的魔网能量。

对于一个外乡人而言，你可真能干。

让我和你分享一些有关魔网能量的秘密吧。这可以帮助你从苏拉玛的生物身上获得更多远古魔力。我知道，这是一个可怕的任务——这也正是我把它交给你的原因！
text.completion: Now listen closely.

english.title: Leyline Apprentice
english.objectives: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois.
english.description:
Good work finding those additional leyline feeds.

You seem rather competent - for an outlander.

Allow me to share with you a few secrets about the power of the leylines. This should help you in scavenging more ancient mana from the creatures around Suramar. A grisly task, I know - which is why I leave it to you!
english.completion: Теперь слушай внимательно.

text.title: 魔网熟稔
text.objectives: 与奥术师瓦尔托伊谈一谈。
text.description:
我们的魔网能量愈发强大了。

我们得到的供给越强，我对远古魔力的理解也越深。

当然，作为我的学徒，你可以和我分享这些发现。仔细听好，我会教你如何更切实地从你的敌人那里抽取力量。
text.completion: Do your best to pick this up the first time - I do hate repeating myself.

english.title: Leyline Proficiency
english.objectives: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois.
english.description:
Our leyline feed grows stronger.

The more powerful our feed becomes, the more I learn about ancient mana itself.

Of course, as my apprentice, you may reap the benefits of my discoveries. Listen well, and I will teach you how to extract power from your enemies more reliably.
english.completion: Старайся разобраться с первого раза – ненавижу повторять одно и то же!

text.title: 魔网大师
text.objectives: 与奥术师瓦尔托伊谈一谈。
text.description:
你让我很惊讶，外乡人。在我们有关远古魔网的第一堂课上，我原以为你已经陷入白日梦里，只会幻想着冒险啊、宝藏啊或者……别的什么乱七八糟的东西。

但你证明了自己是个聪明的学徒。

我们的魔网能量已经变得极为强大了。看着它一步步增长让我了解了很多有关奥术，以及魔力本质的知识。

但我还有最后一堂课，教你如何寻找更多的远古魔力。
text.completion: Perhaps there is hope for outlanders after all.

english.title: Leyline Master
english.objectives: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois.
english.description:
You surprise me, outlander. During our first lesson about the ancient leylines, I half-expected you to be lost in daydreams of adventure, or treasure or... some such nonsense.

But you have proven an apt student.

Our leyline feed has grown extremely powerful. Watching it grow has taught me a great deal about the arcane, and the nature of mana.

I have one final lesson that will help you find even more ancient mana.
english.completion: Может, и для чужаков все не так безнадежно.

text.title: 未竟的宿命
text.objectives: 在外域边境的影月谷见证真正的背叛。
text.description: 已经很少有人能认出他是昔日那个金色眼睛的预言之子了，他在这个破碎世界的边缘过着流亡者的生活，但坚定的决心从不曾改变过。抗击燃烧军团，结束他们的远征，这是他心中唯一的念头。$B$B然而，命运奇特而扭曲，给他带来最后一击的却并不是燃烧军团。$B$B我们必须到外域去，重温伊利丹最后的记忆。
text.completion: In the end, the denizens of Azeroth and Outland came to exact their vengeance upon Illidan. Though you did not strike a blow against him, you were complicit in his fall.$B$BI showed you Illidan's life so that you would understand why he fought and made the choices that he made. Yours was the vessel that needed preparation.$B$BIf the hatred and doubt in your heart has subsided, take your place at the side of the Light. Soon I will call upon you as we begin the hunt for Illidan's soul.

english.title: Destiny Unfulfilled
english.objectives: Witness True Betrayal in Shadowmoon Valley on the fringes of Outland.
english.description: Hardly recognizable from the golden eyed child of prophecy, and living as an outcast on the fringes of a shattered world, his motivation remained unchanged. His assaults on the Legion and his attempts to end their march were his only focus.$B$BYet, in a strange twist of fate, it was not the Burning Legion who came for him in the end.$B$BWe must travel to Outland to experience Illidan's last memory.
english.completion: In the end, the denizens of Azeroth and Outland came to exact their vengeance upon Illidan. Though you did not strike a blow against him, you were complicit in his fall.$B$BI showed you Illidan's life so that you would understand why he fought and made the choices that he made. Yours was the vessel that needed preparation.$B$BIf the hatred and doubt in your heart has subsided, take your place at the side of the Light. Soon I will call upon you as we begin the hunt for Illidan's soul.

text.title: 未竟的宿命
text.objectives: 在外域边境的影月谷见证真正的背叛。
text.description: 已经很少有人能认出他是昔日那个金色眼睛的预言之子了，他在这个破碎世界的边缘过着流亡者的生活，但坚定的决心从不曾改变过。抗击燃烧军团，结束他们的远征，这是他心中唯一的念头。$B$B然而，命运奇特而扭曲，给他带来最后一击的却并不是燃烧军团。$B$B我们必须到外域去，重温伊利丹最后的记忆。
text.completion: Forgive me, noble soul. I mislead you. Light's Heart was not the vessel that required preparation, it was yours.$B$BYou, who sacrificed everything for your world, and served your master dutifully until the end. These memories will serve to strengthen your resolve. Look to them when the dark temptation surrounds you and let them grant you the strength to resist and rise against the corrupters.$B$BWe will save Illidan and once more you will battle at the side of your master for the fate of all worlds.

english.objectives: Witness True Betrayal in Shadowmoon Valley on the fringes of Outland.
english.description: Hardly recognizable from the golden eyed child of prophecy, and living as an outcast on the fringes of a shattered world, his motivation remained unchanged. His assaults on the Legion and his attempts to end their march were his only focus.$B$BYet, in a strange twist of fate, it was not the Burning Legion who came for him in the end.$B$BWe must travel to Outland to experience Illidan's last memory.

Light's Heart was not the vessel that required preparation, it was yours.$B$BYou, who sacrificed everything for your world, and served your master dutifully until the end. These memories will serve to strengthen your resolve. Look to them when the dark temptation surrounds you and let them grant you the strength to resist and rise against the corrupters.$B$BWe will save Illidan and once more you will battle at the side of your master for the fate of all worlds.

text.title: 大作家
text.objectives: 告诉卡德加开始仪式，召唤首任守护者阿洛迪之魂。
text.description: 我们检查了从达拉然取回的书籍。虽然我们找到了一些关于创世之柱的只言片语，但是其中最重要的一段，书里没有提……这些神器在哪里。$b$b幸好，我们可以与这方面的专家交流。$b$b书籍的作者阿洛迪是提瑞斯法议会的首任守护者。他的灵魂永远都与守护者熔炉绑定在了一起。而守护者熔炉则由我们藏起来保管。我觉得，召唤他的时机来到了。
text.completion: We may not have the exact location of the Pillars of Creation, but at least we know where to start. We'll explore every corner of the Broken Isles until they're recovered.$b$bThe Legion's attack is intensifying. We must prepare to move Dalaran to the Broken Isles!

english.title: Author! Author!
english.objectives: Tell Khadgar to begin the ritual to summon the spirit of Alodi, the first Guardian.
english.description: We've reviewed the tome recovered from Karazhan. Though we found references to the Pillars of Creation, one piece of crucial information was omitted from the book... where to find the artifacts.$b$bFortunately, we have access to an expert on the subject.$b$bThe author, Alodi, was the first Guardian of Tirisfal. His spirit is forever bound to the Forge of the Guardian, which has been hidden in our safekeeping. I think the time has come to call him forth.
english.completion: We may not have the exact location of the Pillars of Creation, but at least we know where to start. We'll explore every corner of the Broken Isles until they're recovered.$b$bThe Legion's attack is intensifying. We must prepare to move Dalaran to the Broken Isles!

objectiveDetails.description: 召唤阿洛迪并了解创世之柱的位置

text.title: 破碎海滩之战
text.objectives: 骑乘双足飞龙前往破碎群岛。
text.description:
这头双足飞龙会带你前往破碎海滩，$n。祝你今天能够纵横沙场。

大酋长已经登陆。我打赌，你只要跟着恶魔的血迹走就对了。
text.completion: Glad to see you back on your feet, $n. Many good soldiers who sailed for the Broken Shore were not so fortunate.

english.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
english.objectives: Take the wind rider to the Broken Shore.
english.description:
This wind rider will take you to Broken Shore, $n. May your weapon bring you many kills today.

The Warchief has already made landfall, I will wager you will simply need to follow the trail of demon blood.
english.completion: Хорошо, что ты снова на ногах, $n. Многим славным бойцам, отправившимся на Расколотый берег, повезло меньше.

text.title: 大地之环的召唤
text.objectives: 和顾问塞维尔谈一谈。
text.description:
我总算找到你了！

顾问塞维尔让我给你带话。

大地之环需要你，先知。请尽快回艾泽拉斯之心一趟。顾问塞维尔正急切地盼着你回去呐。
text.completion: It is good that you are here, Farseer $n. We have much to discuss.

english.title: Call of the Earthen Ring
english.objectives: Speak with Advisor Sevel.
english.description:
At last, I've found you!

I have a message from Advisor Sevel.

The Earthen Ring has need of you, Farseer. Please return to the Heart of Azeroth at your soonest convenience. Advisor Sevel is eagerly awaiting your return.
english.completion: Хорошо, что ты здесь, $gПредсказатель:Предсказательница; $n. Нам многое надо обсудить.

text.title: 加强攻势
text.objectives: 在你的职业大厅的指挥地图上选择下一个突击点。
text.description: <在安全获得创世之柱后，是时候利用这股势头乘胜追击了。>$B$B<你想起你的组织已经收集了一些对这次旅途有用的信息——你最好在出发前再去看一眼。>
text.completion: <Your order's intel in hand, you are well-prepared for your next assault on the Broken Isles.>

english.title: Pressing the Assault
english.objectives: Select your next assault point on the Broken Isles at the Command Map in your Order Hall.
english.description: <With this Pillar of Creation safely secured, it is time to take advantage of your momentum and continue onward after the next.>$B$B<You recall that your order has gathered information that would aid you in your journey - looking it over once more before setting off would be wise.>
english.completion: <Your order's intel in hand, you are well-prepared for your next assault on the Broken Isles.>

text.title: 粉碎皇冠药剂公司
text.objectives: 在银松森林的影牙城堡南部消灭12个皇冠药剂公司的员工，并使用滑栓的氪金炸弹摧毁一辆药剂车，然后向奥格瑞玛的侦探斯奈普·滑栓复命。
text.description: 这个账本上写的全是地点，你得去调查一下并采取行动，朋友。这事已经闹得够久了。$b$b我想让你去看看这个地方：就在银松森林的影牙城堡南面。那里肯定没好事。去好好教训他们一下吧。$b$b哦，如果你遇到什么又大又危险的玩意需要销毁的话，就把这个炸弹扔过去。

english.title: Crushing the Crown
english.objectives: Kill 12 Crown Chemical Co. Employees and use Snagglebolt's Khorium Bomb to destroy a chemical wagon south of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest, then return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.
english.description: This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.$b$bHere's an entry I want you to check out: it's just south of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up.$b$bOh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭皇冠药剂公司的员工

text.title: 蛙跳战术
text.objectives: 在你的职业大厅的指挥地图上选择下一个突击点。
text.description: <胜利已经在望了，你知道要想彻底打败燃烧军团，就需要找到剩下的创世之柱。>$B$B<你的组织已经侦察了破碎群岛上未曾绘制过地图、且含有剩余创世之柱的区域。查看这些信息可以帮助你计划下一步的行动。>
text.completion: <You are fully prepared to search for the next Pillar of Creation. >

english.title: Isle Hopping
english.objectives: Select your next assault point on the Broken Isles at the Command Map in your Order Hall.
english.description: <Victory in hand, you know there are still Pillars of Creation that must be recovered if the Legion is to be defeated once and for all.>$B$B<Your order has identified uncharted regions of the Broken Isles that still house the remaining Pillars - looking over the information would help focus your next effort.>
english.completion: <You are fully prepared to search for the next Pillar of Creation. >

text.title: 剩余的岛屿
text.objectives: 在你的职业大厅的指挥地图上选择下一个突击点。
text.description: <环顾大厅，你意识到自己收集创世之柱的行动很顺利。但你的任务还没有完成。>$B$B<你的组织已经搜查了下列岛屿，寻找一切可能有用的信息——你最好在出发前去查看一下。>

english.title: Scouring What Remains
english.objectives: Select your next assault point on the Broken Isles at the Command Map in your Order Hall.
english.description: <Looking around the chamber, you know you are well on your way to gathering all of the Pillars of Creation, but your work is not yet complete.>$B$B<Your order has continued to scour the isles below for anything that might be useful - best to check in with them before embarking once more.>

text.title: 全岛制霸
text.objectives: 在你的职业大厅的指挥地图上查看剩余的突击点。
text.description: <在你的组织精心制定的突袭破碎群岛、收集创世之柱的行动列表上，只剩下最后一片区域了。>$B$B<胜利已经近在眼前了，但最后研究一次组织收集的情报也没什么坏处。>

english.title: Master of the Isles
english.objectives: Review your remaining assault point on the Broken Isles at the Command Map in your Order Hall.
english.description: <Only one region remains from your order's carefully laid plan to assault the Broken Isles and gather the Pillars of Creation.>$B$B<Victory feels close, but studying your order's intelligence one last time couldn't hurt.>

text.title: 阿彻鲁斯的召唤
text.objectives: 与女妖希奥克丝谈一谈
text.description:
死亡领主，请立刻来阿彻鲁斯一晤。

抵抗燃烧军团的战事已展开地如火如荼，黑锋骑士团正在等待进一步的命令。

请在您方便时尽快返回阿彻鲁斯。女妖希奥克丝等待着您的归来。
text.completion: You have arrived at last, Deathlord. We have much to discuss.

english.title: Called to Acherus
english.objectives: Speak with Siouxsie the Banshee
english.description:
Deathlord, your presence has been requested on Acherus.

The war against the Burning Legion rages on and the Knights of the Ebon Blade await further orders.

Please return to Acherus at your soonest convenience. Siouxsie the Banshee is awaiting your return.
english.completion: You have arrived at last, Deathlord. We have much to discuss.

text.title: 卡德加的发现
text.objectives: 与达拉然的大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description: 勇士！请立刻前往紫罗兰城堡。$B$B我有了一个新发现，希望能在六人议会召开前与你分享。
text.completion: Thank you for coming, $n.

english.title: Khadgar's Discovery
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
english.description: Champion! Please come to the Violet Citadel immediately.$B$BI have made a discovery that I would like to share with you before the Council of Six.
english.completion: Thank you for coming, $n.

text.title: 重返卡拉赞
text.objectives: 去卡拉赞外面找卡德加。
text.description: 卡拉赞已经落入了燃烧军团手中，$n。$b$b这都是我的错。我急着找阿洛迪的那本介绍创世之柱的书，没有好好设置保护塔楼的防御法术。燃烧军团很快就发现了它的弱点。$b$b萨格拉斯花了很多时间来控制麦迪文，他跟我一样，知晓那座塔楼的许多秘密。不管黑暗泰坦有什么阴谋诡计，我们都必须尽全力去阻止。$b$b快来吧！我在卡拉赞外面等你。
text.completion: We have work to do!

english.title: Return to Karazhan
english.objectives: Meet Khadgar outside Karazhan.
english.description: Karazhan is now in the hands of the Legion, $n.$b$bThe fault is mine. In my haste to retrieve Alodi's book on the Pillars of Creation, the defenses I put in place to protect the tower were ramshackle at best. The Legion was quick to find a weakness.$b$bThanks to the time Sargeras spent controlling Medivh, he knows the tower's secrets as well as I do. Whatever the Dark Titan's plan is, we must do everything in our power to stop it.$b$bCome at once! I'll meet you outside Karazhan.
english.completion: У нас много дел!

objectiveDetails.description: 使用传送门去卡拉赞（可选）

text.title: 有限增援
text.objectives: 在逆风小径关闭$1oa个传送门，消灭$2oa个恶魔。
text.description: 看来我设置的防御措施还没有完全崩溃。燃烧军团无法在塔楼内部或者附近开启传送门……至少目前还没成功。$b$b他们的援军正在从逆风小径地下的墓穴赶来。快去阻止他们，这或许能为我们争取一点时间，把他们赶出卡拉赞。
text.completion: Well done! At least now most of the remaining demons we have to deal with are currently inside the tower.$B$BCouldn't be more than a thousand or two, I'm sure.

english.title: Finite Numbers
english.objectives: Close $1oa Portals and slay $2oa Demons in Deadwind Pass.
english.description: It seems not all the protections I put in place have been defeated. The Legion isn't able to open portals inside or near the tower... at least, not yet.$b$bThey appear to be bringing reinforcements in through the catacombs running beneath Deadwind Pass. Disable them and you just might buy us the time we need to drive them out of Karazhan.
english.completion: Прекрасная работа! Большинство оставшихся демонов находится в башне – по крайней мере пока.$b$bЯ уверен, их там не больше тысячи или двух.

text.title: 粉碎皇冠药剂公司
text.objectives: 在银松森林的影牙城堡南部消灭12个皇冠药剂公司的员工，并使用滑栓的氪金炸弹摧毁一辆药剂车，然后向暴风城的探员斯尼普·滑栓复命。
text.description: 这个账本上写的全是地点，你得去调查一下并采取行动，朋友。这事已经闹得够久了。$b$b我想让你去看看这个地方：就在银松森林的影牙城堡南面。那里肯定没好事。去好好教训他们一下吧。$b$b哦，如果你遇到什么又大又危险的玩意需要销毁的话，就把这个炸弹扔过去。

english.title: Crushing the Crown
english.objectives: Kill 12 Crown Chemical Co. Employees and use Snagglebolt's Khorium Bomb to destroy a chemical wagon south of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest, then return to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.
english.description: This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.$b$bHere's an entry I want you to check out: it's just south of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up.$b$bOh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭皇冠药剂公司的员工

text.title: 寻找配方
text.objectives: 收集皇冠药剂公司的配方的其他部分，然后向奥格瑞玛的侦探斯奈普·滑栓复命。
text.description: 皇冠药剂公司似乎正在制造某种合剂，而这就是其中一部分配方。其他部分应该就在附近。

text.title: 希望的种子
text.objectives: 在堕夜精灵阵营中达到尊敬声望。
text.description: 塔莉萨派你来寻找阿坎多尔是明智之举，但她低估了它的力量。$B$B她迟早会明白的——就像其他人一样。$B$B但这需要时间。而那些被饥渴折磨着灵魂的堕夜精灵需要你的帮助才能生存下去。
text.progress: Arkan'dor needs time.
text.completion: In the changing of seasons, the truth will be revealed.

english.title: Seed of Hope
english.objectives: Reach Honored with The Nightfallen.
english.description: Thalyssra was wise to send you in search of the arcan'dor, though she underestimates its power.$B$BShe will learn - as will the others.$B$BBut it will take time. And with hunger gnawing at their very souls, the Nightfallen will need your help to survive.
english.progress: Arkan'dor needs time.
english.completion: The changing seasons will reveal the truth.

text.title: 日渐壮大
text.objectives: 在堕夜精灵阵营中达到崇敬声望。
text.description: 魔法已经钳制精灵太久了。它造就了我们，让我们摆脱蒙昧——但失去平衡的魔法也会毁了我们。$B$B夏多雷太过骄傲，不愿承认这一点。他们就是放纵魔瘾的产物。他们的生活极其不和谐。$B$B但我感觉到了堕夜精灵的潜力。失去一切令他们变得谦卑。这也让他们更加坚强。$B$B坚持下去，$p。帮助堕夜精灵崛起吧。
text.progress: Ты чуешь его? Ты ощущаешь ветер перемен?
text.completion: We shall help the shal'dorei find harmony.

english.title: Growing Strong
english.objectives: Reach Revered with The Nightfallen.
english.description: Magic has long been a vice of the elves. It shaped us, and lifted us out of the darkness - but without balance, it also threatens to unmake us.$B$BThe shal'dorei are too proud to admit it, but they are the product of indulgence. They live without harmony.$B$BBut I sense potential among the Nightfallen. Losing everything has humbled them. It has made them stronger.$B$BStay the course, $p. Help the Nightfallen rise up.
english.progress: Ты чуешь его? Ты ощущаешь ветер перемен?
english.completion: Мы поможем шал'дорай обрести гармонию.

text.title: 沉沦者的救赎
text.objectives: 在堕夜精灵阵营中达到崇拜声望。
text.description: 季节的轮替即将到来，堕夜精灵将主宰他们的命运。$B$B你给了他们希望，并带他们走上的救赎之路。此刻，他们更加需要你。$B$B我们也是。
text.progress: У нас еще очень много дел.
text.completion: Finally, my long lost brethren can return to this world. Elves belong beneath a starry sky - not a conjured one.$B$BThank you, $n.

english.title: Redemption for the Fallen
english.objectives: Reach Exalted with The Nightfallen.
english.description: Soon the change of seasons will be upon us, and the Nightfallen will take command of their fate.$B$BYou have given them hope, and set them on the path to redemption. They need you now more than ever.$B$BWe all do.
english.progress: У нас еще очень много дел.
english.completion: Наконец-то мои заблудшие братья смогут вернуться в этот мир. Эльфам подобает жить под звездным небом, а не под сотворенным чародейским куполом.$B$BСпасибо тебе, $p.

text.title: 祭拜这团火焰
text.objectives: 祭拜阿兰卡峰林的仲夏篝火。
text.description: 仲夏火焰节是敬拜元素的时刻。火焰元素会在我们所有人心中点燃激情。在许多时候，这种激情会喷发出来，演变成侵略性的行动。但在这个地方，我们将心中的激情变为虔诚的祭拜。$b$b我们会遵循传统，为火焰举行庆典。你愿意和我们一同敬拜火焰吗，$n？
text.completion: Honor the Spires of Arak flame.
text.end: 祭拜阿兰卡峰林的仲夏篝火。

english.title: Honor the Flame
english.objectives: Honor the Midsummer Bonfire in Spires of Arak.
english.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements.  The element of fire stirs passion within us all.  Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions.  But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.$b$bWe will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, $n?
english.completion: Поклонитесь огню на Пиках Арака.
english.end: Honor the Midsummer Bonfire in Spires of Arak.

text.title: We'll Need Some Obliterum
text.objectives: Find Camille Kleister in the Magus Commerce Exchange district of Dalaran.
text.description:
Loramus Thalipedes has offered to improve our armaments. He says that he pried a secret out of Razelikh. Apparently, the demon knows how to work a material known as Obliterum.

I myself have coerced some information out of the demons. One of the souls trapped in my scythe has whispered the name, Camille Kleister. All I know is that she is somewhere in Dalaran. For the rest, you are on your own.
text.giverWindow: Find this human woman in Dalaran.

text.title: 组建部队
text.objectives: 你准备好带领枯法者进行第一个战斗训练任务后，就与塔莉萨谈一谈。
text.description: 我们应该着眼未来。我们迟早会需要军队的。$b$b枯法者已经被证明并非完全不可救药。他们是可以被训练和改造的。$b$b我希望你能担任他们的战斗训练师，$n。跟我来，我们可以用附近的废墟作为竞技场，让他们磨练战斗技巧。
text.completion: Иссохшие собраны и готовы к обучению.

english.title: Building an Army
english.objectives: Speak with Thalyssra when you are ready to lead the withered in their first combat training mission.
english.description: We must keep our eyes on the future. There will come a time when we will need an army.$b$bWe've proven that the withered are not completely beyond redemption. They can be taught, and molded.$b$bI want you to be their combat trainer, $n. Come with me. We can use the nearby ruins as an arena to hone their abilities.
english.completion: Иссохшие собраны и готовы к обучению.

objectiveDetails.description: 与塔莉萨交谈以训练枯法者

text.title: 眨眼之间
text.objectives: 见证达拉然传送到破碎群岛。
text.description: <这个东西嘴里传出了大法师卡德加的熟悉声音。>$B$B艾泽拉斯需要你，$n！$b$b去奥杜尔和卡拉赞寻找过答案后，我们知道了击败燃烧军团的关键：五件被称为创世之柱的古老神器。$b$b为了寻找它们，达拉然必须迁往破碎群岛。由于我们的领袖吉安娜……缺席，蓝龙军团的卡雷苟斯决定帮助肯瑞托。$b$b燃烧军团已经开始在逆风小径上方对我们展开攻击。快来！
text.completion: Ah, $n, it's good to see you on your feet! The members of the Council of Six are recuperating from their ordeal.$B$BThe intensity of the teleportation spell can be disorienting. It seems you lost consciousness for a time, but at least you didn't awaken to find yourself stuck in a wall!$B$BDalaran has been relocated to the Broken Isles. From here, we will spearhead the effort to acquire the Pillars of Creation and drive the Legion from Azeroth once and for all!

english.title: In the Blink of an Eye
english.objectives: Witness the teleportation of Dalaran to the Broken Isles.
english.description: <The entity speaks with the familiar voice of Archmage Khadgar.>$b$bAzeroth needs you, $n!$B$BAfter scouring Ulduar and Karazhan for answers, we know the key to defeating the Legion: five ancient artifacts called the Pillars of Creation.$b$bTo find them, Dalaran must be moved to the Broken Isles. As our leader Jaina is... absent, Kalecgos of the blue dragonflight has offered the Kirin Tor his aid.$b$bThe Legion is assaulting our current position over Deadwind Pass. Hurry!
english.completion: Ah, $n, it's good to see you on your feet! The members of the Council of Six are recuperating from their ordeal.$B$BThe intensity of the teleportation spell can be disorienting. It seems you lost consciousness for a time, but at least you didn't awaken to find yourself stuck in a wall!$B$BDalaran has been relocated to the Broken Isles. From here, we will spearhead the effort to acquire the Pillars of Creation and drive the Legion from Azeroth once and for all!

objectiveDetails.description: 使用通往达拉然的传送门

text.title: 瓦拉加尔的意志
text.objectives: 完成10个世界任务。
text.description: 我们准备对燃烧军团的世界发动攻击，这次绝对不能给敌人任何喘息的机会。$B$B你的军队正在试图拿下恶魔的传送门，你应该可以顺利返回破碎群岛，继续与阻拦你的敌人作战。
text.completion: You've done well. Our enemies tremble before you and your armies.

english.title: Will of the Valarjar
english.objectives: Complete 10 World Quests.
english.description: As we prepare to launch an attack on the Legion's own world, it is important to not give reprieve to our enemies in this one.$B$BAs your armies seek to secure enemy gateways, you would do well to return to the Broken Isles and carry on the battle against those who stand against you.
english.completion: Превосходно. Враги трепещут пред тобой и твоим войском.

text.title: 远古魔力
text.objectives: 从$1oa个远古魔力节点进行采集。
text.description: 离开了暗夜井，我和我的伙伴只能从这片大地中获取赖以生存的魔力。$B$B地下魔网中的远古魔力会以许多形式出现在地面上，最常见的是水晶或者宝石。$B$B<塔莉萨捡起一块小石头，口中呢喃着真言，指尖在石头上留下了一个符文。>$B$B如果附近有远古魔力，这块石头就会发光。请尽量多收集一点！在接下来的数周里，远古魔力会成为一种宝贵的资源。
text.completion: Keep a lookout for those crystal formations all over Suramar. We will need them.

english.title: Ancient Mana
english.objectives: Gather from $1oa Ancient Mana nodes.
english.description: Without the Nightwell to feed upon, my comrades and I will have to live off the land itself.$B$BAncient mana from the underground leylines can reach the surface in many forms, most commonly as crystals or gems.$B$B<Thalyssra picks up a small stone and, whispering words of power, traces a rune upon it with her fingertip.>$B$BThis stone will glow when ancient mana is nearby. Please gather as much as possible! It will be a precious resource in the weeks to come.
english.completion: Продолжай следить за месторождениями кристаллов по всему Сурамару. Они нам еще пригодятся.

text.title: 身先士卒
text.objectives: 完成10个世界任务。
text.description: 我们当前的处境虽然有些困难，但我们并不能因此放弃隐秘通途的使命，也就是保护艾泽拉斯的人民。$B$B这个世界上有很多人需要我们的帮助。$B$B你身为我们的领袖，应该身先士卒，救人于危难。
text.completion: You are an inspiration to us all, $n.

english.title: Leading by Example
english.objectives: Complete 10 World Quests.
english.description: We cannot let our current situation overshadow the Unseen Path's mission to protect the people of Azeroth.$B$BThere are many in this world who could use our help.$B$BAs our leader, you can set the example by aiding those in need.
english.completion: Ты $gвоодушевил:воодушевила; нас, $n.

text.title: 无可比拟的力量
text.objectives: 完成10个世界任务。
text.description: 我们周围到处都是力量，$n，这些力量期待着我们的驾驭。$B$B你得到世界上冒险，把这些力量带给议会！$B$B当我们议会的首座获得此等无可比拟的力量的时候，我们的敌人就根本毫无胜算。
text.completion: The power within you grows, $n. You will serve the council well.

english.title: Unparalleled Power
english.objectives: Complete 10 World Quests.
english.description: Power is all around us, $n, waiting to be harnessed.$B$BYou must venture out into the world and claim it for the council!$B$BWith our First wielding such unparalleled power, our enemies won't stand a chance.
english.completion: Твоя сила растет, $n. Ты хорошо послужишь Совету.

text.title: 守住阵线
text.objectives: 夺取卡拉赞地下的东部魔网和西部魔网。
text.description: 卡拉赞坐落在魔网的交汇点上。这也是为什么当初会选这个地方修建塔楼……这一点当然逃不过燃烧军团的眼睛。$b$b如果恶魔是在吸取魔网的能量，那他们肯定是想用这些能量来干特别邪恶的事情。你得阻止他们接入魔网，然后我们才有机会夺回塔楼，$n。
text.completion: The Legion's hold wanes. Our time to strike grows nearer.

english.title: Holding the Lines
english.objectives: Secure the Eastern Ley Line and Western Ley Line beneath Karazhan.
english.description: Karazhan sits upon a confluence of ley lines. It's why this location was chosen for the tower in the first place... a fact that has not escaped the Legion's notice.$b$bIf the demons are tapping into these lines of power, they must need their energy for something particularly menacing. You must cut off their access to the ley lines if we're to have a chance of retaking the tower, $n.
english.completion: Хватка Легиона слабеет. Скоро мы нанесем удар.

text.title: 深层腐化
text.objectives: 从逆风小径地下的山洞中获取一份腐化土壤精华和一份腐化水体精华。
text.description: 燃烧军团所接触的一切都会留下指纹般的腐蚀痕迹。如果能让我研究一下他们留下的魔法痕迹，或许就能搞清他们来卡拉赞的目的。$b$b这个瓶子经过了特殊加固，可以容纳邪能魔法。如果你能给我带一些他们传送门周围的腐化土壤和水体的精华来，我们就有望破解他们的阴谋了。
text.completion: Every bit contains an essence of sorts - one we can study to learn things about the magic wielder and ways to manipulate their magic for... other purposes.

english.title: Corruption Runs Deep
english.objectives: Recover an Essence of Corrupted Soil and an Essence of Corrupted Water from the caverns beneath Deadwind Pass.
english.description: Everything the Legion touches is marred by fingerprints of their corruption. If I can study the traces of magic they leave behind, perhaps I can discern their plans for Karazhan.$b$bThis vial is specially reinforced to contain fel magic. If you bring me the essences of corrupted soil and water from near their portals, I believe we'll be closer to unraveling their scheme.
english.completion: Каждая частичка содержит своего рода эссенцию, по которой можно многое узнать об ее обладателе и возможностях использования его магии для... иных целей.

text.title: 再制壁垒
text.objectives: 在逆风小径塔楼的东部、南部和北部放置结界。
text.description: 夺下魔网之后，我们就该清理塔楼周边的区域了。$b$b塔楼周围有几个地方的腐蚀依然十分猖獗。去找到那些地方，用这种结界将它们保护起来。$b$b按照我们目前的进展，再加强一下防御，就能把其余的燃烧军团挡住，直到我们找出幕后黑手。
text.completion: You've bought us precious time.

english.title: Reclaiming the Ramparts
english.objectives: Plant the Wards at the Eastern, Southern and Northern locations around the tower in Deadwind Pass.
english.description: With the ley lines protected we must move to secure the tower's perimeter.$B$BAround the tower are several locations where corruption continues to run rampant. Seek out these locations and secure them with these wards.$B$BWith the progress we've made so far, bolstering our defenses should keep the remaining Legion's forces at bay just long enough for us to discover who's behind their efforts.
english.completion: Тебе удалось выиграть для нас время.

text.title: 刨根问底
text.objectives: 前往逆风小径塔楼北面的建筑审问被俘的虫语者。
text.description: 在我深入研究样本时，请你到北面的建筑去询问一下我们的某个巡逻队。他们好像抓到了一个恶魔。$b$b快，去审问一下，看看能不能问出什么东西。抓紧点！我们的时间恐怕不多了。
text.completion: This information is just what we needed.

english.title: Thought Collection
english.objectives: Interrogate the Captured Wyrmtongue in the structure just north of the tower in Deadwind Pass.
english.description: While I examine these samples further, I ask that you seek out one of our patrols in the structure to the north. It appears they've captured one of the demons.$B$BGo, interrogate it. Find out anything you can. And hurry! I'm afraid time is no longer an ally.
english.completion: Это именно то, что нужно.

text.title: 提瑞斯秘法会之力
text.objectives: 完成10个世界任务。
text.description: 提瑞斯秘法会收到了来自破碎群岛各地的请求，希望我们支援他们与燃烧军团作战。我们在寻找大法师瓦格斯的同时，也不能忘记，我们首要的使命是驱除恶魔，保护艾泽拉斯。
text.progress: Without our help, Azeroth will swallow the flame of the Legion.
text.completion: Well done, conjuror. With heroes like you at the helm, the Tirisgarde is a force to be reckoned with!

english.title: The Might of the Tirisgarde
english.objectives: Complete 10 World Quests.
english.description: The Tirisgarde has received requests from across the Broken Isles for aid in fighting the Burning Legion. While we will continue pursuing Archmage Vargoth, we cannot forget that our primary mission is to repel the demons and protect Azeroth.
english.progress: Without our help, Azeroth will swallow the flame of the Legion.
english.completion: Ты хорошо $gпотрудился:потрудилась;, Верховный маг. Именно благодаря таким героям, как ты, Стражи Тирисфаля пользуются уважением.

text.title: 口腹之欲
text.objectives: 给首席传送师欧库勒斯喂食远古魔力。
text.description: 我们必须尽快让首席传送师欧库勒斯好起来。$B$B不管你用什么方法，去弄份远古魔力来喂他吃下。
text.progress: <Okuleta is shaking.>
text.completion: Ah, I am feeling much better. Thank you!$B$BNow let us get to work.

english.title: Hungry Work
english.objectives: Use Ancient Mana to feed Chief Telemancer Oculeth.
english.description: We must get Chief Telemancer Oculeth back on his feet as soon as possible.$B$BFind ancient mana, any way you can, and feed it to him.
english.progress: <Okuleta is shaking.>
english.completion: Мне уже намного лучше. Спасибо!$B$BА теперь займемся делом.

objectiveDetails.description: 喂饱首席传送师欧库勒斯

text.title: 步步为营
text.objectives: 完成10个世界任务。
text.description:
在成为恶魔猎手前，我是个法师。我仍然具备一些魔法知识，但邪能已经令我完全无法使用它们了。

我唯一能做的，就是偶尔能够窥视远方。你应该已经见过我使用虚空坩埚那么做了。我想这恐怕还不够。

跟我们作对的并不仅仅是燃烧军团。你必须尽快行动，防止破碎群岛被攻占。
text.completion: It would seem that you have done an excellent job of eliminating a great many threats on the Broken Isles.$B$BYou never fail to impress me, $n.
text.completed: 回邪能之槌号找食魂者阿莱利。

english.title: One Battle at a Time
english.objectives: Complete 10 World Quests.
english.description:
Before I  became a demon hunter, I practiced the arcane arts. I still retain some of that knowledge, though the fel makes it all but impossible to use.

One thing I can still manage is the occasional glimpse into faraway places. You've seen me use the nether crucible to do this. I'm afraid that things don't look too good.

The forces that are arrayed against us are not limited to the Burning Legion. You must act quickly to keep the Broken Isles from being overwhelmed.
english.completion:
Я бы сказала, что ты $gпроделал:проделала; огромную работу на Расколотых островах.

Ты не перестаешь меня радовать, $n.
english.completed: Return to Allari the Souleater on the Fel Hammer.

text.title: 风暴峡湾
text.objectives: 在达拉然的紫罗兰城堡与空军上将罗杰斯谈一谈。
text.description:
幸好我们找到你了，$n！

空军上将罗杰斯传来口信，让你去达拉然见她。这听起来很重要。她就在紫罗兰城堡等你。

赶紧去把！
text.completion: It's an honor, $n.
text.giverTarget: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

english.title: Stormheim
english.objectives: Speak to Sky Admiral Rogers at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
english.description:
It is good we found you, $n!

Sky Admiral Rogers has sent word for you to meet her in Dalaran. It sounded important. She awaits your presence in the Violet Citadel.

Make haste!
english.completion: It's an honor, $n.

text.title: 风暴峡湾
text.objectives: 前往达拉然，在紫罗兰城堡与纳萨诺斯·凋零者谈一谈。
text.description:
幸好我们找到你了，$n！

黑暗女王的勇士，纳萨诺斯·凋零使者传来口信，让你去达拉然见他。这听起来很重要。他就在紫罗兰城堡等你。

赶紧去吧！
text.completion: <Nathanos glances over at you, pausing for a moment before acknowledging your presence.>$B$BYes?
text.giverTarget: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

english.title: Stormheim
english.objectives: Speak to Nathanos Blightcaller at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
english.description:
It is good we found you, $n!

Nathanos Blightcaller, Champion of the Banshee Queen herself, sent for you in Dalaran. He made it sound urgent. He should be waiting for you in the Violet Citadel.

Make haste!
english.completion: <Natanos takes a look at you and, after a pause, finally talks to you. >$B$BYeah?
