text.title: 登堂入室
text.objectives: 与欧库勒斯交谈并开始突袭。
text.description: 是时候了。瓦尔托伊会摧毁大殿突破口上的屏障。我会把你传送到突破口，攻下它的任务就靠你了。$b$b拿着这些传送宝珠。你需要支援时，可以用它们来召唤枯法者。$b$b趁他们还没建起新的防御工事，我们要马上出击。你准备好了就告诉我一声，我们就会开始行动。
text.completion: I must commend your knack for overcoming adversity. Take your time gathering your fellow champions, $n, but don't take TOO long!

english.title: Breaching the Sanctum
english.objectives: Speak with Oculeth to start the assault.
english.description: It is time. Valtrois is ready to destroy the barrier guarding the breach in the Sanctum. I will teleport you to the breach, then it falls on you to secure the area.$b$bTake these telemancy orbs. If you find you need support, use them to summon Withered.$b$bWe must strike before the enemy can ready new defenses. Let me know when you are ready and we will begin.
english.completion: Надо признать, твоя целеустремленность весьма впечатляет. Собери своих соратников, но не слишком задерживайся.

text.title: 行动的召唤
text.objectives: 去瓦狄斯丹找哈维。
text.description:
<渡鸦直视你的眼睛，熟悉的声音响彻你的脑海。>

勇士，我需要你的帮助。海拉终于出手了。

好好准备一下，然后来找我吧。
text.completion: It is good of you to come.
text.completed: 在瓦狄斯丹与哈维谈一谈。

english.title: A Call to Action
english.objectives: Find Havi at Valdisdall.
english.description:
<As the raven stares into your eyes, a familiar voice fills your mind.>

Champion, I require your aid. It seems Helya has shown her hand.

Steel yourself then come to me.
english.completion: Очень хорошо, что ты $gпришел:пришла;.

text.title: 海拉的远征
text.objectives: 搜查蔑潮港，寻找海拉军队的证据。
text.description:
如果海拉想在破碎群岛兴风作浪，我们也得有所回应。

到蔑潮港去，侦察一下她部队的动向。我倒要看看，海拉是不是真的蠢到想跟我作对。
text.completion: She has forced my hand...

english.title: Helya's Conquest
english.objectives: Search Tideskorn Harbor for evidence of Helya's forces.
english.description:
If Helya is making an advance on the Broken Isles, we will need to answer in turn.

Go to Tideskorn Harbor and scout her forces. We will see if Helya is foolish enough to begin her campaign against me.
english.completion: Она не оставляет мне выбора...

text.title: 幡然醒悟
text.objectives: 去永月平台见希尔格林。
text.description:
城里的气氛依然紧张，但今天，这样的环境对我们反而有利。

希尔格林要你去永月平台找他。看来，就连艾利桑德的军队也受不了她的疯狂，要开始叛逃了。

部队中出现了一个逃兵，他想加入我们的事业。

好好招待这人，$n。在这个黑暗的时代，朋友总是越多越好。
text.completion: Glad you could make it.

english.title: Disillusioned Defector
english.objectives: Meet Silgryn at Evermoon Terrace.
english.description:
The atmosphere in the city has improved little, but we may find this to our advantage today.

Silgryn asks for you at the Terrace. It seems even Elisande's forces are fleeing before her insanity.

A defector has risen from the ranks and seeks to join our cause.

See that this individual is well received, $n. We need all the friends we can get during these dark times.
english.completion: Рад видеть тебя.

text.title: 志同道合
text.objectives: 对暮色卫队征服者使用暮色百合徽记，找出5个暮色卫队逃兵。
text.description: 你好，外来者。$b$b我叫维多利亚。在艾利桑德维持着城内秩序时，我一直听命于她。为了大局，我与恶魔并肩作战，甚至还干过更坏的事。$b$b但残月酒馆的惨案说明，她已经不再关心夜之子的福祉。她在乎的只是个人地位。$b$b像我这样想的人还有不少。现在只需要有人向他们证明，我们还有其他出路。$b$b对我们来说，暮色百合并不陌生——把暮色百合的徽记拿给阿斯塔瓦港的卫兵看看吧。他们已经看够了艾利桑德的残暴行径。
text.completion: Hopefully more will follow their example.$B$BThank you for showing them another way to serve the Nightborne.

english.title: More Like Me
english.objectives: Use the Dusk Lily Sigil on Duskwatch Subjugators to identify 5 Deserters.
english.description: Greetings, Outlander.$b$bI am Victoire. I served Elisande while she maintained peace in the city. I fought beside demons and worse for the greater good.$b$bThe massacre at the Waning Crescent made it clear that she no longer serves the Nightborne. She serves only herself.$b$bThere are others who feel as I do. They simply need proof that there is another way.$b$bThe Dusk Lily is not unknown to us- try showing it to those now guarding Astravar Harbor. They have seen the worst of Elisande's cruelty.
english.completion: Надеюсь, за ними последуют и другие.$b$bСпасибо тебе за то, что $gпоказал:показала; им лучший способ помочь ночнорожденным.

text.title: 失踪人口
text.objectives: 从阿斯塔瓦港的恶魔身上获取一个军团联络器。
text.description: 这位新朋友还告诉了我们一个令人不安的消息。$b$b她说她看到大量披枷戴锁的市民被拖出了唤星者小屋。他们好像是被送去了阿斯塔瓦港。$b$b但被带走的市民一个都没有回来。更糟的是，那里如今已全是恶魔。$b$b我要你去搞清这些人的去向。潜入港口，尽量多收集一些情报。$b$b你可以拿那些燃烧军团的渣滓开刀，他们的尸体或许能给我们指明方向。
text.progress: Have you learned where the captives have been taken?
text.completion: <Silgryn stares grimly at the communicator.>

english.title: Missing Persons
english.objectives: Acquire a Legion Communicator from demons in Astravar Harbor.
english.description: Our new friend brings us some disturbing information.$b$bShe claims to have seen a large number of citizens dragged from Starcaller Retreat in chains. Their destination appears to be Astravar Harbor.$b$bThose taken to the harbor have yet to return, however. Worse yet, the area is now overrun with demons.$b$bI need you to find out where these people went. Infiltrate the harbor and gather any information you can.$b$bStart with the Legion filth- their corpses may point us in the right direction.
english.progress: Ты $gузнал:узнала;, куда демоны переправляют пленников?
english.completion: <Silgrin is grimly looking at the intercom. >

text.title: 人质危机
text.objectives: 前往阿斯塔瓦港，混入一队俘虏中，被送往邪魂堡垒。
text.description: 她居然把我们的同胞交给燃烧军团！$b$b要想中止这罪恶的交易，我们就得切断运输线路。你恐怕得扮演一下俘虏了，我的朋友。$b$b别急着质疑，有点信心。$b$b到时候，我们会藏在德琳的一条船上，紧紧跟在你后面。一旦搞清楚船只的去向，我们就救你出来。$b$b到阿斯塔瓦港去，找一队俘虏，混进他们中间，让人把你带走。$b$b记住，我们就在你身后。
text.completion: Thank you for taking this risk. Let us put an end to this now!

english.title: Hostage Situation
english.objectives: Go to Astravar Harbor and join a group of captives being taken to Felsoul Hold.
english.description: Our own people, sacrificed to the Legion!$b$bWe need to intercept a transport if we intend to put an end to this trade. I'm afraid this does mean you will be playing the part of a captive, my friend.$b$bBefore voicing your concerns, try to have a little faith.$b$bWe will follow behind in one of Deline's boats and break you out once we know where they are going.$b$bGo to the harbor and find a group of captives. Stand among them. Allow yourself to be taken.$b$bWe will not be far.
english.completion: Спасибо, что $gпошел:пошла; на этот риск. Пришло время положить этому конец!

text.title: 出卖灵魂
text.objectives: 消灭邪魂前哨的阿戈斯。
text.description: 我们会坚守阵地，你去把这个营地的恶魔首领找出来干掉。$b$b解决了阿戈斯也不能一劳永逸地终止这种拐卖人口的行为，但这或许能拖延他们的进度，给我们争取时间，想出其他办法来帮助这些人。$b$b快去吧。他就在山顶。
text.progress: Ты уже $gразобрался:разобралась; с Ааргоссом?
text.completion: Well done. Let us leave before they call in reinforcements.

english.title: In the Business of Souls
english.objectives: Slay Aargoss in Felsoul Advance.
english.description: We will hold our position here while you find and slay the demon responsible for this camp.$b$bEnding Aargoss will not permanently stop this smuggling operation, but it may slow them down long enough for us to find another way to help these people.$b$bGo quickly. He is somewhere atop this ridge.
english.progress: Ты уже $gразобрался:разобралась; с Ааргоссом?
english.completion: Отличная работа. Пора уходить, пока демоны не вызвали подкрепление.

text.title: 贩卖人口
text.objectives: 在邪魂前哨救出玛瑞贝丝和其他5名俘虏。
text.description: 求求你，救我出去！$b$b这些栅栏很脆弱，但我太虚弱了……$b$b还有其他人！这里还有好多人！求你救救我们！
text.completion: Thank you. We had no hope of rescue before you came along.

english.title: Smuggled!
english.objectives: Release Maribeth and 5 captives in Felsoul Advance.
english.description: Please get me out of here!$b$bThe bars are brittle but I am so weak...$b$bThe others! There are so many others! Please help us!
english.completion: Thank you. Before you arrived, we dared not hope for salvation.

text.title: 勇气试炼：奥丁的眷顾
text.objectives: 在勇气试炼团队副本中赢得奥丁的眷顾。
text.description:
该解决那个背叛我的女巫了。不知道你有没有能力给她最后一击，我得确认一下。

到英灵殿来见我，让我们来考验一下你的意志力。
text.completion: Now a greater task awaits you.

english.title: Trial of Valor: Odyn's Favor
english.objectives: Gain Odyn's favor within the Trial of Valor Raid.
english.description:
The time to deal with that treacherous witch has come. I suspect you may be the one to deal the final blow, but I must be certain.

See me in the Halls of Valor and we will test the strength of your will.
english.completion: Now a greater task awaits you.

objectiveDetails.description: 在勇气试炼团队副本击败奥丁

text.title: 腐蚀之力
text.objectives: 在逆风小径使用伪装，进入卡拉赞地下的密室，消灭塔祖尔和艾露萨拉·蔑暗。
text.description: 时机终于成熟了。$B$B卡拉赞地下蜿蜒的洞窟深处有座早已被人遗忘的大厅。根据我们的恶魔朋友提供的信息，我相信它的女主人就盘踞在那里。$B$B这只恶魔的主人一定是燃烧军团的高阶成员。这对卡拉赞可不是好消息。$B$B我们必须夺回逆风小径，$n。$B$B你得找到这个恶魔，然后干掉她。
text.completion: Our worst fears have been proven true, $n. The Legion's presence is deeply rooted in the tower.$B$BThe time has come. We must take back Karazhan!

english.title: The Power of Corruption
english.objectives: Use the disguise to gain access to the chamber, then slay Thar'zul and Elux'ara Darkscorn beneath Karazhan in Deadwind Pass.
english.description: The time has come at last.$B$BDeep within the cavernous underbelly of Karazhan lies a long-forgotten chamber. Based on what you learned from our demon friend, I believe this is where its mistress dwells.$B$BThis demon's master must come from the highest ranks of the Burning Legion. This does not bode well for Karazhan.$B$BWe need to secure Deadwind Pass, $n.$B$BYou must find this demon and destroy it.
english.completion: Наши худшие опасение подтвердились, $n. Легион прочно обосновался в башне.$B$BНельзя медлить. Мы должны отвоевать Каражан!

text.title: 历史的残片
text.objectives: 前往卡拉赞的会客间、宴会厅、仆役宿舍、歌剧院和展览馆收集灵魂残片。
text.description: 虽然你的首要目标是从军团手中夺回塔楼，但我还有……另一个请求。$b$b卡拉赞是魔法与历史交汇的地方。众所周知，昔日的片段会在这里化为实体，这些实体具有强大的力量。$b$b你在卡拉赞冒险的时候，记得留意那些回忆汇聚的地方。这些碎片可以提供宝贵的知识，让我们了解塔楼里到底发生了什么事。
text.progress: Тебе удалось найти фрагменты?
text.completion: For so long the secrets of the tower have remained hidden... I feel as if I have learned more about my former master.$B$BI am greatful we were able to see this journey through together, $n.

english.title: Fragments of the Past
english.objectives: Collect the Soul Fragments from the Guest Chambers, Banquet Hall, Servant Quarters, Opera Hall and the Menagerie inside Karazhan.
english.description: Though your primary objective is to liberate the tower from the Legion's hold, I have... another request.$b$bKarazhan is a place where magic and history intertwine. Moments of the past have been known to take physical form, and these forms can possess great power.$b$bAs you journey through Karazhan, watch for places where memories coalesce. These fragments could provide valuable insight into what's really going on inside that tower.
english.progress: Тебе удалось найти фрагменты?
english.completion: For so long the secrets of the tower have remained hidden... I feel as if I have learned more about my former master.$B$BI am greatful we were able to see this journey through together, $n.

text.title: 重返卡拉赞：眼魔眼里出……
text.objectives: 在卡拉赞击败监视者维兹艾德姆。
text.description: 军团的目的很明显。他们想掌握塔楼的魔法能量，与其他军团世界取得联系！$b$b我们的时间恐怕不多了，$n。你得登上塔顶，干掉那只怪物，否则就迟了！
text.completion: Your efforts today will not be forgotten, $n.$B$BThough the Legion's presence has left its mark on the Karazhan we once knew, I am certain the fate of the tower will not disappoint.

english.title: Return to Karazhan: In the Eye of the Beholder
english.objectives: Defeat Viz'aduum the Watcher in Karazhan.
english.description: The Legion's intentions are clear. They intend to harness the tower's magical energy to communicate with other Legion worlds!$B$BI'm afraid we haven't much time, $n. You must ascend the tower and destroy this monstrosity before it is too late!
english.completion: Your efforts today will not be forgotten, $n.$B$BThough the Legion's presence has left its mark on the Karazhan we once knew, I am certain the fate of the tower will not disappoint.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败监视者维兹艾德姆

text.title: 要塞大门
text.objectives: 前往阿斯塔瓦港，与精灵一起围攻暗夜要塞。
text.description:
我们的联军已经在王宫前摆开阵势，随时能够出击！我都不敢相信这一天真的到来了。

联军指挥官已经就位，我们也会加入你。去阿斯塔瓦港，与卡德加谈一谈。他正在协调进攻，至少我觉得他是。

我们到那里见……还有，谢谢你所做的一切。
text.completion: Thank you for saving me. It seems we underestimated Elisande's power.

english.title: Gates of the Nighthold
english.objectives: Go to Astravar Harbor and begin the siege of Nighthold with the elves.
english.description:
Our combined armies are arrayed in front of the palace, ready to strike! I cannot believe the time has come.

Your allied commanders are already there and we will join you. Make your way to Astravar Harbor and speak with Khadgar. He is coordinating the attack, or at least I think he is.

See you there... and thanks for everything.
english.completion: Спасибо, что $gспас:спасла; меня. Похоже, мы недооценили мощь Элисанды.

objectiveDetails.description: 在阿斯塔瓦港与卡德加谈一谈

text.title: 海拉加尔登陆战：灰色浅滩
精灵的实力
text.objectives: 带领精灵大军前往阿斯塔瓦港。
text.description: 塔莉萨居然让她们三个达成了一致？她的口才真是出众。$b$b好了，英雄。莉亚德琳已经向苏拉玛进发了，去加入她的部队吧。泰兰德会包抄城卫军的侧翼，在城内与你汇合。$b$b夜之子负责殿后，帮我们巩固阵地。$b$b我和欧库勒斯会把肯瑞托的部队转移到阿斯塔瓦港。如果走运的话，我们在另一边见。
text.completion: The telemancy traps you placed prior to the battle are doing wonders for reducing our losses.

english.title: Full Might of the Elves
english.objectives: Lead the elven army to Astravar Harbor.
english.description: Thalyssra managed to get all 3 to agree to the same thing? I am impressed with her skills of negotiation.$b$bAlright hero, Liadrin is already marching on Suramar. Join her forces.$b$bTyrande will flank the city defenders and meet you deeper in.$b$bThe Nightborne will bring up the rear and hold the territory for us.$b$bOculeth and I will move the Kirin Tor forces to Astravar Harbor. With luck, we shall see you on the other side.
english.completion: Телемантические ловушки, которые ты $gрасставил:расставила; перед боем, значительно сократили наши потери.

text.title: 全力备战
text.objectives: 把计划交给温蕾萨·风行者、女伯爵莉亚德琳和泰兰德·语风。
text.description: 多亏你的帮助，以及我们这支新军的努力，堕夜精灵终于做好战斗准备了。$b$b而且，我们还成功疏散了从这里到阿斯塔瓦港的几乎全部市民。我起草了一个作战计划，让我们的联军穿过城区，占领港口。$b$b请你把计划交给温蕾萨、泰兰德和莉亚德琳，好吗？
text.completion: Well, with these plans and a little luck, we might be able to get through this with far less collateral damage than I would have expected.

english.title: Ready for Battle
english.objectives: Deliver plans to Vereesa Windrunner, Lady Liadrin and Tyrande Whisperwind.
english.description: Thanks to your efforts and a lot of effort on the part of our new army, the Nightfallen are prepared for battle.$b$bWhat is more, we have managed to evacuate nearly all of the civilians between here and Astravar Harbor.$b$bI have drafted plans that can lead our combined forces through the city and take the harbor.$b$bCan you deliver these plans to Vereesa, Tyrande and Liadrin?
english.completion: With any luck, these plans will allow us to make far fewer sacrifices than expected.

objectiveDetails.description: 与女伯爵莉亚德琳交谈

text.title: 中转站
text.objectives: 激活阿斯塔瓦港的道标。
text.description: 你和我们的盟友在城里打通了一条走道，真了不起。虽然要守住它并不容易，但它就像是插进艾利桑德大军中的一根楔子。$b$b欧库勒斯正忙着把传送道标转移过来，但他想把激活它们的荣耀交给你。
text.completion: Well done, hero. With this as our staging ground, our forces have a clear shot at the city gates.$B$BThalyssra has ordered her rebels to secure our location and cover our rear flank.$B$BOnce we have our siege vehicles in place we should be ready to assault the city.

english.title: Staging Point
english.objectives: Activate the Astravar Beacon.
english.description: That is quite a corridor you and our allies have punched through the city. It will be difficult to hold but it will cut a wedge in Elisande's forces.$b$bOculeth has been busy redirecting a telemancy beacon to this location but wanted to give you the honor of activating it.
english.completion: Отлично, $gгерой:воительница;. Используя этот плацдарм, мы легко сможем обстрелять городские ворота.$b$bТалисра приказала своим мятежникам зачистить территорию и охранять наш тыл.$b$bКогда осадные орудия займут позиции, мы сможем начать штурм.

text.title: 重返卡拉赞：背包大爆炸
text.objectives: 在卡拉赞找到一个千袋之袋和一个邪筋背包。
text.description: $n，你肯定听过这种说法，那就是背包越大越好。但我不同意。我觉得背包的质量才是最重要的。$b$b看看你这身破烂。它们让你整个人都显得……那么廉价。$b$b我可以证明给你看。据说，卡拉赞有一种背包，能够容纳几乎无穷无尽的物品。但是制作这些背包所使用的材料……呃，你会知道的。
text.progress: After this lesson, I trust I won't have to prove anything further to you.
text.completion: Now, look closely.$B$B<Tytallo goes into a lengthy explanation concerning the thread count, weaving techniques, and other miscellaneous details that, to a tailor, are fascinating.>$B$BYou still seem confused. Here, take the pattern and see for yourself. Perhaps then you'll learn a thing or two.

english.title: Return to Karazhan: The Big Bag Theory
english.objectives: Recover a Bag of a Thousand Pockets and a Fel Sinew Bag from Karazhan.
english.description: I'm sure you've heard, $n, that a bigger bag is always better. I disagree. I believe it's the quality of the bag that makes all the difference.$b$bJust look at those tattered things around your person. They make you look... well, quite plain.$b$bI'll prove it to you. Allegedly there are some bags in Karazhan that hold an almost infinite amount of items, but the materials required to make such bags are... well, you'll see.
english.progress: After this lesson, I trust I won't have to prove anything further to you.
english.completion: Now, look closely.$B$B<Tytallo goes into a lengthy explanation concerning the thread count, weaving techniques, and other miscellaneous details that, to a tailor, are fascinating.>$B$BYou still seem confused. Here, take the pattern and see for yourself. Perhaps then you'll learn a thing or two.

text.title: 酒馆老板的命运
text.objectives: 跟随塔莉萨前往月郡庄园，了解凡瑟尔的命运。
text.description: 我终于破解了莉莉丝的信息。$b$b我想让你和我一起去她的庄园。我已经很久没有回过城里了。
text.progress: Такие мрачные новости надо сообщить как можно скорее.
text.completion: We need to take action immediately!

english.title: Tavernkeeper's Fate
english.objectives: Follow Thalyssra to the Lunastre Estate and learn of Vanthir's fate.
english.description: I have finished unraveling Ly'leth's message.$b$bI want you to come with me to her estate. It is long past time I returned to the city.
english.progress: Такие мрачные новости надо сообщить как можно скорее.
english.completion: Нужно действовать, и как можно скорее!

objectiveDetails.description: 使用传送门前往月郡庄园

text.title: 泰兰德的要求
text.objectives: 与梅瑞戴尔的泰兰德·语风谈一谈。
text.description: 沙尔艾兰已经挤满了难民和起义军。我们算是建起了自己的军队，但却没有足够的武器来武装他们，也没有足够的魔力来防止他们变成枯法者。$b$b在这种时候，泰兰德还来雪上加霜，提出一大串的要求，我根本就没有时间去应付。$b$b你去帮她看看，好吗？她驻扎在梅瑞戴尔的部队还在不断壮大，很容易找到的。
text.completion: The Nightfallen insisted on being a part in this conflict. There is more work to be done than people we have.

english.title: Tyrande's Command
english.objectives: Speak with Tyrande Whisperwind in Meredil.
english.description: Shal'aran is bursting at the seams with refugees and rebels. We practically have an army now but not enough weapons or mana to keep everyone armed and un-withered.$b$bAnd in all of this, Tyrande has a battery of requests I simply do not have the time to deal with.$b$bWill you go to her? Her growing army is hard to miss in Meredil.
english.completion: The Nightfallen insisted on being a part in this conflict. There is more work to be done than people we have.

objectiveDetails.description: 守护魔力酒的分发过程

text.title: 三角测量
text.objectives: 帮助塔莉萨收集3个凡瑟尔的奥术精华。
text.description: 凡瑟尔……杀一儆百！难怪艾利桑德把他关了这么久。$b$b我们得赶快行动。我有办法找到他，但这得先找到他的奥术精华最强烈的地方。$b$b这可不容易，毕竟这座城市的历史太过悠久。可如果运气好的话，我们或许能找到几处对他来说非常重要的地方，那些地方就会有他留下的精华。$b$b我们从大步道开始找吧——他经常去那里做生意。
text.completion: All that remains is to focus on his essence to isolate his location. Good work.

english.title: Essence Triangulation
english.objectives: Help Thalyssra collect 3 of Vanthir's Arcane Essences.
english.description: Vanthir... an example! That certainly explains why Elisande chose to hold him this long.$b$bWe need to move quickly. I can track him, but I will need to find places where his Arcane Essence is strongest.$b$bThis will not be an easy feat, not in a city this old, but with any luck there are a few places important enough to him that he left a little bit of himself behind.$b$bWe should start in the promenade- he often visited it for business.
english.completion: Остается только сконцентрироваться на сущности, чтобы определить его местоположение. Отлично.

objectiveDetails.description: 听取大步道北部的对话

text.title: 公开处刑
text.objectives: 帮助塔莉萨完成占卜仪式。
text.description: 我已经从众多苏拉玛市民的精华中分辨出了凡瑟尔的，这样或许就能找到他的确切位置了。$b$b你应该还记得吧，我之前对我们的朋友泰林用过类似的仪式。别担心，这次不会那么吓人了……但愿吧。$b$b来吧，我们一起找出酒馆老板的下落。
text.completion: That was... difficult... but I am glad we succeeded.

english.title: On Public Display
english.objectives: Help Thalyssra complete the Scrying Ritual.
english.description: Now that I have identified Vanthir's essence from the multitude of Suramar's citizens, it may be that I can find his exact location.$b$bI believe you'll recall a similar ritual with our friend Theryn. Do not worry- there will be less screaming this time. Hopefully.$b$bCome. Let us find our missing tavernkeeper.
english.completion: Это было... сложно... но я рада, что у нас получилось.

text.title: 残月渐圆
text.objectives: 救出凡瑟尔，并给他一颗阿坎多尔的果实。
text.description: 我认识抓捕他的人。他是奥鲁瑞尔的副官之一，也是个厉害的魔剑士。你需要希尔格林的帮助，才有可能拿到凡瑟尔的牢房钥匙。$b$b我们的朋友已经命悬一线了。就算我们把他从刽子手手里救出来，恐怕也来不及阻止他变成枯法者了。$b$b我要你带一颗阿坎多尔的果实给他。这种果实很珍贵，数量稀少，但这是凡瑟尔唯一的机会了。$b$b快去吧，祝你好运。
text.progress: <Vanthir shudders violently and stares blankly ahead. He does not seem to be aware of your presence.>
text.completion: <Vanthir's hands dart up to snatch the fruit from your grasp.>

english.title: Waxing Crescent
english.objectives: Rescue Vanthir and give him an Arcan'dor fruit.
english.description: His captor is familiar to me. He is one of Aluriel's lieutenants and a skilled spell-fencer at that. You will need Silgryn's help to retrieve the key to Vanthir's prison.$b$bOur friend's life hangs in the balance. Even if we manage to wrestle him from the executioner's grasp, he may well Wither before we can act.$b$bI need you to take an Arcan'dor fruit to him. They are precious, and few, but for Vanthir this is the only chance he has.$b$bGo quickly, and good luck.
english.progress: <Vantir shudders and stares blankly forward. He does not seem to notice your presence.>
english.completion: < With a swift movement, Wantyre rips the fruit out of your hands. >

text.title: 暮色百合徽记
text.objectives: 将暮色百合徽记放到凡瑟尔的牢笼上。
text.description: 真是……太惊人了！$b$b我好久没有这么清醒过了。$b$b我还是很虚弱……我得休息一下。但首先……$b$b<凡瑟尔用颤抖的手指了指笼子顶部。>$b$b让他们看看，今天的胜利者是暮色百合。
text.completion: I will see that he is made comfortable next chance I get. We made a great stride forward today, $n.$B$BElisande will not soon forget that we do not simply abandon our own.

english.title: Sign of the Dusk Lily
english.objectives: Place a Dusk Lily Sigil above Vanthir's Cage.
english.description: Simply... astounding.$b$bI have not felt this clear of mind in so long.$b$bI am still weak... I need to rest. But first...$b$b<Vanthir gestures to the top of his cage with a trembling hand.>$b$bShow them that the Dusk Lily triumphs this day.
english.completion: Я при первой же возможности помогу ему обустроиться. Сегодня мы добились больших успехов, $n.$b$bТеперь Элисанда знает, что мы своих не бросаем.

text.title: 邪能火药箱
text.objectives: 消灭神枪手派瑞克丝，获得灌注邪能的火药箱。
text.description: 我们来这儿其实是为了一箱火药。那箱玩意好像灌注了某种邪能……所以极其火爆。它目前就在这里的一个海盗头子手上。$b$b神枪手派瑞克丝应该就在海湾后头的沙滩上。把我们想要的东西从她手上抢过来吧。
text.progress: Did you get the gunpowder?
text.completion: This gunpowder is the key to my plan. Right good work retrieving it.

english.title: What's the Cache?
english.objectives: Kill Master Gunner Prix and obtain the Fel-Infused Gunpowder Cache.
english.description: We're here for a cache of gunpowder. It seems to have been infused with some sort of fel power... it's extremely reactive. One of the leaders of the pirate forces here currently has it.$b$bMaster Gunner Prix should be toward the back of the cove, near the water. Take what we need from her.
english.progress: Did you get the gunpowder?
english.completion: This gunpowder is the key to my plan. Right good work retrieving it.

text.title: 恶魔伪装
text.objectives: 在逆风小径与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description: 你刚才忙着对那只恶魔……施展魔法的时候，我设法用这些腐化精华蒸馏出了更纯粹，更容易控制的物质。$B$B我已经跟卡德加说了，等他检查过这种合剂后，就可以提供给你。但是我得提醒你——这些精华非常强大，如果不小心处理，就会造成危险。$B$B你准备好了就跟卡德加说一声。
text.completion: The samples have proven to be quite helpful along with your... influence.

english.title: Demon in Disguise
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar in Deadwind Pass.
english.description: While you were... working your magic on that demon, I was able to make headway in distilling the corrupted essences down to a simpler, more manageable form.$B$BI've asked Khadgar to provide you with the concoction once he's had a look, but I must remind you - these essences are quite potent, often dangerous if not handled with the utmost of care.$B$BSpeak with Khadgar when you are ready to begin.
english.completion: Образцы оказались весьма полезными – так же, как и твои... навыки дознавателя.

text.title: 后备方案
text.objectives: 与大法师卡雷谈一谈。
text.description:
达拉然看似只是一座浮空城，但它其实是我们最强大的魔法武器。修复奥术防御工事需要时间——但燃烧军团不会放过这个大好机会的。

在维修期间，我们必须想个过渡计划，而且要快！

大法师卡雷对这种事情非常在行。也许你应该跟他商量一下？
text.completion: Hmm. An interesting challenge!

english.title: Backup Plan
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Kalec.
english.description:
Dalaran may appear to be just a floating city, but it is actually our most powerful magical weapon. It will take time to repair the arcane defenses - time the Legion will use to their great advantage.

It is imperative to come up with an interim plan, and quickly! 

Archmage Kalec is very knowledgeable about this sort of thing. Perhaps you should consult with him?
english.completion: Хм... Как интересно!

text.title: 来自星界的邀请
text.objectives: 在宠物对战中击败观测者奥尔加隆。
text.description: 你好，凡人。$B$B多年来，我一直都在观察这颗星球。奥杜尔的殿堂空虚沉寂，只有黑暗中偶尔传出的窃窃私语。我实在是无聊透了！$B$B所以，我也开始尝试你们非常热衷的“宠物对战”。这真是极好的消遣，够我玩好几百年了！$B$B我一直在各大星球上搜寻具有宇宙之力的小家伙，逐步壮大我的宠物队伍。来吧，我们再战一回！
text.completion: Ah, quite the breath of fresh solar winds. Take this, my favorite constellation, may it remind you of the watchers that watch over us all.

english.title: A Celestial Invitation
english.objectives: Defeat Algalon the Observer in a pet battle.
english.description: Greetings, mortal.$B$BFor many years I have continued my observation of this planet. The halls of Ulduar have been hollow and silent, save for the occasional clattering whisper from the darkness. I grew so very bored of it!$B$BThus, I have taken up this "pet battling" you seem so fond of. Truly, an amusing pastime that will sustain my mind for many centuries!$B$BI have been amassing my collection, scouring the stars for tiny beings of cosmic power. Come, let us do battle once more!
english.completion: Ah, quite the breath of fresh solar winds. Take this, my favorite constellation, may it remind you of the watchers that watch over us all.

text.title: 奈耶尔的工作室
text.objectives: 消灭大技师柰耶尔。
text.description:
根据我打听来的情报，这就是大技师奈耶尔的工作室。他制作构造体的技术无与伦比！

可惜他投靠了军团。我真不想干掉这样一位名匠，但我们别无选择。

如果你走运的话，他身边可能还会有一个备用的护盾发生器。
text.progress: Were you successful?
text.completion: That is one less Legion supporter we need to worry about. Oh, and you found a shield generator too? Wonderful!

english.title: Nyell's Workshop
english.objectives: Kill Master Artificer Nyell.
english.description:
From what I've overheard, this is Master Artificer Nyell's workshop. His skills in construct creation are unparalleled! 

What a shame that he swore fealty to the Legion. I hate to destroy such a renowned craftsman, but we have no choice.

If you are lucky, he might even have a spare shield generator sitting around.
english.progress: Is it done?
english.completion: Одним приспешником Легиона меньше. О, ты и генератор щита $gнашел:нашла;? Чудесно!

text.title: 夏多雷的奥秘
text.objectives: 收集8个古代夏多雷卷轴。
text.description:
这个工作室里有一座大型图书馆，里面收藏着大量的珍贵卷轴，全都是由我的同胞所著。信息分享可以让大家都受益，你觉得呢？

如果我们把这座知识的宝库搬回提瑞斯秘法会，我和我的同胞在那里的地位一定会有所提高……

请尽量多拿一些。
text.progress: Have you found some scrolls?
text.completion: Few texts written by the ancient shal'dorei remain. I am sure the Tirisgarde's librarians will be thrilled with these!

english.title: Secrets of the Shal'dorei
english.objectives: Gather 8 Ancient Shal'dorei Scrolls.
english.description:
This workshop includes an extensive library of rare scrolls written by my people. We all benefit by sharing information, do you not agree? 

Perhaps if we bring back such a treasure trove the Tirisgarde will be more welcoming towards me and my kind...

Please gather whatever you can.
english.progress: Ты $gнашел:нашла; свитки?
english.completion: There are very few ancient texts written by the Shal'dorai. The librarians of the Tirisphalus Sentinels will surely be pleased with our discovery!

text.title: 山雨欲来
text.objectives: 给哈维倒酒。
text.description:
我该告诉你另外一段故事了。我讲的时候，麻烦你给我倒点烈酒好吗？我快渴死了。

这个酒桶太旧了，酒流得太慢。
text.completion: Delicious, thank you.$B$BBefore we act, we must gather more information onto what Helya is planning.

english.title: A Threat Rises
english.objectives: Pour Havi some grog.
english.description:
It is time I told you another tale. While you listen, would you be so kind as to pour me some grog? I've grown a terrible thirst.

The keg is very old and the tap is a bit slow.
english.completion: Чудно, благодарю.$B$BПрежде всего нам необходимо больше разузнать о планах Хелии.

text.title: 白骨峰
text.objectives: 跟鬼翼谈一谈，飞往托里姆峰，然后与米妮瓦见面。
text.description: 你不在的时候，我们制定了使用挽具的策略。我们可以利用它的力量，将死去幼龙的灵魂与你自己绑定，将它们复活成你的忠实士兵。$b$b我已经派米妮瓦前往风暴峡湾的托里姆峰，她在那里找到了一窝死去的托林尼尔幼龙。它们是绝佳的目标。$b$b去跟鬼翼谈谈，飞往托里姆峰，米妮瓦会把详情告诉你的。
text.completion: Finally you're here, Deathlord. I've been waiting so long I could've died again.

english.title: The Peak of Bones
english.objectives: Speak to Grimwing for a flight to Thorim's Peak, then meet Minerva.
english.description: While you were gone, we strategized what to do with the harness. We can utilize its power to bind the spirits of deceased drakes to you, raising them under your will as loyal soldiers.$b$bI sent Minerva to Thorim's Peak in Stormheim, where she has found a brood of deceased Thorignir. They will be prime targets.$b$bSpeak to Grimwing for a flight to the mountain, then Minerva will fill you in.
english.completion: Ну наконец-то, |3-6($ct). Я тут чуть снова не умерла, тебя дожидаясь.

text.title: The Council's Call
text.objectives: Seek out the Council of Six in the Violet Citadel.
text.description: <The Council of Six has sought your aid against a 'great threat'.>$B$B<If they have turned their focus on something outside of the demon hordes pouring out of the Tomb of Sargeras, it must be truly dangerous.>$B$B<But how does the object you found on the Broken Shore fit into all of this? You know only that the Council awaits at the Violet Citadel.>
text.end: Seek out the Council of Six.

english.title: The Council's Call
english.objectives: Seek out the Council of Six in the Violet Citadel.
english.description: <The Council of Six has sought your aid against a 'great threat'.>$B$B<If they have turned their focus on something outside of the demon hordes pouring out of the Tomb of Sargeras, it must be truly dangerous.>$B$B<But how does the object you found on the Broken Shore fit into all of this? You know only that the Council awaits at the Violet Citadel.>
english.end: Seek out the Council of Six.

text.title: 秘而不宣
text.objectives: 在紫罗兰城堡上方的紫色天台与六人议会会合。
text.description: 光靠军队冲锋陷阵是赢不了战争的，$ct。$b$b有时候，由单人执行的、默默无闻的战斗才是最重要的。所以说——$b$b<卡德加微微皱了皱眉。>$b$b我们还是到更隐蔽的地方讨论这件事比较好。我们去上面的紫色天台吧，怎么样？
text.completion: Don't worry, she'll be alright.$B$BWhatever demon did this to her didn't hang around long enough to finish the job.
text.end: 在紫色天台与六人议会会合。

english.title: Away From Prying Eyes
english.objectives: Join the Council of Six in the Purple Parlor above the Violet Citadel.
english.description: Wars are not won solely with armies charging bravely across the battlefield, $ct.$B$BSometimes, it is the actions of individuals that matter most, fighting battles few ever hear about. That is why - $B$B<Khadgar furrows his brow slightly.>$B$BWe should really discuss this somewhere a tad more private. Let's move up to the Purple Parlor, shall we?
english.completion: Не волнуйся, с ней все будет в порядке.$B$BЧто за демон бы это ни сделал, он умер раньше, чем смог завершить начатое.
english.end: Join the Council of Six in the Purple Parlor.

text.title: 涅槃重生
text.objectives: 在托里姆峰复活$1oa只死去的托林尼尔幼龙。
text.description: 好了，我们的任务是控制龙母。但要我说的话，如果能再加上几条幼龙就更好了，对吧？$b$b既然我们都来了，何不利用我们强大的亡灵之力复活几只她的后裔呢？虽然这座山峰已经将它们的尸体冻成了坚冰，但它们肯定更愿意投入亡灵之力的怀抱。我们必须找到它们冰冻的尸体，将你的意志灌注进去。
text.completion: I could feel their energy, even in undeath.

english.title: From Bones They Rise
english.objectives: Revive $1oa Deceased Thorignir in Thorim's Peak.
english.description: Alright, the job is to get the broodmother under our control. But hear me out. A few more drakes would be a boon, right?$b$bWhile we're here, why don't we use our awesome power over undeath to raise some of her brood as well? Although the peak has claimed their corpses for the ice, I'm sure the embrace of undeath will be much more welcoming. We must find their frozen corpses and breathe your will into them.
english.completion: Я чувствую их энергию, хоть они и мертвы.

objectiveDetails.description: 复活死去的托林尼尔幼龙

text.title: 白骨龙母
text.objectives: 在托里姆峰点燃托里姆之火，召唤多米尔。击败她后将其复活。
text.description: 是时候了，该召唤龙母了。她才是我们来此的目的。她强大的意志和力量足以让她傲视托里姆峰，看护她剩余的子嗣。托林尼尔巨龙虽然是壮丽的生物，我还是希望自己的巨龙能骨感一点，所以得先让她死去。$b$b还记得我们见面处的那个火堆吗？她守护着那里，就像刚才峰顶那个鬼魂一样。只要点燃火堆，她就会现身。
text.completion: That was quite the entrance, Deathlord.

english.title: The Bonemother
english.objectives: Light Thorim's Beacon at Thorim's Peak to raise Daumyr. Defeat her and raise her from death.
english.description: It's time to call the mother, the true reason we came. She is strong, her sheer will and strength allowing her to face this peak in order to watch over the remains of her brood. While the Thorignir is a grand sight, I like my dragons a little more bony. She must die first.$b$bRemember the pyre where we met? She is its guardian, as the spirit was at the peak. If we light it, she will come.
english.completion: Impressive return, |3-6($ct).

objectiveDetails.description: 骑乘多米尔前往阿彻鲁斯

text.title: 悉心研究：阿苏纳物种学

objectiveDetails.description: 把书放到塞索尼的讲台上
把书放到塞索尼的讲台上
把书放到塞索尼的讲台上

text.title: 负隅顽抗
text.objectives: 前往黑鸦堡垒上空侦察恶魔的动向。
text.description:
燃烧军团的地面部队被削弱了，但他们又调集了增援部队进行反击。

我们的盟友发现，有些恶魔盘踞在黑鸦堡垒上空。我担心他们是想建立据点。

乘上这只角鹰兽，去侦察一下城墙。如果我担心的情况属实，我希望你能迅速消除这个威胁。
text.completion: Our victory here is well deserved. With their forces subdued we can press our attacks to the forward camp and the monstrosity on the horizon.

english.title: Holding the Ramparts
english.objectives: Scout the demonic presence atop Black Rook Hold.
english.description:
With their ground presence weakened the Legion has retaliated with additional forces.

Our allies managed to track several of these demons to the skies above Black Rook. I fear they intend to establish a foothold.

Take this hippogryph and scout the ramparts. Should this fear become a reality I ask that you deal with the threat swiftly.
english.completion: Мы полностью заслужили эту победу. Теперь мы сможем сосредоточиться на передовом лагере и чудовище, что маячит на горизонте.

objectiveDetails.description: 向黑鸦堡垒平台上方的加洛德·影歌报到

text.title: 魔火试练
text.objectives: 前往梅瑞戴尔消灭洛兹勒斯。
text.description:
我们没多少时间了。我接到报告说，有个深渊领主来到了梅瑞戴尔。

我已经派出了一支突击队。我们不能让这只恶魔攻击我们驻扎在此的军队侧翼，也不能让他找到沙尔艾兰。这些新兵也该通过实战好好锤炼一下了。

请与我们在梅瑞戴尔的部队汇合，迎战那只恶魔。还有，别让这支新生的部队首次上阵就打败仗。
text.completion: Well done. Sometimes a single victory is enough to bring an army together. With time, these recruits shall train others, and we can grow our army to many times this size.

english.title: Trial by Demonfire
english.objectives: Slay Rozzeleth in Meredil.
english.description:
We are out of time. I have reports that a pitlord has come to Meredil. 

I have dispatched a strike force. We cannot let this demon flank our army here, nor can we let him find Shal'Aran. It is time to temper these recruits in a real battle.

Join our forces in Meredil, engage the demon, and help us ensure this new army of ours is not lost in its first conflict.
english.completion: Отличная работа. Иногда достаточно одной победы, чтобы сплотить армию. Со временем эти новобранцы начнут учить других, и наша армия сможет вырасти многократно.
english.giverWindow: He seeks to crush the rebellion.

text.title: 违背玛加萨的意志
text.objectives: 与玛加萨·恐怖图腾谈一谈，然后把末日石交给预言者努波顿。
text.description: 嗯？你还在等什么？快把末日石交出来。
text.completion: The Doomstone! I thought it legend, but here it is before me$B$BCan you feel its power radiating? We must only use it in times of utmost need; its power has a heavy price.$B$BYou were right not to give it to Magatha. It could do much harm in her hands.$B$BI trust you to keep it safe while we prepare an appropriate home for it.

english.title: Against Magatha's Will
english.objectives: Talk to Magatha Grimtotem, then bring the Doomstone to Farseer Nobundo.
english.description: Well? What are you waiting for? Hand over the Doomstone.
english.completion: Камень Рока! Я уж думал, что это лишь легенда, но вот он, передо мной.$b$bЧувствуешь, какую силу он излучает? Но прибегать к его помощи надлежит только в час крайней нужды. Его сила имеет свою цену – и немалую.$b$bТы верно $gпоступил:поступила;, что не $gотдал:отдала; его Магате. В ее руках Камень принес бы немало зла.$b$bЯ хочу вверить Камень Рока тебе на хранение, пока мы не найдем ему подходящее пристанище.

text.title: 重返卡拉赞：一家之主
text.objectives: 收集清单上的物品，并将其带到卡拉赞外的墓地里。
text.description:
怀表里有张陈旧的纸条。

“下次宴会将在摩根墓场举行，这一定会成为热门话题！光临的嘉宾如下：

费伦斯伯爵，钟情陈年红酒。
米尔斯迪普女伯爵，无奶酪不欢。真是怪女人。
德鲁格尔男爵，胃口不小，给肉块撒上香料，就足以款待他了。

跟往常一样，如果有需要，我会摇铃叫你的。

——麦迪文”
text.progress: What do you have there?
text.completion: Wonderful, you brought dinner! Moroes was worried he would let his master down.

english.title: Return to Karazhan: Master of the House
english.objectives: Collect the listed items and bring them to the cemetery outside Karazhan.
english.description:
Inside the pocket watch is a worn note.

"The next affair will take place in Morgan's Plot, it will cause quite a stir! The following guests will be in attendance:

Lord Ference, his preferred vintage is red.
Baroness Millstipe, she will only attend on the promise of cheese. Strange woman.
Baron Dreuger, a ravenous soul, any well spiced meat should keep him happy.

As always, I shall ring the bell should I need you.

- Medivh"
english.progress: What do you have there?
english.completion: Wonderful, you brought dinner! Moroes was worried he would let his master down.

text.title: 残月避难所
text.objectives: 乘坐德琳的贡多拉离开邪魂前哨。
text.description: 我们在这里能做的都已经做了。$b$b趁现在，把所有人都送上船并抓紧离开吧。$b$b我们为其他人争取了时间，但是也只能这样了。
text.completion: These people owe their lives to your bravery. They will not forget the risks we have taken for them.

english.title: Waning Refuge
english.objectives: Leave Felsoul Advance on Deline's Gondola.
english.description: We have done all we can here.$b$bLet us get everyone into the boat and get out while we still can.$b$bWe have bought time for the others but nothing more.
english.completion: Эти горожане обязаны тебе жизнью. Они не забудут о том, как нам пришлось рисковать ради них.

objectiveDetails.description: 暴露在动荡邪能中的枯法者

text.title: 十万火急
text.objectives: 在紫色天台听取六人议会的看法。
text.description:
你带来的坏消息让议会一直以来就有的忧虑变得更深了。

我知道萨格拉斯之墓的局面已经让你应接不暇了。不要误会，攻打墓穴依然是我们的首要任务；但我们也不能想当然地认为燃烧军团会蠢到只依赖蛮力。他们的阴谋远不止如此。

请听我们说几句吧。
text.completion: So what do you say? Up for a challenge?

english.title: In Dire Need
english.objectives: Hear out the Council of Six in the Purple Parlor.
english.description:
The ill tidings you bear only increase the concerns the Council has been having.

I know you have your hands full with the Tomb of Sargeras. Make no mistake, the battle for the tomb remains our top priority--but we must not think the Legion foolish enough to rely on brute force alone. They are far more cunning than that.

Please, hear us out.
english.completion: Ну, что скажешь? $gГотов:Готова; к испытанию?

text.title: 时空调查
text.objectives: 和卡德加一起调查艾利桑德的时间法术。
text.description:
我早知道夏多雷在研究时间魔法，但这简直不可思议……

艾利桑德把我们的整支军队的时间都停住了！

来吧，我们来调查一下。或许有办法破解这个法术——至少能发现夜之子维持这个法术的秘密。
text.completion: We got lucky that time, but trying again could risk all our lives for nothing. We must find another way.

english.title: Temporal Investigations
english.objectives: Investigate Elisande's time spell with Khadgar.
english.description:
I knew the shal'dorei dabbled in time magic, but this is simply incredible...

Elisande stopped time on our entire army!

Come, let us investigate. Perhaps there is a way to break the spell - or at least discover how it is being maintained.
english.completion: We're lucky this time, but it's just pointless to take that risk again. We have to find another way.

objectiveDetails.description: 帮助卡德加调查时空谜锁。

text.title: Wisp in the Willows
text.objectives: Guide the Wisp through the Hidden Pools to grow $2oa trees.
text.description: Wisps are the spirits of our Night elven brethren who have become one with the forest. But their minds and the way they perceive things are very different than in life.$b$bYou should bond with this little one. See through its eyes as it travels to the hidden pools and grows some trees.

english.title: Wisp in the Willows
english.objectives: Guide the Wisp through the Hidden Pools to grow $2oa trees.
english.description: Wisps are the spirits of our Night elven brethren who have become one with the forest. But their minds and the way they perceive things are very different than in life.$b$bYou should bond with this little one. See through its eyes as it travels to the hidden pools and grows some trees.

text.title: 全民皆兵
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉的黑鸦堡垒击败$1oa个拉文凯斯的士兵。
text.description: 我好不容易才让这些平民排出整齐的队列。$b$b他们没受过训练，自由散漫，也没有武器。$b$b可他们还得准备上阵厮杀。$b$b卡德加建议我们去瓦尔莎拉的黑鸦堡垒进行实地训练。拉文凯斯领主的幽灵军队显然还记得怎么战斗。$b$b去吧，英雄，我会派些新兵去支援你的。
text.completion: The trainees you helped cannot seem to stop talking about your fighting prowess. Already they are passing along what you taught them.$B$BI appreciate your help in this.

english.title: Citizens' Army
english.objectives: Defeat $1oa of Ravencrest's forces at Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.
english.description: I can barely get these civilians to stand in a straight line.$b$bThey are untrained, undisciplined, and underarmed.$b$bStill, they need to be ready for the real battle.$b$BKhadgar suggested we try some field training at the ruins of Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah. The risen forces of Lord Ravencrest apparently remember how to fight.$b$bGo, hero, and I will send some trainees to support you.
english.completion: Новобранцы под сильным впечатлением от твоего мастерства. Они хорошо усвоили твои уроки.$b$bБлагодарю тебя за помощь.

text.title: 急需武器
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉的黑鸦堡垒找到$1oa个武器箱。
text.description: 许多起义军的成员都想在即将到来的大战中出力。我们的人民有战斗的意愿，他们缺的只是战斗的能力。$b$b他们需要武器。$b$b卡德加告诉过我，黑鸦堡垒有许多军备，我们可以拿来使用。$b$b到黑鸦堡垒去，把这些道标放在武器箱上。放好后，我就可以把它们传送回来。
text.completion: These weapons should prove quite useful in the coming conflict. Well done, hero.

english.title: We Need Weapons
english.objectives: Recover $1oa Weapon Caches at Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.
english.description: So many of the rebels want to help in the coming battle. Our people have the will, they lack only the means.$b$bThey need weapons.$b$bFrom what Khadgar has told me, the fortress of Black Rook has plenty of munitions we could use.$b$bTravel to the fortress and place these beacons on some weapon caches there. Once placed, I can teleport them back.
english.completion: Это оружие придется как нельзя кстати в предстоящей битве. Отлично, $gгерой:воительница;.

text.title: 亡者的智慧
text.objectives: 从瓦尔莎拉的黑鸦堡垒获得$1oa本战术论。
text.description: 听说你要去黑鸦堡垒。$b$b那里曾是传奇的拉文凯斯领主的家乡，他可是位杰出的军事家。他的知识或许能帮我们在对抗暮色卫队时占据优势 。$b$b你去黑鸦堡垒的时候，记得睁大眼睛，找找还有没有记载了拉文凯斯的战术，并保存完好的书籍。
text.progress: How goes the search?
text.completion: Excellent. The knowledge in these books should prove very useful in the days to come.

english.title: Learning From the Dead
english.objectives: Recover $1oa Books of Tactics from Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.
english.description: I heard you were traveling to Black Rook Hold.$b$bIt was once home to the legendary Lord Ravencrest, a brilliant tactician. His knowledge may be exactly what we need to give us an edge against the Duskwatch.$b$bWhile you are at the Rook, keep your eyes peeled for any books that might have survived the ages that outline the Ravencrest's strategems.
english.progress: How is the search going?
english.completion: Прекрасно. Знания, содержащиеся в этих книгах, очень помогут нам в будущем.

text.title: 侦察步道
text.objectives: 前往大步道寻找斥候。
text.description: 我们和这些人同根同祖，却对他们毫无了解。他们避世隐居多年，已经改变了许多。$b$b我们得尽量了解他们，搞清他们的能力。我们派了一位斥候潜入大步道，探查夜之子的防线。血精灵也这么做了，但我不知道他们是否也能这么机警。$b$b回报的期限早就过了，他们却毫无消息。去找他们，确保他们的安全，至少也不能让他们白白牺牲。
text.completion: It is good to know that they are alive. Their knowledge will be valuable in the coming siege.
text.end: 找到大步道的斥候。

english.title: Taking a Promenade
english.objectives: Locate the scouts in the Promenade.
english.description: These people are foreign to us, despite our common heritage. They have changed much in the years they have been cloistered away.$b$bWe need to learn more about them, what they are capable of. We dispatched one of our scouts to infiltrate the Promenade and assess the defenses. The blood elves did the same, although I doubt their ability to be discreet.$b$bBoth are long past due for reporting back to us. Find them and make sure they are safe or at least did not die in vain.
english.completion: It is good to know that they are alive. Their knowledge will be valuable in the coming siege.
english.end: Locate the scouts in the Promenade.

text.title: 侦察突破口
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛的秩序大殿地下帮助瓦尔托伊。
text.description:
如果莉莉丝的情报准确，秩序大殿里有个突破口，那将是我们进入暗夜要塞的唯一入口。

他们肯定用魔法封印了那里——让瓦尔托伊跟你一起去看看，她检查封印的时候，请保护好她。她天赋非凡，我对她有绝对的信心。不管他们弄出了什么魔法，以她的能力都能破解。

瓦尔托伊自有办法进城，她会在秩序大殿里跟你见面。
text.completion: It appears Ly'leth was correct. This is an entrance to the Nightwell - and it is well protected. Nothing is impenetrable though.$B$BLet us have a look at the ley lines powering this shield, shall we?

english.title: Scouting the Breach
english.objectives: Aid Valtrois underneath the Sanctum of Order in Suramar City.
english.description:
If Ly'leth's information is accurate, there is a breach in the Sanctum of Order that could be our only way into the Nighthold.

No doubt they have magically sealed it - take Valtrois and protect her while she examines the seal. She is an exceptional talent, and I have total faith in her ability to break whatever enchantment they have cooked up.

Valtrois has her own methods of getting into the city and will meet you inside the Sanctum of Order.
english.completion: Очевидно, Ли'лет была права. Вот вход в Ночной Колодец, и он надежно защищен. Но нет ничего невозможного.$b$bДавай взглянем на силовые линии, питающие этот щит.

objectiveDetails.description: 等待瓦尔托伊检查完屏障
清理出一条通向秩序大殿地下屏障的道路
到秩序大殿地下与瓦尔托伊见面

text.title: 封印之力
text.objectives: 去深红林地的凯尔巴洛调查魔网装置。
text.description:
暗夜井已经超负荷运转了，没办法匀出能量给这个封印。所以，他们借用了魔网的能量。

我追踪了其中的一个能量源，发现它位于凯尔巴洛。我们马上出发吧，到了那里，我才知道关闭屏障的最佳方式。

对，你没听错，是我们一起。你肯定不会让我孤身犯险的，对吧？

我们在那里见吧！
text.completion: Valtrois told me everything. She is hard at work on a plan for bringing down that barrier.$B$BI am afraid all we can do for now is wait. Thank you for your help.

english.title: The Seal's Power
english.objectives: Investigate the ley line device at Kel'balor in the Crimson Thicket.
english.description:
The Nightwell is so overloaded that they could not spare anything for this seal. Instead, they are borrowing power from the ley lines.

I have traced one of their power sources to Kel'balor. We should head there immediately so I can determine how best to disable this barrier.

Yes of course I said "we." Surely you do not expect me to go without my bodyguard, do you?

I shall meet you there!
english.completion: Waltrua told me everything. She's currently working on a plan to remove that barrier. I'm afraid we can only wait. Thank you for your help.

objectiveDetails.description: 通往沙尔艾兰的传送门
在瓦尔托伊调查魔网装置的时候保护她
与凯尔巴洛的瓦尔托伊见面

text.title: 消除魔法
text.objectives: 为塞达斯获取充能的塑魔法杖和不稳定的构造体核心。
text.description: 负责这个防御工事的魔导师很厉害，可能我们俩联手也打不过。$b$b幸好辛多雷或多或少还是懂点魔法的。那个法师的屏障虽强，但我们还能智取。$b$b为了给另外一组防御传送门供能，他给自己的法杖灌注了大量能量，但他没有将法杖随身携带。把法杖带来给我，再从那些构造体身上弄个能量源。这样我就可以制作出关闭护盾所需的东西了。
text.progress: It is really child's play when you consider the magical weaves. I can see the flaws with just a few minutes of study.
text.completion: Excellent work. The weapon will provide the proper housing, and the magical signatures on the core will let me bypass...
text.end: 为塞达斯获取充能的塑魔法杖和不稳定的构造体核心。

english.title: Nullified
english.objectives: Obtain the Charged Arcshaper Staff and a Volatile Construct Core for Sendath.
english.description: The magus in charge of the defenses here is powerful. Perhaps too strong, even for the both of us.$b$bFortunately, the sin'dorei know a thing or two about magic. The mage's barrier is strong, but we are clever.$b$bHe has somehow channeled enough energy into his staff to power another set of defense portals, but he has left it out of his sight. Bring me the staff and an energy source from one of those constructs. I should be able to create just the thing we need to take that shield out.
english.progress: Творение чар – детская игра для меня. Я с первого взгляда замечаю все недочеты.
english.completion: That's great. The weapon will play the role of a hull, and the magical core signatures will help me get around...
english.end: Obtain the Charged Arcshaper Staff and a Volatile Construct Core for Sendath.

text.title: 护盾对魔法
text.objectives: 使用魔力消除器击败塑魔者索伦迪斯。
text.description: 好了，魔力消除器完成了！用他们的武器和魔法信号来遮蔽法术，就可以像破法者一样轻松撕裂护盾了。$b$b让那个玩票的法师领教一下，跟辛多雷开战是什么下场！
text.completion: Good. With him out of the way we will be able to establish a stronger foothold once the main force arrives.
text.end: 使用魔力消除器击败塑魔者索伦迪斯。

english.title: Shield, Meet Spell
english.objectives: Use the Arcane Nullifier to defeat Arcshaper Thorendis.
english.description: There you have it, one arcane nullifier! Using their weapon and magical signatures to cloak the spell, it should tear apart the shield as good as any spellbreaker would.$b$bGo teach that amateur spellslinger what it means to wage war against the sin'dorei!
english.completion: Хорошо. Теперь нам будет проще продержаться, пока не прибудут основные силы.
english.end: Use the Arcane Nullifier to defeat Arcshaper Thorendis.

text.title: 清理水晶
text.objectives: 破坏$1oa个传送水晶。
text.description: 这座传送门是个问题。有它在，他们就能召唤出数不清的预备部队。$b$b附近的水晶大概是给传送门供能的。只要把水晶破坏掉，就可以给他们沉重打击。
text.completion: Nice work. They will not be opening that portal again any time soon.

english.title: Crystal Clearing
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Portal Crystals.
english.description: This portal is a problem. With it they can summon countless reserves.$b$bThe crystals nearby seem to be powering the gate. If we destroy those, we can set them back significantly.
english.completion: Молодец. В обозримом будущем этот портал больше не доставит нам хлопот.

text.title: 关闭传送门
text.objectives: 消灭监督者英格拉。
text.description: 破坏水晶只能暂时阻止他们，但如果不解决控制传送门的人，我们的努力还是会白费。$b$b我听到他们那个叫英格拉的监督者，正在发号施令，想用更强大的力量把更厉害的军团军官从传送门那边召唤过来。我们得阻止她，这样才能永远封印这座传送门。
text.completion: A portal that big will not be reopening any time soon. I would say that counts as weakening their defenses.
text.end: 消灭监督者英格拉。

english.title: Powering Down the Portal
english.objectives: Slay Overseer Ingra.
english.description: Destroying the crystals will stop them temporarily, but it will be meaningless if we do not deal with the person controlling the portal itself.$b$bI heard their overseer, Ingra, shouting orders for more power so that she could bring the stronger Legion lieutenants through the gate. We must stop her to truly seal the portal for good.
english.completion: Такой массивный портал они еще не скоро откроют заново. Думаю, что мы прилично ослабили их оборону.
english.end: Slay Overseer Ingra.

text.title: 斩除臂膀
text.objectives: 击败魔导师之臂。
text.description: 你麾下的夏多雷起义者给我带来了一些坏消息，$n。$b$b忠于艾利桑德的奥术师重新激活了魔导师之臂，这是夜之子有史以来最强大的构造体。它以前失控过一次。在被关闭前，它毁掉了整整一片城区。看来他们真是狗急跳墙了，居然想用它来对付我们。$b$b斥候在深红林地北面看到了那玩意。我们绝不能让它充能完毕，否则就胜利无望了。
text.completion: We almost lost the invasion before we could begin. Good work.
text.end: 击败魔导师之臂。

english.title: Break An Arm
english.objectives: Defeat the Arm of the Magistrix.
english.description: The insurgents you marshaled gave me some bad news, $n.$b$bThe arcanists loyal to Elisande have reactivated the Arm of the Magistrix. The most powerful construct ever attempted, it raged out of control and decimated an entire district before it was disabled. Truly they must be desperate to turn it against us.$b$bThe scouts have spotted it in the Crimson Thicket to the north. We cannot allow it to reach full power if we are to succeed.
english.completion: A little more, and we'd be defeated before we even had a chance to get started. Well done.
english.end: Defeat the Arm of the Magistrix.

text.title: 拉壮丁
text.objectives: 请艾瑞莉娅护送你进入冥狱深渊。
text.description:
海拉的克瓦迪尔在过去的数百年里一直都在劫掠艾泽拉斯各地的海岸，许多杰出的维库人本应成为我的瓦拉加尔，结果却被她偷走了。如今他们那该死的女王已经一败涂地，冥狱深渊中囚禁的灵魂也终于获得了解放，可以加入我们了！

跟艾瑞莉娅一起去一趟冥狱深渊吧。我保证，她会让你安全返回的。
text.completion: Keep your wits about you, $n. There are many here who will attempt to steal your soul.

english.title: Recruitment Drive
english.objectives: Ask Aerylia to escort you to Helheim.
english.description:
Helya's kvaldir have been raiding Azeroth's coasts for centuries, and many worthy vrykul who were destined to become my Valarjar were stolen. 

Now that their cursed queen is defeated, the souls held captive in Helheim can finally be freed to join us!

Go to Helheim with Aerylia. I assure you she will bring you back safely.
english.completion: Keep your wits about you, $n. There are many here who will attempt to steal your soul.

text.title: 武装军队
text.objectives: 搜索失窃的箱子，获取10把失窃利刃和10面失窃盾牌。
text.description:
最近的战斗极大地消耗了我们的物资。而新来的瓦拉加尔还需要武器。

克瓦迪尔抢来的箱子里堆满了大量武器、护甲和其他战利品。

去尽量多收集一点物资吧！
text.progress: Did you find any supplies we can use in Helheim $n?
text.completion: Good. These will be invaluable in the coming battles.

english.title: Arming the Army
english.objectives: Search stolen crates for 10 stolen blades and 10 stolen shields.
english.description:
The recent battles have greatly depleted our supplies, and we will need arms for our new Valarjar. 

The kvaldir have an abundance of weapons, armor, and other spoils from their raiding stockpiled in stolen crates. 

Confiscate whatever you can!
english.progress: Тебе удалось найти припасы, которые мы могли бы использовать, $n?
english.completion: Good. These will be invaluable in the coming battles.

text.title: Not There, Not Then, Not Forever

english.title: Not There, Not Then, Not Forever

text.title: 斡旋
text.objectives: 清除精灵战争营中的侮辱性物品。
text.description: 我的部队纪律严明，没有我的命令，绝对不会与辛多雷开战。$b$b可是，我不得不羞愧地承认，两支军队都在搞恶作剧，互相骚扰，还把带有侮辱含义的物品丢到对方的营地。$b$b请你帮个忙，$p，我们需要找个双方军队都尊敬的人，把这些物品收起来，以免双方擦枪走火。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. Hopefully, since our forces saw you performing this task they will come to their senses and stop this harassment.

english.title: Trolling Them
english.objectives: Remove insulting items from the elven war camps.
english.description: My army is disciplined, and they will follow my order not to engage the Sin'dorei in combat unless I give the command.$b$bHowever, it is with some level of shame that I must admit both armies have been attempting to harass the other with pranks, littering our respective camps with insults.$b$bPlease, $p, we need someone both armies respect to collect these items before fighting breaks out.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. Hopefully, since our forces saw you performing this task they will come to their senses and stop this harassment.

text.title: 莉亚德琳的要求
text.objectives: 在梅瑞戴尔与女伯爵莉亚德琳谈一谈。
text.description: 沙尔艾兰已经挤满了难民和起义军。我们算是建起了自己的军队，但却没有足够的武器来武装他们，也没有足够的魔力来防止他们变成枯法者。$b$b在这种时候，女伯爵莉亚德琳还来雪上加霜，提出一大串的要求，我根本就没有时间去应付。$b$b你去帮她看看，好吗？她的部队还在梅瑞戴尔不断壮大，很容易找到的。
text.completion: I can relate to Thalyssra's frustration.$B$BI remember when I launched my first offensive. I swear I didn't eat or sleep for a week.

english.title: Liadrin's Command
english.objectives: Speak with Lady Liadrin in Meredil.
english.description: Shal'Aran is bursting at the seams with refugees and rebels. We practically have an army now but not enough weapons or mana to keep everyone armed and un-withered.$b$bAnd in all of this, Lady Liadrin has a battery of requests I simply do not have the time to deal with.$b$bWill you go to her? Her growing army is hard to miss in Meredil.
english.completion: Я понимаю разочарование Талисры.$b$bКак сейчас помню свою первую наступательную операцию. Я тогда неделю не спала и ничего не ела.

text.title: 斡旋
text.objectives: 清除精灵战争营中的侮辱性物品。
text.description: 我的部队纪律严明，没有我的命令，绝对不会与卡多雷开战。$b$b可是，我不得不羞愧地承认，两支军队都在搞恶作剧，互相骚扰，还把带有侮辱含义的物品丢到对方的营地。$b$b请你帮个忙，$p，我们需要找个双方军队都尊敬的人，把这些物品收起来，以免双方擦枪走火。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. Hopefully, since our forces saw you performing this task they will come to their senses and stop this harassment.

english.title: Trolling Them
english.objectives: Remove insulting items from the elven war camps.
english.description: My army is disciplined, and they will follow my order not to engage the kaldorei in combat unless I give the command.$b$bHowever, it is with some level of shame that I must admit both armies have been attempting to harass the other with pranks, littering our respective camps with insults.$b$bPlease, $p, we need someone both armies respect to collect these items before fighting breaks out.
english.completion: Спасибо тебе, $p. Очень надеюсь, что твой пример благотворно скажется на поведении солдат, и они перестанут подтрунивать друг над другом.

text.title: 武装义军
text.objectives: 在梅瑞戴尔与维多利亚谈一谈。
text.description: 堕夜精灵起义军的人数越来越多，但是他们大多久疏战阵。$b$b维多利亚和希尔格林都在尽全力训练新兵，但还需要一个老手帮忙。$b$b去他们那里，向他们展示一下你在旅途中学到的战斗技巧。我希望那些堕夜精灵能为即将到来的战争做好准备。
text.completion: Every member of the Duskwatch has had centuries to perfect their fighting techniques. We do not have that much time to get these rebels in to fighting shape.

english.title: Arming the Rebels
english.objectives: Speak with Victoire in Meredil.
english.description: The Nightfallen rebellion is growing in number, but they have not fought a real war in ages.$b$bVictoire and Silgryn are doing their best to train the new arrivals, but could use an experienced hand.$b$bGo to them and show them some of the skills in battle you have picked up in your travels. I want those Nightfallen ready for battle when the time comes.
english.completion: Every member of the Duskwatch has had centuries to perfect their fighting techniques. We do not have that much time to get these rebels in to fighting shape.

text.title: 武装义军
text.objectives: 在梅瑞戴尔与维多利亚谈一谈。
text.description: 堕夜精灵起义军的人数越来越多，但是他们大多久疏战阵。$b$b维多利亚和希尔格林都在尽全力训练新人，但还需要一个老手帮忙。$b$b去他们那里，向他们展示一下你在旅途中学到的战斗技巧。我们得让那些堕夜精灵能为即将到来的战争做好准备。
text.completion: Every member of the Duskwatch has had centuries to perfect their fighting techniques. We do not have that much time to get these rebels in to fighting shape.

english.title: Arming the Rebels
english.objectives: Speak with Victoire in Meredil.
english.description: The Nightfallen rebellion is growing in number, but they have not fought a real war in ages.$b$bVictoire and Silgryn are doing their best to train the new arrivals and could use an experienced hand.$b$bGo to them and show them some of the skills in battle you have picked up in your travels. We need those Nightfallen ready for battle when the time comes.
english.completion: The warriors of the Twilight Guard have been perfecting their combat skills for centuries. Alas, we have very little time to train these rebels in any way.

text.title: 净化空气
text.objectives: 为露妮丽找到一个鲜红的天空核心，一个鲜红的风暴核心和一个鲜红的风之核心。集齐三个核心后返回沙塔斯向她复命。
text.description: 要想重新掌握打造远古武器的技术，就需要远古的祭品。$b$b如果你想了解如何使用空气铸造武器，那就需要先与从空气的产物交战。$b$b把它们的核心带给我，我就会把你寻求的知识赐予你。
text.progress: Be mindful of their attacks, for with air, you never know it's there until you feel it move across your skin.
text.completion: I smell the air about you and see that you have returned triumphant.$B$BHere is the knowledge that you seek.

english.title: Clearing the Air
english.objectives: Recover a Cardinal Sky Core, a Cardinal Storm Core, and a Cardinal Wind Core for Lunelli. Bring them back to her in Shattrath when you have all three.
english.description: Ancient weapons require ancient offerings to regain the knowledge on how to construct them.$b$bIf you wish to learn how weapons forged from air are crafted, then you must first battle with beings born from it.$b$bBring me their cores and I will gift you the knowledge you seek.
english.progress: Be mindful of their attacks, for with air, you never know it's there until you feel it move across your skin.
english.completion: I smell the air about you and see that you have returned triumphant.$B$BHere is the knowledge that you seek.

text.title: 了不起的管家
text.objectives: 铺好桌子，然后召唤莫罗斯。
text.description: 幽灵宴会准备停当，只等桌子铺好，宾客来访。
text.completion: I can't believe it's finally over.

english.title: Butler to the Great
english.objectives: Lay the table, and summon Moroes.
english.description: A ghostly dinner party awaits, ready for the spread and its dinner guests.
english.completion: I can't believe it's finally over.

text.title: 勇气试炼：奥丁的审判
text.objectives: 在勇气试炼团队副本中击败海拉。
text.description: 你证明了自己有实力挑战海拉。有了我的祝福，你就有了击败她的力量。
text.completion: It is done. Helya's reign comes to an end and now we move forward. You have done a great thing today, champion. Consider yourself counted among those in the Halls of Valor.

english.title: Trial of Valor: Odyn's Judgment
english.objectives: Defeat Helya within the Trial of Valor Raid.
english.description: You've proven worthy to challenge Helya. Now with my blessing, the power to defeat her is yours.
english.completion: Итак, дело сделано. Владычеству Хелии пришел конец, и мы теперь можем двигаться дальше. Сегодня ты $gсовершил великий подвиг, защитник:совершила великий подвиг, защитница;. Отныне ты по праву можешь занимать место в Чертогах Доблести.

objectiveDetails.description: 在勇气试炼团队副本中击败海拉

text.title: 利爪恐慌
text.objectives: 使用梦境之路的传送门，前往海加尔山的艾维娜圣殿找希萨莉。
text.description: 我刚刚得知，燃烧军团正在攻打艾维娜圣殿！而利爪德鲁伊却在这里慢吞吞地策划着防御战略，眼看着我们的兄弟姐妹惨遭屠戮。$b$b我不能坐视被我视为家园的圣殿化为火海。求求你，跟我一起去拯救我的人民。
text.completion: It took all my willpower not to jump into the fray without backup. Let's go!

english.title: Talon Terror
english.objectives: Use the portal in the Dreamway to meet Thisalee at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: I just received word that the Shrine of Aviana is under attack by the Burning Legion! While the Druids of the Talon here are taking their time planning and strategizing their defense, our brothers and sisters are being slaughtered where they stand.$b$bI cannot stand idly by while my home shrine is in danger. Please, come with me to save my people.
english.completion: It took all my willpower not to jump into the fray without backup. Let's go!

text.title: 嗷嗷待哺
text.objectives: 在沙尔艾兰与奥术师瓦尔托伊谈一谈。
text.description: 如你所见，我们救了许多难民。不幸的是，这导致了一个新问题。$b$b阿坎多尔的果实是我们的救赎，但它现在结的果子数量不足以治愈所有人。为了保障所有难民的生活，我们还得继续依赖魔力一小段时间。$b$b瓦尔托伊说她可能有办法。去跟她谈谈，看看她有什么计划。
text.completion: It is good to see you. I could use a helping hand.
text.end: 在沙尔艾兰与奥术师瓦尔托伊谈一谈。

english.title: Mouths to Feed
english.objectives: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois in Shal'Aran.
english.description: We have rescued many refugees, as you can see. Unfortunately this has revealed a new problem.$b$bThe arcan'dor fruit is our salvation, but it does not bear enough fruit right now to cure everyone. We must rely on mana a little longer to tide the refugees over.$b$bValtrois thinks that she may have a solution. Please go speak with her and see what she plans to do.
english.completion: Какая приятная встреча! Мне как раз нужна твоя помощь.
english.end: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois in Shal'Aran.

text.title: 救星欧库勒斯
text.objectives: 与欧库勒斯谈一谈，然后传送到阿苏纳。
text.description: 我有办法养活沙尔艾兰的难民。$b$b现在我已经不再缺少魔力，就有更多时间来研究其他地区的魔网了。我探测出阿苏纳的魔网有处魔法涡流。我虽然掌握着不少魔法，但我们还得亲自去看看那里的魔网，才能把能量转移到沙尔艾兰。$b$b欧库勒斯人很好，愿意把我们传送过去，可我还需要个帮手。你愿意跟我一起去吗？
text.completion: That was a little terrifying. Sometimes I am not entirely sure that Oculeth knows what he is doing.
text.end: 与欧库勒斯谈一谈，然后传送到阿苏纳。

english.title: Oculeth Ex Machina
english.objectives: Speak with Oculeth and teleport to Azsuna.
english.description: I have a plan to feed Shal'Aran.$b$bNow that I am no longer starving for mana I have had time to study ley lines in new regions. I detected an eddy of mana in the ley lines of Azsuna. I have plenty of magic at my disposal, but we must visit the ley line in person in order to properly redirect the energy to Shal'Aran.$b$bOculeth has graciously offered to teleport us there, but I could use an assistant. Care to join me?
english.completion: Я даже успела испугаться. Иногда я сомневаюсь, что Окулет действительно знает, что делает.
english.end: Speak with Oculeth and teleport to Azsuna.

text.title: 魔网之力
text.objectives: 协助奥术师瓦尔托伊放置魔网共振器。
text.description: 言归正传！$b$b你拿着这些魔网共振器。我们可以使用共振能量准确地改变魔网流动的方向，但前提是共振器的摆放位置要精准。我会把位置指给你看。$b$b你的朋友同意来……“监督”我们。但愿我这个专业人士在干活的时候，她不要来添乱。
text.progress: Энергия силовых линий не польется отсюда сама по себе. Нам нужно ее направить.
text.completion: That was more infuriating than it should have been. At least her natural talents mostly matched my calculations...
text.end: 协助奥术师瓦尔托伊放置魔网共振器。

english.title: Unbeleyvable
english.objectives: Assist Arcanist Valtrois with placing ley line taps.
english.description: Back to the task at hand!$b$bTake these ley line taps. We can use the resonant energies to properly redirect the flow, but they must be placed in precise locations. I will show you where.$b$bYour friend has agreed to... "supervise" us. Let us hope she just stays out of the way while the professionals take care of this.
english.progress: Энергия силовых линий не польется отсюда сама по себе. Нам нужно ее направить.
english.completion: Это было гораздо неприятнее, чем я предполагала. Но, по крайней мере, мне удалось довольно точно вычислить ее природные способности...
english.end: Assist Arcanist Valtrois with placing ley line taps.

text.title: 上善若水
text.objectives: 在奥术师瓦尔托伊举行仪式期间保护她。
text.description: 都搞定了，$n！只差最后一步，沙尔艾兰就可以尽情享用魔力了。$b$b现在，我对魔网的掌握能力变强了，可以震散这个池子，让魔网能量畅通无阻地流过。可这片魔网的状态十分混乱，我得全神贯注，才能让能量转向。$b$b我得警告你，这么做肯定闹出很大的动静。我进行仪式时，你得保护我。$b$b你准备好了就跟我说一声。
text.completion: It is done. Shal'Aran will have no want of mana now.
text.end: 在奥术师瓦尔托伊进行仪式期间保护她。

english.title: The Art of Flow
english.objectives: Protect Arcanist Valtrois while she completes the ritual.
english.description: All done, $n! We have but one more step and Shal'Aran will have all the mana it needs.$b$bNow that I have better access to the ley line below I can break the pool so that it will flow through properly. Given the chaotic state of this ley line it will require all of my concentration to redirect the energy.$b$bI must warn you that we will attract attention while I am doing this. You will need to protect me while I complete the process.$b$bSpeak to me when you are ready.
english.completion: Done. There will now be enough mana in Shal'Aran.
english.end: Protect Arcanist Valtrois while she completes the ritual.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成第三个道标的仪式
完成第二个道标的仪式
完成第一个道标的仪式

text.title: 与龙共舞
text.objectives: 与丝黛拉苟萨交谈并飞回沙尔艾兰。
text.description: 老实说我很惊讶，$n。$b$b你和你的朋友都不是巨龙，居然也修复了一片魔网！$b$b你们看来也筋疲力竭了。我来送你们回家吧。
text.completion: That is quite the adventure you had. Thankfully we now have plenty of mana for the refugees. Thank you, $n.
text.end: 与丝黛拉苟萨交谈并飞回沙尔艾兰。

english.title: A Dance With Dragons
english.objectives: Speak with Stellagosa to ride back to Shal'Aran.
english.description: I must say I am impressed, $n.$b$bYou and your friend were able to fix a ley line, and you are not even dragons!$b$bYou both seem exhausted by this ordeal. Allow me to help you get back home.
english.completion: What an adventure! Luckily, now we have a lot of mana for refugees. Thank you, $n.
english.end: Speak with Stellagosa to ride back to Shal'Aran.

text.title: 进击的利爪
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个军团入侵者。
text.description: 啸天者沙德格弗一直在指挥圣殿的防御，但是我觉得他正在丧失信心。显然他需要更多的火力支援！$b$b我们去把这些恶魔干掉，击溃他们的攻势，打他们个措手不及！
text.completion: Ha! Take that, demon scum!

english.title: Attack on the Roost
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Legion invaders.
english.description: Skylord Shadegrove has been leading the defense of the shrine, but I think he's starting to lose hope. Clearly he needs some more firepower behind him!$b$bLet's take out these demons and fend off the attack. They'll never see it coming!
english.completion: Ha! Take that, demon scum!

text.title: Shipwrecked Survivors
text.objectives: Speak with First Sergeant Steelfang.
text.description: It appears that we have allies here on the Broken Shore.$b$bA small band of shipwrecked soldiers have been surviving here since the first assault. Their strength and tenacity will bolster our ranks.$b$bMake your way to their encampment along the beach and bring them here. Tell them that reinforcements have arrived, and the battle against the Burning Legion waits for no one.

english.title: Shipwrecked Survivors
english.objectives: Speak with First Sergeant Steelfang.
english.description: It appears that we have allies here on the Broken Shore.$b$bA small band of shipwrecked soldiers have been surviving here since the first assault. Their strength and tenacity will bolster our ranks.$b$bMake your way to their encampment along the beach and bring them here. Tell them that reinforcements have arrived, and the battle against the Burning Legion waits for no one.

text.title: 不祥的证据
text.objectives: 将邪能水晶碎片带给达拉然的大法师卡德加。
text.description: <你发现斯科瓦尔德手中攒着一块仍然散发着恶魔能量的邪能水晶碎片。$b$b看来神王不想让别人发现它。古尔丹给他的指令会不会就在水晶里呢？$b$b要是还有人能解读这块破碎的水晶，那一定是卡德加。>
text.progress: Greetings, $n.$B$BDid you intercept Gul'dan's message to Skovald?
text.completion: You believe Skovald didn't want you to find this crystal, eh? Let me have a look.$B$B<Khadgar peers at the fel crystal fragment, tracing the lines of power that run through it.>$B$BI have seen this sort of crystal before. They are used to convey orders that come from the highest ranks of the Legion.$B$BThis is not good.

english.title: Unwanted Evidence
english.objectives: Bring the Fel Crystal Fragment to Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
english.description: <You find a shattered remnant of fel crystal clutched in Skovald's hand, still glowing with demonic power.$b$bIt seems the god-king didn't want it found. Did the crystal contain the message sent to him by Gul'dan?$b$bIf anyone can glean the meaning of the broken crystal, it's Khadgar.>
english.progress: Привет, $n.$b$bТебе удалось перехватить послание Гул'дана Сковальду?
english.completion: Тебе кажется, что Сковальд не хотел, чтобы ты $gобнаружил:обнаружила; этот кристалл? Что ж, давай посмотрим.$b$b<Кадгар внимательно рассматривает осколок кристалла, вглядываясь в проходящие внутри него нити силы.>$b$bМне доводилось видеть такие кристаллы. Они служат для передачи приказов от командиров Легиона самого высокого звена.$b$bНе нравится мне все это.

text.title: 搜寻指令
text.objectives: 从黑鸦堡垒（史诗难度）获得怨恨碎片，从紫罗兰监狱（史诗难度）获得力量碎片，从守望者地窟（史诗难度）获得痛苦碎片。
text.description: 看来这些密令是燃烧军团的几个主子发来的。既然他们不想让我们知道这个计划，那就说明它一定有极大的威胁。$b$b据我们所知，在那些蕴藏强大力量的地方，高阶恶魔和他们的盟友都动员起来了。他们很可能也收到了类似的水晶。$b$b你或许能找到一颗完整的水晶，至少也要收集足够的碎片来拼出一颗完整水晶，这样我们就能搞清楚燃烧军团的目的了。
text.progress: We need to get to the bottom of what the Legion is planning.
text.completion: Well done! That couldn't have been easy.$B$BThis should be enough fragments. Let's have a look.

english.title: Uncovering Orders
english.objectives: Recover the Fragment of Spite from Blackrook Hold (Mythic), the Fragment of Power from Violet Hold (Mythic), and the Fragment of Torment from Vault of the Wardens (Mythic).
english.description: It would seem secret orders have been parceled out by the Legion's masters. If they're determined to conceal their plan from us, it must pose a dire threat.$b$bWe know high-ranking demons and their allies are mobilizing in places of power. Odds are good that they have received similar crystals.$b$bPerhaps you can find one intact, or at least gather enough fragments that we can reassemble one and determine the Legion's target.
english.progress: Нам любой ценой нужно выведать планы Легиона.
english.completion: Отлично! Изрядно же тебе, наверное, пришлось потрудиться.$b$bЭтих фрагментов нам должно хватить. Давай посмотрим, что мы можем узнать с их помощью.

text.title: 艾维娜的恩典
text.objectives: 在艾维娜圣殿联系艾维娜。
text.description: 如果这是在声东击西，那他们的主力部队在哪？还有哪里遭到了攻击？我们得查出还有谁遇到了威胁！艾维娜应该知道，她的耳目无处不在。$b$b我们去问问吧。去后面的房间应该可以联系上她。
text.completion: Nature is in dire need, mortal. You must fix it.

english.title: Aviana's Grace
english.objectives: Contact Aviana in the Shrine of Aviana.
english.description: If this was only the distraction, where is the main force? Who else is under attack? We need to figure out who else is in danger! Aviana should know, she's got eyes everywhere.$b$bLet's go ask her. We should be able to contact her in the back room.
english.completion: Nature is in dire need, mortal. You must fix it.

text.title: 人尽其用
text.objectives: 与艾瑞莉娅谈一谈，前往破碎海滩的受难小径。
text.description:
既然你拿到了海拉之角，克瓦迪尔就归你了。我们应该好好利用他们。

我已经派遣了我的瓦格里丹妮卡前往破碎海滩。她已经锁定了几个应该清除的燃烧军团目标。

你准备好离开时，艾瑞莉娅会你送过去的。
text.completion: Good to see you made it, Battlelord $n!

english.title: Resource Management
english.objectives: Talk to Aerylia to travel to the Path of Suffering on the Broken Shore.
english.description:
Now that you possess Helya's Horn, the kvaldir are yours to command. We may as well put them to good use for a change. 

I've dispatched my Val'kyr, Danica, to the Broken Shore. She has identified a few Legion targets that should be eliminated.

Aerylia will send you there when you are ready to leave.
english.completion: Good to see you made it, Battlelord $n!

text.title: reuse me
text.objectives: Defeat Viz'aduum the Watcher in Karazhan on Normal difficulty.
text.description: Defeat Viz'aduum the Watcher in Karazhan (Normal).

english.title: reuse me
english.objectives: Defeat Viz'aduum the Watcher in Karazhan on Normal difficulty.
english.description: Defeat Viz'aduum the Watcher in Karazhan (Normal).

objectiveDetails.description: Defeat Viz'aduum the Watcher in Karazhan (Normal).

text.title: 武器战士：顺手牵羊
text.objectives: 前往艾萨拉的熊头，拜访克希雷姆之塔。
text.description:
达拉然宝库里的聚焦之虹被偷走了！小偷是个技巧精湛的法师，我们还没找到他的下落。

幸好，小偷遗落了一张他师傅的字条。他的师傅称他为“弟子”。据我所知，只有一个人会用这种奇怪的称呼——大法师克希雷姆。

我需要你进行调查。他的法师塔位于艾萨拉，他在那里训练他的学徒。快去看看克希雷姆在搞什么名堂。

|cFF660000专精：武器战士|r
text.completion: So someone stole the Focusing Iris and you suspect Xylem might be the culprit? You may be right. $B$BIt is no secret that the archmage has been seeking artifacts of late. However, after the discovery of an ancient grimoire in the Legashi ruins, Xylem has become... unstable. I fear the grimoire may be stealing his mind.$B$BI can help you gain audience with the archmage. With any luck, you can reclaim the Iris peacefully.

english.title: Arms: The Thieving Apprentice
english.objectives: Travel to Xylem's Tower within Bear's Head in Azshara.
english.description:
The Focusing Iris has been stolen from the Dalaran Vaults! The thief was a mage of some skill, but we've been unable to track him.

Fortunately, the thief dropped a note from his master, addressing him as one of his "apprentici." I know of only one mage who uses that particular pluralization - Archmage Xylem.

I'll need you to investigate. In Azshara you will find his tower where he trains his apprentices. Go there, and see what Xylem is up to.

|cFF660000Specialization: Arms Warrior|r
english.completion: Значит, кто-то украл Радужное Средоточие, и ты думаешь, что это проделки Ксилема? Возможно, так оно и есть. $B$BНе секрет, что верховный маг охотится за артефактами. Но недавно он нашел в руинах Легаши древний гримуар, что привело к… некоторому помешательству. Полагаю, что гримуар похищает его разум.$B$BЯ могу добиться для тебя аудиенции у Ксилема. Если повезет, мы сможем забрать Средоточие мирным путем.

text.title: 职业着装
text.objectives: 从艾萨拉的莱萨斯·黎明之眼、鲁博斯和法罗姆身上收集花哨的帽子，精心缝制的长袍和华丽护肩。
text.description:
大法师最近一直把自己锁在法师塔里。如果你想进去，就需要他的几个学徒的帮助。可是你穿成这样的话，恐怕是不行的。

克希雷姆对着装……非常讲究，他的学徒也是通过着装划分等级的。如果你想让他的学徒帮你，就得假装成他们的前辈。那些学徒非常渴望给大法师留下好印象，所以他们会通过决斗来争夺最漂亮的服装。

说到这里，我想你也应该明白了。
text.completion: Yes, I think that will do.$B$BThe apprentices outside the tower should think you outrank them now, so you should be able to get some information out of them. You'll need it to bypass the barrier.

english.title: Professionally Good Looking
english.objectives: Collect the Fanciful Hat, Well-Tailored Robes, and Magnificent Mantle from Raethas Dawnseer, Lobos and Phloem in Azshara.
english.description:
The archmage has recently locked himself away in his tower. If you wish to enter, you'll need help from some of his apprentices. I'm afraid you won't get it dressed like that.

Xylem has a thing for... outfits, and his apprentices use them to show rank. If you wish his apprentices to help you, you'll need to appear their superior. Such is their desire to impress the archmage, many of his apprentices will battle each other for the best pieces.

I think you know where this is going.
english.completion: Yes, that’s so good.$B$BNow the students outside the tower should think that you are significantly superior to them, so that they will give you no problem information that will help you overcome the barrier.

text.objectives: 击败卡拉赞的监视者维兹艾德姆。
text.description:
你的勇士发现卡拉赞的周边地区遭到了燃烧军团入侵。这可不妙。

爬上塔楼，击败沿途的所有敌人。
text.progress: How are you finding the challenges of Karazhan?
text.completion: Were you able to defeat the evils within Karazhan?

english.title: Return to Karazhan: The Tower of Power
english.objectives: Defeat Viz'aduum the Watcher in Karazhan.
english.description:
Your champions discovered that the area surrounding Karazhan is under an invasion from the Legion. This does not bode well.

Climb the tower, and defeat all in your path.
english.progress: Ну, как прошло испытание в Каражане?
english.completion: Тебе удалось одолеть силы зла, наводнившие Каражан?
