text.title: 敌人的消息
text.objectives: 在沙尔艾兰听取安达丽斯的信息。
text.description: $n！当时我们还不知道，我们在平台追踪莉莉丝的消息的时候，有人在监视我们。$B$B这颗水晶是今早由信使送来的。<指了指她身旁的水晶。>$B$B恐怕里面的信息会吓坏胆小的人。我还没给其他人看过，但你为我们做了那么多事，理应看看。
text.completion: I do not know what lies in store for us, but we cannot sit idly while Ly'leth is missing.$B$BWe must act now!

english.title: A Message From Our Enemies
english.objectives: Listen to Andaris's Message in Shal'Aran.
english.description: $n! The messages from Ly'leth we traced throughout the Terrace - we could not have known at the time, but somebody was watching.$B$BThis crystal was delivered by a courier early this morning. <Pointing to the crystal by her side.>$B$BI am afraid the message contained within is not for the faint of heart. It has not been shown to anyone else, but you deserve to see it for all you have done for us.
english.completion: Не знаю, что нас ожидает, но я не могу сидеть сложа руки, пока Ли'лет пропадает неизвестно где.$B$BНадо что-то делать!

text.title: 敌人的挑衅
text.objectives: 前往苏拉玛城的月郡庄园找安达丽斯。
text.description: 别搞错了，这个消息绝对不容轻视。任何针对我们的人民的威胁都应该立刻解决。$b$b我们必须立刻前往月郡庄园，搞清楚莉莉丝的情况。
text.completion: The withered... defeated so easily.$B$BWe must find a way to negate the magic of the felborne. We cannot afford to fight if our own can be turned against us.

english.title: A Challenge From Our Enemies
english.objectives: Meet Andaris at the Lunastre Estate in Suramar City.
english.description: Make no mistake. This message cannot be taken lightly. Any threat made against our people will be dealt with swiftly.$B$BWe must travel to the estate at once to discover what has become of Ly'leth.
english.completion: Иссохшие были... повержены так легко.$B$BНам нужно найти способ нейтрализовать магию Скверны. Как мы можем сражаться, если наше войско так легко обратить против нас?

text.title: 咒语的次序
text.objectives: 在熊头与克希雷姆的学徒谈一谈，破解密码，打开他塔楼的屏障。
text.description:
要打开保护塔楼的屏障，需要按正确的顺序激活灌魔的宝石。这个顺序只有克希雷姆和他的心腹学徒才知道。外人始终无法成功破解密码，而且一旦失败，下场非常致命。

那些渴望晋升的学徒在塔楼附近待了很久。他们中或许有人看到过或者听到过一些东西，可以帮助我们解决这个问题。

为了你的生命着想，希望他们提供的信息会有用吧。
text.completion: The barrier is loose!$B$BHurry, to the tower! There you'll find both Xylem and Rainbow Focus.

english.title: Order of Incantations
english.objectives: Speak with Xylem's apprentices in Bear's Head to decipher the code to open the barrier to his tower.
english.description:
The barrier shielding the tower can only be opened by activating the imbued gems in the correct order. The order is only known to Xylem and his inner circle of apprentices. No others have yet been able to decipher the code, and mistakes are met with deadly consequences.

The aspiring apprentices spend a lot of their time around the tower. Some may have seen or heard something that might point to a solution.

Let us hope, for your sake, their information proves valuable.
english.completion: The barrier is loose!$B$BHurry, to the tower! There you'll find both Xylem and Rainbow Focus.

text.title: 孤狼
text.objectives: 前往月光林地找希萨莉·黑鸦。
text.description: 我的耳目飞翔在艾泽拉斯的每个角落，为我带来各种消息和物品。我的盟友戈德林前去月光林地的兽穴悼念瓦里安·乌瑞恩。他的梦境一直很安宁……但现在，情况发生了变化。$b$b鸟儿们看到恶魔入侵了那个兽穴，还在途中屠杀了我们的许多凡人德鲁伊。你一定要去阻止他们，拯救戈德林，为我们的人民报仇！带上我的孩子希萨莉吧，她坚韧又狂暴，在我们当中很受欢迎。她可以代替我帮助你。
text.completion: If Goldrinn is in the Dream, he's defenseless! We've got to help!

english.title: Lone Wolf
english.objectives: Meet Thisalee Crow in Moonglade.
english.description: My eyes and ears fly across Azeroth, bringing me back news of many things. My ally Goldrinn took to the barrows of Moonglade in mourning upon the death of Varian Wrynn. He has been untouched in the dream... until now.$b$bDemons have been seen invading the very same barrows, killing many more of our mortal druids in the process. You must go. Save Goldrinn, avenge our people! Take my hatchling Thisalee with you. Her tenacity and bloodlust is welcome in my clutch. You shall have my aid.
english.completion: If Goldrinn is in the Dream, he's defenseless! We've got to help!

text.title: Inside the Winter Storm
text.objectives: Grapple across from the tower and climb to the top of the mountain path.
text.description:
There, it looks like there's a good spot to launch to right across from here. This path should take you all the way to the top.

According to my  intel, your dragons should be up there. Let's just hope that they're still in a state to help you.

text.title: 海拉加尔登陆战：维克特
与大法师沟通
text.objectives: 面对大法师克希雷姆。
text.description:
驱散了屏障之后，大法师克希雷姆已经触手可及！

但愿他能合作点，归还聚焦之虹……
text.completion: It is as I feared, the archmage is beyond reason... and now he is beyond reach.$B$BYou have done a great thing here, freeing his apprentices from his corruption, but this fight is not over yet.

english.title: The Archmage Accosted
english.objectives: Confront Archmage Xylem.
english.description:
With the barrier dispelled, Archmage Xylem is finally within reach!

Hopefully he'll be cooperative in returning the Iris...
english.completion: Я так и думала. Договориться с ним не удастся… впрочем, и добраться до него теперь тоже.$B$BНо у тебя все прекрасно получилось. Благодаря тебе ученики Ксилема освободились от его оскверняющего воздействия. Впрочем, угроза еще не устранена.

text.title: 闭上眼睛
text.objectives: 与军事顾问维多利亚谈一谈，传送到大法师克希雷姆的位置，并击败他。
text.description:
克希雷姆之塔的学徒向我们报告说，他们可以用克希雷姆的传送门的残骸来确定他的位置。

我们得到了六人议会的指令，要打开一道直达他身边的传送门。但他在传送门的另一边所引导的法术非常强大，我们只能让传送门开启一小会儿。

他的学徒乔安娜要求我在你走之前把这个消息告诉你。你准备好了就告诉我。
text.completion: I apologize for my actions, $C. I was a fool to tap into the power of the grimoire, and that folly could have cost Azeroth dearly. $B$BI thank you not only for purging and defeating the shadowy evil that had hold of me, but also for sparing my life.$B$BMyself, as well as all of Azeroth, are in your debt.

english.title: Closing the Eye
english.objectives: Speak with War Councilor Victoria to be teleported to Archmage Xylem's location and defeat him.
english.description:
We have received reports from the apprentices at Xylem's Tower that they've been able to use the remant of Xylem's portal to pinpoint his location.

We have orders from the Council of Six to open a portal directly to him, though whatever magic he's channeling on the other end is powerful enough to allow us to only keep it open for a brief window.

The apprentice, Joanna asked I give you this message before you proceed. Speak to me when you're ready.
english.completion: I apologize for my actions, $C. I was a fool to tap into the power of the grimoire, and that folly could have cost Azeroth dearly. $B$BI thank you not only for purging and defeating the shadowy evil that had hold of me, but also for sparing my life.$B$BMyself, as well as all of Azeroth, are in your debt.

text.title: 鬼斧神工
text.objectives: 把斧刃拿给凿握据点的胡德鲁克·折刃看看。
text.description: 这把利刃的构造很眼熟，但是你却想不起来在哪里见过。$b$b也许凿握据点那里有人知道这种构造的详细情况。
text.completion: Oh aye! I know the make of that chopper.$B$BTha master who made it also created the famous Bleakwood Hew. You may 'ave heard of it.$B$BAn' it just so happens I know how to make the hew too!

english.title: A Familiar Axe to Grind
english.objectives: Show the axe blade to Hoddruc Bladebender at Chiselgrip.
english.description: The construction of this blade feels familiar, but you can't quite recall where you may have seen something like it before.$b$bPerhaps someone at Chiselgrip might know more about its construction.
english.completion: Oh aye! I know the make of that chopper.$B$BTha master who made it also created the famous Bleakwood Hew. You may 'ave heard of it.$B$BAn' it just so happens I know how to make the hew too!

text.title: 好钢用在斧刃上
text.objectives: 从燃烧平原上的兽人和食人魔身上收集$1oa把斧刃。集齐后返回凿握据点向胡德鲁克复命。
text.description: 听着，你看起来的确是真心想要这种斧头设计图的人。$b$b这玩意在拍卖行应该能赚不少钱。但是我可不能把它白白交给你，$g小伙子:小姑娘;，你得拿东西来换。$b$b就你之前带给我的那种斧刃，再给我弄些来。这玩意可是用上好的钢材打造的。别担心，$g小伙子:小姑娘;，我要不了多少……$b$b你怎么说？
text.progress: You see, I've got a shipment ta fill and it's been slim pickin' round these parts for good metal. Those blades are just what I'm lookin' for.
text.completion: Oh ho! Look at all that STEEL!$B$BI'll have this shipment finished by the end o' the week. Well done, lad! Well done!$B$BAn' as I promised, here are those plans for the hew.

english.title: Worth Its Weight in Steel
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Axe Blades from orcs and ogres around the Burning Steppes. Return them to Hoddruc in Chiselgrip when you've collected them all.
english.description: Listen, ye seem like one who may be interested in getting a copy of those axe plans.$b$bCould probably make a pretty penny at the auction house on it. But I can't just hand 'em over to ya, $glad:lass;. Not fer free.$b$bThat axe blade ye brought me, I could use more of those. Good steel in those blades. Don't worry, $glad:lass;, I just need a few...$b$bWhat do ye say?
english.progress: You see, I've got a shipment ta fill and it's been slim pickin' round these parts for good metal. Those blades are just what I'm lookin' for.
english.completion: Oh ho! Look at all that STEEL!$B$BI'll have this shipment finished by the end o' the week. Well done, lad! Well done!$B$BAn' as I promised, here are those plans for the hew.

text.title: 有点不对劲……
text.objectives: 解除5名夜之子渗透者的伪装。
text.description: 我有些不安，勇士。$b$b现在已经不止是简单的小玩笑了，肯瑞托已经处理了几起精灵斗殴的事件。我担心有什么东西——或是人——在煽风点火。$b$b你的伪装是夜之子制作的对吧？那么他们应该也可以做类似的东西。$b$b幸好塔莉萨教了我很多有关这种幻象的知识。我相信这种水晶可以消除他们的伪装。$b$b以防万一，你就去营地检查一下吧。
text.completion: It is as I feared. Hopefully they will think twice before sending more spies.
text.end: 解除5名夜之子渗透者的伪装。

english.title: Something's Not Quite Right...
english.objectives: Remove the disguise of 5 Nightborne Infiltrators.
english.description: Something is troubling me, champion.$b$bBeyond these simple japes, the Kirin Tor has had to break up a few fights between the elves. I am worried something - or someone - might be influencing them.$b$bYour disguise was made by the nightborne, yes? It is not unreasonable to assume they can do something similar.$b$bFortunately, Thalyssra has told me much about how the illusion works, and I believe this crystal can remove their disguise.$b$bWhy don't you check the camps, just to be safe?
english.completion: Как я и боялся... Надеюсь, теперь они не рискнут отправлять сюда шпионов.
english.end: Remove the disguise of 5 Nightborne Infiltrators.

text.title: 死亡矿井：血染大海
text.objectives: 为棘须船长收集$1oa条染血的迪菲亚头巾。
text.description: 啊，终于来人啦！我困在这鬼地方好多年月了，一个鬼影都没有，我只能自个儿跟自个儿聊天。终于看到个有精神气儿的家伙啦，好棒。你愿意替我报个仇吗？很多年前，这群迪菲亚暴徒干掉了我和我的水手，把这个洞据为己有。我打算去杀回来，这样才公平！记得拿点他们的东西回来，证明你干掉了那些强盗。我可以把那些玩意用来堵在污水泵上！
text.progress: Revenge is worth waitin' for. Not that I have much in the way of choice.
text.completion: Ha ha ha! I hope those rotten thugs rot in whatever pit of misery spawned them.

english.title: Deadmines: Sea'in Red
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Bloodied Defias Bandanas for Captain Bramblebeard.
english.description: Arr, finally! I been stuck up here f'years with naught company but me own thoughts. Tis good to clap me eyes on another swashbuckling soul. Are ye up for a plot of revenge and skullduggery? These meddlin' Defias thugs murdered  me and me crew years ago before they took over this cave. I propose a series of counter-murders to bring about balance! Bring me proof ye've dealt with enough of the thieves to clog a bilge pump!
english.progress: Revenge is worth waitin' for. Not that I have much in the way of choice.
english.completion: Ha ha ha! I hope those rotten thugs rot in whatever pit of misery spawned them.

text.title: 狩猎课：北地鹰喙猫头鹰
text.objectives: 在至高岭用你的雪羽雏龙击败3只北地鹰喙猫头鹰。
text.description:
<你一走近其他小动物，尤其是至高岭的鹰喙猫头鹰，你的雪羽雏龙就会激动起来。它会竖起羽毛，大声嘶鸣。看来它已经展露出原始的掠食本能。>

<看来你得把自己的隼龙带出去狩猎了。>
text.completion: <The hatchling seems quite content with its victories, and settles in for a nap. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Hunting Lesson: Northern Hawk Owls
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Northern Hawk Owls in Highmountain with your Snowfeather Hatchling.
english.description:
<Your snowfeather hatchling seems to get agitated when you are near other critters, none more so than the hawk owls of Highmountain. It fluffs up its plumage and squawks loudly whenever one is nearby. It appears to have a primal need for predation.> 

<It seems you will need to take your falcosaur out hunting.>
english.completion: <The hatchling seems quite content with its victories, and settles in for a nap. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 黑石深渊：深渊宝石
text.objectives: 前往黑石深渊，获取贝尔加的核心，洛考尔的核心，伊森迪奥斯的精华，玛格姆斯的精华。获得全部四件物品后，在黑石深渊底部靠近熔火之心入口的黑熔炉处，将它们融合在一起，然后把黑岩红宝石带回永望镇交给维撒克。
text.description: 欢迎来到永望镇。要看看我们的新式武器吗？$b$b你瞧，我的店不止是出售大规模杀伤性武器那么简单。我也热爱珍贵的宝石。$b$b有一颗宝石我已经眼馋了很久了，也许你我可以达成某种珠宝采购协议。我这里有一些上佳的锻造设计图，可以作为你辛劳工作的报酬。$b$b现在，我们来说说细节……
text.progress: This ain't no easy task. It's why the jewel's so rare, you see?
text.completion: Whoa, now that's a RUBY! I'd only ever seen one other of its kind in the world and now I have one.$B$BI tell ya, this is gonna make me stinkin' rich!$B$BBut uh, onto your payment. Here are those plans I was mentioning.

english.title: Blackrock Depths: Jewel of the Depths
english.objectives: Travel to Blackrock Depths and obtain a Core of Bael'Gar, Core of Roccor, Essence of Incendius, and Essence of Magmus. Once you have all four items, combine them at the Black Forge near the entrance to Molten Core at the bottom of Blackrock Depths and bring the Blackrock Ruby back to Wixxrak in Everlook.
english.description: Welcome to Everlook. Could I interest you in a new weapon of sorts?$b$bYou know, I'm not just into selling weapons of mass dismemberment here at the shop. I like rare jewels as well.$b$bPerhaps you and I can come to an arrangement of sorts in procuring a jewel I've had my eye on getting for quite some time. I have some great blacksmithing plans here you might be interested in, you know, in trade for your services.$b$bNow, onto the details...
english.progress: This ain't no easy task. It's why the jewel's so rare, you see?
english.completion: Whoa, now that's a RUBY! I'd only ever seen one other of its kind in the world and now I have one.$B$BI tell ya, this is gonna make me stinkin' rich!$B$BBut uh, onto your payment. Here are those plans I was mentioning.

text.title: 至高岭的盟友
text.objectives: 带着你的雪羽雏龙在至高岭完成5个世界任务。
text.description:
<你经过雷霆图腾时，雪羽雏龙发出一声深沉的咆哮。>

<高岭诸族立刻开始驱赶隼龙，想将它赶出他们的地盘。你的雏龙可能是把他们当成了威胁种群的坏人，那声咆哮或许是为了保护你。>

<用行动向你的隼龙证明，它可以跟高岭诸族和谐相处。>
text.completion: <The hatchling trills at the sight of Thunder Totem. That's quite an improvement! It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Allies in Highmountain
english.objectives: Complete 5 World Quests in Highmountain with your Snowfeather Hatchling out.
english.description:
<Your snowfeather hatchling emits a deep, chittering growl when you pass near Thunder Totem.> 

<The Highmountain Tribes immediately began attempting to evict the falcosaurs from their territory. It must consider them a threat to the flock, and the growl is probably its attempt to protect you.>

<Show your falcosaur that you and it can work alongside the Highmountain Tribes.>
english.completion: <The hatchling trills at the sight of Thunder Totem. That's quite an improvement! It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 雪羽小队
text.objectives: 用你的雪羽雏龙赢得3个宠物对战世界任务。
text.description:
<你的雪羽雏龙看了看你，发出抗议的叫声。它似乎是想参加集体活动！>

<为了有所领悟，开始战斗前，你的雏龙必须在你身边，必须是你的宠物里第一个进入战斗的，且不能在战斗中死亡。>
text.completion: <The hatchling rams you softly with its head and trills. It seems to like doing things with you quite a lot! It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Snowfeather Team Up
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Pet Battle World Quests with your Snowfeather Hatchling.
english.description:
<Your snowfeather hatchling looks at you and emits a sort of squawking bark. It appears to want to do something together as a team!>

<To learn, your hatchling must be at your side before you begin a battle, must be your first pet to enter the battle, and cannot die in battle.>
english.completion: <The hatchling rams you softly with its head and trills. It seems to like doing things with you quite a lot! It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 沙尔艾兰的访客
text.objectives: 找到沙尔艾兰外面的陌生人。
text.description: 你在城里的时候，有个人来到了沙尔艾兰，指名要见你。$b$b虽然我没见过她，也不熟悉她的声音，但是她看起来非常真诚可靠。$b$b她就在洞外面。去见见她，搞清她来这里的目的吧。
text.completion: She looked good. The Arcan'dor truly is a miracle for our people.$B$BShe is a welcome ally in the fight to come. Silgryn will take good care of her.

english.title: Visitor in Shal'Aran
english.objectives: Meet the stranger outside Shal'Aran.
english.description: Someone came to Shal'Aran while you were in the City. She asked for you specifically.$b$bI did not recognize her face, nor her voice, but she seemed trustworthy and earnest.$b$bShe is just outside the cavern. Meet with her and determine her purpose for coming here.
english.completion: Она полностью исцелена. Аркан'дор – настоящее сокровище для нашего народа.$b$bМы с радостью примем ее помощь в грядущей битве. Силгрин позаботится о ней.

text.title: 致命猎物
text.objectives: 带着你的雪羽雏龙完成1个稀有精英世界任务。
text.description: <经过最近在宠物对战时的配合，你的雪羽隼龙似乎对你的战斗技能特别感兴趣。如果能让它旁观你是怎么对抗强敌的，它或许能从中领悟到些什么。>
text.completion: <The hatchling looks at you with admiration. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Deadly Prey
english.objectives: Complete 1 Rare Elite World Quest with your Snowfeather Hatchling out.
english.description: <After working together on recent pet battles, your snowfeather falcosaur seems much more interested in your combat abilities. It might learn a thing or two from watching you do battle with a powerful opponent.>
english.completion: <The hatchling looks at you with admiration. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

objectiveDetails.description: 完成稀有精英世界任务

text.title: 狩猎课：针尾河狸
text.objectives: 用你的雪羽雏龙在至高岭击败3只针尾河狸。
text.description: <你的雪羽雏龙最近迷上了捕猎河狸。它肯定是又发现了一种新猎物。>
text.completion: <The hatchling looks more confident after besting those beavers, and settles in for a nap. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Hunting Lesson: Spiketail Beaver
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Spiketail Beavers in Highmountain with your Snowfeather Hatchling.
english.description: <Your snowfeather hatchling has been interested in following beaver tracks recently. It must have found a new species to prey upon.>
english.completion: <The hatchling looks more confident after besting those beavers, and settles in for a nap. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 仇人见面
text.objectives: 带着你的雪羽雏龙完成3个PvP世界任务。
text.description: <最近，你路过对立阵营的地盘时，你的雪羽雏龙一点都不害怕，径直就朝他们走过去了。它大概还不明白，对立阵营的人都是敌人。你最好在它惹出麻烦前先教教它。>
text.completion: <The hatchling emits a low hiss when you pass a member of the opposite faction. Mission accomplished! It will need to rest after this adventure.>

english.title: The Unfriendly Faction
english.objectives: Complete 3 PvP World Quests with your Snowfeather Hatchling out.
english.description: <When passing the other faction recently, your snowfeather walked right up to them without fear. It does not appear to understand that they are the enemy. Probably best to teach them before something bad happens.>
english.completion: <The hatchling emits a low hiss when you pass a member of the opposite faction. Mission accomplished! It will need to rest after this adventure.>

text.title: 雪羽的羁绊
text.objectives: 前往达拉然寻找苏珊娜·阿维罗，为你的雪羽雏龙购买一个小包裹。
text.description: <你的雪羽雏龙总是爱钻进你的背包里，把里面弄得乱糟糟。你把它揪出来，它还会大叫着用头撞你。也许你该给他弄个小包裹，分散一下它的注意力？>
text.progress: <Your snowfeather hatchling looks at you inquisitively.>
text.completion: <You feel a special bond form between you and the hatchling. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Snowfeather Bonding
english.objectives: Buy a Tiny Pack from Susana Averoy in Dalaran for your Snowfeather Hatchling.
english.description: <Your snowfeather hatchling keeps getting into your pack and making a mess. It squawks loudly whenever you remove it, and rams you with its head. Maybe you can distract it with a tiny pack of its own?>
english.progress: <Your snowfeather hatchling looks at you inquisitively.>
english.completion: <You feel a special bond form between you and the hatchling. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 狩猎课：泥壳蜗牛
text.objectives: 用你的雪羽雏龙和2只飞行类宠物击败3只至高岭的泥壳蜗牛。
text.description: <你的雪羽雏龙跟其他飞行宠物交上了朋友。它们好像对狩猎至高岭的蜗牛很有兴趣。>
text.completion: <The hatchling looks more confident in its abilities. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Hunting Lesson: Mudshell Conch
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Mudshell Conches in Highmountain with your Snowfeather Hatchling and 2 Flying pets.
english.description: <Your snowfeather hatchling has made friends with some of the other flying pets. The flock seems interested in hunting some of the snails of Highmountain.>
english.completion: <The hatchling looks more confident in its abilities. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 团队合作：纳拉萨斯
text.objectives: 带着你的雪羽雏龙，在至高岭击败奈萨里奥的巢穴中的纳拉萨斯。
text.description: <在最近几次战斗中，虽然最终赢得了胜利，但你的雪羽雏龙总在战斗时冲它的盟友大叫，还啄它们。让它瞧瞧，团队合作应该是什么样子的，这样也许有帮助。>
text.completion: <The hatchling looks like it might have absorbed some of that lesson, at least it enjoyed the trip. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Teamwork Lesson: Naraxas
english.objectives: Defeat Naraxas in Neltharion's Lair in Highmountain with your Snowfeather Hatchling out.
english.description: <While victorious, your snowfeather hatchling squawked and pecked at its allies during some of those last fights. Showing it a good example of teamwork might help.>
english.completion: <The hatchling looks like it might have absorbed some of that lesson, at least it enjoyed the trip. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 狩猎课：珊脊沙蟹
text.objectives: 用你的雪羽雏龙和2只元素类宠物击败至高岭的3只珊脊沙蟹。
text.description: <你的雪羽雏龙对你的元素类宠物特别有戒心。要让它们和睦相处，就得让它们学会合作。让它们一起狩猎新猎物的话，或许就能达成这个目的。>
text.completion: <The hatchling looks much more at ease around elementals now. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Hunting Lesson: Coralback Fiddler
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Coralback Fiddlers in Highmountain with your Snowfeather Hatchling and 2 Elemental pets.
english.description: <Your snowfeather hatchling is particularly wary of the elemental pets in your menagerie. They will need to learn to work together if they are to get along. Hunting together against the new prey it has begun stalking may just do the trick.>
english.completion: <The hatchling looks much more at ease around elementals now. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 交给你了
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛的特洛萨兰、凯尔巴洛和艾洛珊放置能量干扰器。
text.description: 瓦尔托伊已经有了计策，可以解决大殿的能量屏障。$b$b在苏拉玛的魔法回廊里有几个地方，属于为屏障供能的关键节点。她制作了一些能量干扰器，启动后就可以远程同时切断连接，关闭屏障。$b$b拿上这些装置，安装到魔网各处，然后回到这里，对大殿发动突袭。
text.completion: The preparations are nearly complete. Oculeth will be ready to teleport us soon.

english.title: I'll Just Leave This Here
english.objectives: Place Energy Disruptors at the energy sources in Teloth'aran, Kel'balor and Elor'shan in Suramar.
english.description: Valtrois has a plan for the Sanctum's energy barrier.$B$BSeveral key Arcway locations throughout Suramar harness the power necessary for it. These Energy Disruptors she made will remotely break the links simultaneously on activation, causing the barrier to fall.$b$bTake these devices and install them at the leylines, then return here for the surprise assault on the Sanctum.
english.completion: Совсем скоро мы будем готовы. И Окулет сможет нас телепортировать.

objectiveDetails.description: 在艾洛珊放置能量干扰器
在凯尔巴洛放置能量干扰器
在特洛萨兰放置能量干扰器

text.title: 团队合作：乌索克
text.objectives: 带着你的雏龙击败翡翠梦魇的乌索克。
text.description: <你的雪羽雏龙一受到威胁，就会跟其他宠物打作一团。它得学会顶住压力，保持冷静，哪怕是要面对那些巨兽。与一头巨兽打一场史诗之战，展示一下团队合作精神，这样它可能就会明白。>
text.completion: <The hatchling positively beams at you in pride for defeating such a frightening foe. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Teamwork Lesson: Ursoc
english.objectives: Defeat Ursoc in the Emerald Nightmare with your Snowfeather Hatchling out.
english.description: <Your snowfeather hatchling continues to fight with other pets when threatened. It must learn to remain calm under pressure, even when facing great beasts. Showing it an epic example of teamwork against a great beast might help.>
english.completion: <The hatchling positively beams at you in pride for defeating such a frightening foe. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 雪羽小队大乱斗
text.objectives: 用你的雪羽雏龙和2只亡灵类宠物完成3个宠物对战世界任务。
text.description: <你的雪羽雏龙看起来已经准备好与你一起迎接新的战斗，并展示它学会的合作技巧了。指挥它和新盟友一起战斗，好好测试一下它的能力吧。>
text.completion: <The hatchling looks proud of itself and preens after the victory. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Snowfeather Team Rumble
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Pet Battle World Quests with your Snowfeather Hatchling and 2 Undead pets.
english.description: <Your snowfeather hatchling looks ready to team up with you for another round of battles and show off everything it has learned about teamwork. Commanding it with new allies would be an excellent test of its abilities.>
english.completion: <The hatchling looks proud of itself and preens after the victory. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 雪羽家族团聚
text.objectives: 把雪羽雏龙送回至高岭的迷雾海岸。
text.description: <你的雪羽雏龙最近无精打采。它似乎很沮丧。或许该送它回到出生地了？>

english.title: Snowfeather Reunion
english.objectives: Return the Snowfeather Hatchling to the Misty Coast in Highmountain.
english.description: <Your snowfeather hatchling has been lethargic as of late. It seems to be depressed. Perhaps it is time to return it to its place of origin?>

objectiveDetails.description: 雪羽雏龙回到迷雾海岸

text.title: The Smell of Orcs
text.objectives: Take your Snowfeather Hatchling to the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar.
text.description: <You've noticed that your snowfeather hatchling shakes whenever orcs are nearby. It appears to be utterly terrified of them. Perhaps you could take it somewhere with a lot of orcs, so that it can get used to the smell.>
text.completion: <The hatchling seems to be more comfortable around the sights and sounds of an orc city. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.completion: <The hatchling struts around happily, clearing showing off. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.completion: <The hatchling struts around happily, clearing showing off. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.description: <你发现只要有矮人靠近，这只恐嘴雏龙就会瑟瑟发抖。看来它真的很怕矮人。或许你能把它带到矮人聚集的地方，让它习惯这种气味。>
text.completion: <The hatchling seems to be more comfortable around the sights and sounds of a dwarven city. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 狩猎课：紫红泰斑蛇
text.objectives: 用你的恐嘴雏龙击败3条风暴峡湾的紫红泰斑蛇。
text.description:
<你一走近其他小动物，尤其是风暴峡湾的紫红泰斑蛇，你的恐嘴雏龙就会激动起来。它会竖起羽毛，大声嘶鸣。看来它已经展露出原始的掠食本能。>

<你大概得把自己的隼龙带出去狩猎了。>
text.completion: <The hatchling seems quite content with its victories, and claws at your leg until you sit down and create a lap it can sit on. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Hunting Lesson: Rose Taipan
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Rose Taipans in Stormheim with your Direbeak Hatchling.
english.description:
<Your direbeak hatchling seems to get agitated when you are near other critters, none more so than the rose taipans of Stormheim. It squawks loudly and slams its beak into the dirt whenever one is nearby. It appears to have a primal need for predation.> 

<It seems you will need to take your falcosaur out hunting.>
english.completion: <The hatchling seems quite content with its victories, and claws at your leg until you sit down and create a lap it can sit on. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 风暴峡湾的盟友
text.objectives: 带着你的恐嘴雏龙在风暴峡湾完成5个世界任务。
text.description:
<你的恐嘴雏龙刨着地面，死瞪着一个瓦拉加尔，这个瓦拉加尔有它的十倍大。>

<瓦拉加尔一定是把隼龙当成了某种新出现的美味猎物，立刻就开始猎捕隼龙了。虽然它们是破碎群岛出现的新物种，却已经害怕起风暴峡湾的居民了。>

<用行动向你的隼龙证明，它可以跟瓦拉加尔和谐相处。>
text.completion: <The hatchling no longer cowers behind you when the storms crackle in Stormheim. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Allies in Stormheim
english.objectives: Complete 5 World Quests in Stormheim with your Direbeak Hatchling out.
english.description:
<Your direbeak hatchling scratches the ground and stares down a member of the Valarjar more than ten times its size.> 

<The Valarjar must have seen the falcosaurs as an excellent new source of meat, and begun hunting them immediately. Though a new species to the Broken Isles, it already fears the inhabitants of Stormheim.>

<Show your falcosaur that you and it can work alongside the Valarjar.>
english.completion: <The hatchling no longer cowers behind you when the storms crackle in Stormheim. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 恐嘴小队
text.objectives: 用你的恐嘴雏龙完成3个宠物对战世界任务。
text.description:
<你的恐嘴雏龙咬了咬你。它似乎是想参加集体活动！>

<为了有所领悟，开始战斗前，你的雏龙必须在你身边，必须是你的宠物里第一个进入战斗的，且不能在战斗中死亡。>
text.completion: <The hatchling nips at your feet excitedly. It seems to like doing things with you quite a lot! It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Direbeak Team Up
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Pet Battle World Quests with your Direbeak Hatchling.
english.description:
<Your direbeak hatchling bites you. It appears to want to do something together as a team!>

<To learn, your hatchling must be at your side before you begin a battle, must be your first pet to enter the battle, and cannot die in battle.>
english.completion: <The hatchling nips at your feet excitedly. It seems to like doing things with you quite a lot! It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 可怕的猎物
text.objectives: 带着你的恐嘴雏龙完成1个稀有精英世界任务。
text.description: <在第二场战斗中，你的恐嘴雏龙差点把你绊倒。它很想学习怎么击败致命的生物。如果能让它旁观你是怎么对抗强敌的，它或许能从中领悟到些什么。>
text.completion: <The hatchling looks at you with interest. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Dire Prey
english.objectives: Complete 1 Rare Elite World Quest with your Direbeak Hatchling out.
english.description: <Your direbeak falcosaur nearly trips you the next time you enter combat. It is eager to learn more about how to defeat deadly creatures. It might learn a thing or two from watching you do battle with a powerful opponent.>
english.completion: <The hatchling looks at you with interest. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

objectiveDetails.description: 完成稀有精英世界任务

text.title: 狩猎课：小幽灵
text.objectives: 用你的恐嘴雏龙击败3个风暴峡湾的小幽灵。
text.description: <你的恐嘴雏龙似乎能看见你看不到的猎物，有时候会盯着一堵墙好几小时。它要么是发现了一种新猎物，要么就是蜜酒喝多了。>
text.completion: <Your direbeak certainly doesn't look afraid of ghosts. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Hunting Lesson: Tiny Apparition
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Tiny Apparitions in Stormheim with your Direbeak Hatchling.
english.description: <Your direbeak hatchling seems to see prey that you cannot, sometimes staring at a wall for hours at a time. It must have found a new species to prey upon, or gotten into some mead.>
english.completion: <Your direbeak certainly doesn't look afraid of ghosts. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 八字不合
text.objectives: 带着你的恐嘴雏龙完成3个PvP世界任务。
text.description: <最近，你路过对立阵营的地盘时，你的恐嘴雏龙朝他们大叫，讨要食物。它大概还不明白，对立阵营的人都是敌人。你最好在它惹出麻烦前先教教它。>
text.completion: <The hatchling scratches the ground aggressively when you pass a member of the opposite faction. Mission accomplished! It will need to rest after this adventure.>

english.title: The Unkindly Faction
english.objectives: Complete 3 PvP World Quests with your Direbeak Hatchling out.
english.description: <When passing the other faction recently, your direbeak squawked at them for food. It does not appear to understand that they are the enemy. Probably best to teach them before something bad happens.>
english.completion: <The hatchling scratches the ground aggressively when you pass a member of the opposite faction. Mission accomplished! It will need to rest after this adventure.>

text.title: 恐嘴的羁绊
text.objectives: 前往达拉然找发条助手，为你的恐嘴雏龙购买一副假牙。
text.description: <你的恐嘴雏龙竖起身上的羽毛，对你低声咆哮，宣示自己的权威。但它对结果不太满意，因为你没有吓得瑟瑟发抖。也许它想要打扮成成年隼龙再试一次。>
text.progress: <Your direbeak hatchling looks at you inquisitively.>
text.completion: <You feel a special bond form between you and the hatchling. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Direbeak Bonding
english.objectives: Buy a pair of Fake Teeth from Clockwork Assistant in Dalaran for your Direbeak Hatchling.
english.description: <Your direbeak hatchling puffs up its feathers and growls at you in a display of dominance. It seems unhappy with the results, as you are not cowering in fear. It might like to dress up like a grown-up falcosaur and try again.>
english.progress: <Your direbeak hatchling looks at you inquisitively.>
english.completion: <You feel a special bond form between you and the hatchling. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 狩猎课：金色小鹰
text.objectives: 用你的恐嘴雏龙和2只飞行类宠物击败3只风暴峡湾的金色小鹰。
text.description: <你的恐嘴雏龙跟其他飞行宠物交上了朋友。它们好像对狩猎风暴峡湾的鹰很有兴趣。>
text.completion: <The hatchling builds a small nest of eaglet feathers, and settles in for a nap. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Hunting Lesson: Golden Eaglet
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Golden Eaglets in Stormheim with your Direbeak Hatchling and 2 Flying pets.
english.description: <Your direbeak hatchling has made friends with some of the other flying pets. The flock seems interested in hunting some of the eagles of Stormheim.>
english.completion: <The hatchling builds a small nest of eaglet feathers, and settles in for a nap. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 团队合作：芬雷尔
text.objectives: 带着你的恐嘴雏龙，在风暴峡湾击败英灵殿的芬雷尔。
text.description: <在前几次战斗中，你的恐嘴雏龙很害羞，总是躲着其他的飞行宠物。让它瞧瞧，团队合作应该是什么样子的，这样也许有帮助。>
text.completion: <The hatchling has taken a large puff of wolf fur for its nest, and you're not entirely sure where it was concealing it. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Teamwork Lesson: Fenryr
english.objectives: Defeat Fenryr in Halls of Valor in Stormheim with your Direbeak Hatchling out.
english.description: <Your direbeak hatchling timidly avoided the other flying pets during their last battles together. Showing it a good example of teamwork might help.>
english.completion: <The hatchling has taken a large puff of wolf fur for its nest, and you're not entirely sure where it was concealing it. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 狩猎课：风暴海狸
text.objectives: 用你的恐嘴雏龙和2只机械类宠物击败3只风暴海狸。
text.description: <你每次经过声音嘈杂的机器，你的恐嘴雏龙就会警戒地看着它。你不禁怀疑，它以前是不是跟机械类宠物有什么过节。要让它们和睦相处，就得让它们学会合作。让它们一起狩猎新猎物的话，或许就能达成这个目的。>
text.completion: <The hatchling looks much more at ease around machines now. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Hunting Lesson: Stormstruck Beaver
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Stormstruck Beavers in Stormheim with your Direbeak Hatchling and 2 Mechanical pets.
english.description: <Your direbeak hatchling looks warily at any loud piece of machinery you pass. You begin to wonder if something transpired between it and a mechanical pet at one point. They will need to learn to work together if they are to get along. Hunting together against the new prey it has begun stalking may just do the trick.>
english.completion: <The hatchling looks much more at ease around machines now. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 团队合作：克洛苏斯
text.objectives: 带着你的恐嘴雏龙击败暗夜要塞的克洛苏斯。
text.description: <你的恐嘴雏龙只要看到巨兽，就会惊慌大叫，哪怕那些生物并无敌意。它得学会顶住压力，保持冷静，哪怕是要面对那些巨兽。与一头巨兽打一场史诗之战，展示一下团队合作精神，这样它可能就会明白。>
text.completion: <The hatchling growls at you possessively. It seems... proud? It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Teamwork Lesson: Krosus
english.objectives: Defeat Krosus in the Nighthold with your Direbeak Hatchling out.
english.description: <Your direbeak hatchling squawks loudly and panics when very large creatures are nearby, even if they are friendly. It must learn to remain calm under pressure, even when facing creatures many times its size. Showing it an epic example of teamwork against a monster the size of a mountain might help.>
english.completion: <The hatchling growls at you possessively. It seems... proud? It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 恐嘴小队大乱斗
text.objectives: 用你的恐嘴雏龙和2只人形类宠物完成3个宠物对战世界任务。
text.description: <你的恐嘴雏龙看起来已经准备好与你一起迎接新的战斗，并展示它学会的合作技巧了。指挥它和新盟友一起战斗，好好测试一下它的能力吧。>
text.completion: <The hatchling somehow still has energy, and runs off to play with your other pets. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Direbeak Team Rumble
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Pet Battle World Quests with your Direbeak Hatchling and 2 Humanoid pets.
english.description: <Your direbeak hatchling looks ready to team up with you for another round of battles and show off everything it has learned about teamwork. Commanding it with new allies would be an excellent test of its abilities.>
english.completion: <The hatchling somehow still has energy, and runs off to play with your other pets. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 恐嘴家族团聚
text.objectives: 把恐嘴雏龙送回风暴峡湾的海鸥岩。
text.description: <你的恐嘴雏龙不断发出轻柔、忧郁的叫声。它似乎很沮丧。或许该送它回到出生地了？>

english.title: Direbeak Reunion
english.objectives: Return the Direbeak Hatchling to Gull Rock in Stormheim.
english.description: <Your direbeak hatchling won't stop emitting soft, melancholy squawks. It seems to be depressed. Perhaps it is time to return it to its place of origin?>

text.title: 养育你的利爪雏龙
text.objectives: 把你的利爪雏龙提升到25级。
text.description: <你的利爪雏龙靠在你身边，不断瑟瑟发抖。它瞪大眼睛，眨也不眨地盯着你，似乎希望你能帮助它活下来，并健康长大。>
text.completion: <The hatchling is no longer shaking and clinging to your side. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Raising Your Sharptalon
english.objectives: Raise your Sharptalon Hatchling to level 25.
english.description: <Your sharptalon hatchling continues to shiver as it settles in at your side. It looks up at you with wide, unblinking eyes. It appears to be looking to you to help it survive and grow.>
english.completion: <The hatchling is no longer shaking and clinging to your side. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 养育你的血眼雏龙
text.objectives: 把你的血眼雏龙提升到25级。
text.description: <你的血眼雏龙好奇地看着你，歪着头发出低沉的叫声，似乎希望你能帮助它活下来，并健康长大。>
text.completion: <The hatchling looks strong and confident. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Raising Your Bloodgazer
english.objectives: Raise your Bloodgazer Hatchling to level 25.
english.description: <Your bloodgazer hatchling looks at you curiously, cocking its head to the side and emitting a low whistle. It appears to be looking to you to help it survive and grow.>
english.completion: <The hatchling looks strong and confident. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 德莱尼的气味
text.objectives: 带着你的血眼雏龙前往埃索达的旅店。
text.description: <你发现只要有德莱尼靠近，这只血眼雏龙就会瑟瑟发抖。看来它真的很怕德莱尼。或许你能把它带到德莱尼聚集的地方，让它习惯这种气味。>
text.completion: <The hatchling seems to be more comfortable around the sights and sounds of a draenei city. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: The Smell of Draenei
english.objectives: Take your Bloodgazer Hatchling to the Inn in the Exodar.
english.description: <You've noticed that your bloodgazer hatchling shakes whenever draenei are nearby. It appears to be utterly terrified of them. Perhaps you could take it somewhere with a lot of draenei, so that it can get used to the smell.>
english.completion: <The hatchling seems to be more comfortable around the sights and sounds of a draenei city. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

objectiveDetails.description: 让血眼雏龙适应德莱尼环境

text.title: 暗夜精灵的气味
text.objectives: 带着你的利爪雏龙前往达纳苏斯的旅店。
text.description: <你发现只要有暗夜精灵靠近，这只利爪雏龙就会瑟瑟发抖。看来它真的很怕暗夜精灵。或许你能把它带到暗夜精灵聚集的地方，让它习惯这种气味。>
text.completion: <The hatchling seems to be more comfortable around the sights and sounds of a night elf city. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: The Smell of Night Elves
english.objectives: Take your Sharptalon Hatchling to the Inn in Darnassus.
english.description: <You've noticed that your sharptalon hatchling shakes whenever night elves are nearby. It appears to be utterly terrified of them. Perhaps you could take it somewhere with a lot of night elves, so that it can get used to the smell.>
english.completion: <The hatchling seems to be more comfortable around the sights and sounds of a night elf city. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

objectiveDetails.description: 让利爪雏龙适应暗夜精灵的环境

text.title: 血精灵的气味
text.objectives: 带着你的血眼雏龙前往银月城的银月城旅店。
text.description: <你发现只要有血精灵靠近，这只血眼雏龙就会瑟瑟发抖。看来它真的很怕血精灵。或许你能把它带到血精灵聚集的地方，让它习惯这种气味。>
text.completion: <The hatchling seems to be more comfortable around the sights and sounds of a blood elf city. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: The Smell of Blood Elves
english.objectives: Take your Bloodgazer Hatchling to the Silvermoon City Inn in Silvermoon.
english.description: <You've noticed that your bloodgazer hatchling shakes whenever blood elves are nearby. It appears to be utterly terrified of them. Perhaps you could take it somewhere with a lot of blood elves, so that it can get used to the smell.>
english.completion: <The hatchling seems to be more comfortable around the sights and sounds of a blood elf city. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

objectiveDetails.description: 让血眼雏龙适应血精灵环境

text.title: 亡灵的气味
text.objectives: 带着你的利爪雏龙前往幽暗城的旅店。
text.description: <你发现只要有被遗忘者靠近，这只利爪雏龙就会瑟瑟发抖。看来它真的很怕被遗忘者。或许你能把它带到被遗忘者聚集的地方，让它习惯这种气味。>
text.completion: <The hatchling seems to be more comfortable around the sights and sounds of a forsaken city. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: The Smell of Undead
english.objectives: Take your Sharptalon Hatchling to the Inn in Undercity.
english.description: <You've noticed that your sharptalon hatchling shakes whenever forsaken are nearby. It appears to be utterly terrified of them. Perhaps you could take it somewhere with a lot of forsaken, so that it can get used to the smell.>
english.completion: <The hatchling seems to be more comfortable around the sights and sounds of a forsaken city. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

objectiveDetails.description: 让利爪雏龙适应被遗忘者的环境

text.title: 狩猎课：泉眼水黾
text.objectives: 用你的利爪雏龙击败瓦尔莎拉的3只泉眼水黾。
text.description:
<你一走近其他小动物，尤其是瓦尔莎拉的泉眼水黾，你的利爪雏龙就会激动起来。它会竖起羽毛，大声嘶鸣。看来它已经展露出原始的掠食本能。>

<你大概得把自己的隼龙带出去狩猎了。>
text.completion: <The hatchling seems quite content with its victories, and butts you with its head lovingly. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Hunting Lesson: Spring Strider
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Spring Striders in Val'sharah with your Sharptalon Hatchling.
english.description:
<Your sharptalon hatchling seems to get agitated when you are near other critters, especially the spring striders of Val'sharah. It fluffs up its plumage and scratches the ground whenever one is nearby. It appears to have a primal need for predation.> 

<It seems you will need to take your falcosaur out hunting.>
english.completion: <The hatchling seems quite content with its victories, and butts you with its head lovingly. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 狩猎课：博学的嗜魔者
text.objectives: 用你的血眼雏龙击败阿苏纳的3只博学的嗜魔者。
text.description:
<你一走近其他小动物，尤其是阿苏纳的博学的嗜魔者，你的血眼雏龙就会激动起来。它会竖起羽毛，大声嘶鸣。看来它已经展露出原始的掠食本能。>

<你大概得把自己的隼龙带出去狩猎了。>
text.completion: <The hatchling seems quite content with its victories, and clucks happily at you. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Hunting Lesson: Erudite Manafiend
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Erudite Manafiends in Azsuna with your Bloodgazer Hatchling.
english.description:
<Your bloodgazer hatchling seems to get agitated when you are near other critters, none more so than the erudite manafiends of Azsuna. It makes an odd, low clucking noise and spreads its wings whenever one is nearby. It appears to have a primal need for predation.> 

<It seems you will need to take your falcosaur out hunting.>
english.completion: <The hatchling seems quite content with its victories, and clucks happily at you. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 瓦尔莎拉的盟友
text.objectives: 带着你的利爪雏龙在瓦尔莎拉完成5个世界任务。
text.description:
<你靠近瓦尔莎拉时，你的利爪雏龙怎么都不肯跟你一起进去。>

<虽然织梦者敬重大自然，但他们也得维持自然的平衡。他们注意到这些隼龙的侵略性后，曾采取一些过暴力措施。瓦尔莎拉的德鲁伊很可能屠杀了它族群里的一些同伴。>

<用行动向你的隼龙证明，它可以跟织梦者和谐相处。>
text.completion: <The hatchling no longer shivers when entering the dense foliage of Val'sharah. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Allies in Val'sharah
english.objectives: Complete 5 World Quests in Val'sharah with your Sharptalon Hatchling out.
english.description:
<Your sharptalon hatchling stubbornly refuses to enter Val'sharah when you approach.> 

<Though they revere nature, the Dreamweavers also must maintain the balance of nature, and began an aggressive campaign against the falcosaurs once their invasiveness was noted. It has likely seen the druids of Val'sharah slaughter some members of its flock.>

<Show your falcosaur that you and it can work alongside the Dreamweavers.>
english.completion: <The hatchling no longer shivers when entering the dense foliage of Val'sharah. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 阿苏纳的盟友
text.objectives: 带着你的血眼雏龙在阿苏纳完成5个世界任务。
text.description:
<你的血眼雏龙害怕得叫了起来，你感觉到阿苏纳的幽灵就在附近。>

<你的宠物肯定觉得，阿苏纳的精灵幽灵很奇怪，不自然。所以它本能地害怕他们。>

<用行动向你的隼龙证明，它可以跟法罗迪斯宫廷和谐相处。>
text.completion: <The hatchling is more curious than afraid of the ghosts in Azsuna now. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Allies in Azsuna
english.objectives: Complete 5 World Quests in Azsuna with your Bloodgazer Hatchling out.
english.description:
<Your bloodgazer hatchling emits a terrified squawk, and you sense the spirits of Azsuna are nearby.> 

<The spirits of the elves of Azsuna must seem strange and unnatural to your pet. It may instinctively fear them.>

<Show your falcosaur that you and it can work alongside the spirits of the Court of Farondis.>
english.completion: <The hatchling is more curious than afraid of the ghosts in Azsuna now. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 利爪小队
text.objectives: 用你的利爪雏龙完成3个宠物对战世界任务。
text.description:
<你的利爪雏龙兴奋地扇着翅膀，朝你大叫。它似乎是想参加集体活动！>

<为了有所领悟，开始战斗前，你的雏龙必须在你身边，必须是你的宠物里第一个进入战斗的，且不能在战斗中死亡。>
text.completion: <The hatchling emits a loud "baroo!" It seems to like doing things with you quite a lot! It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

english.title: Sharptalon Team Up
english.objectives: Defeat 3 Pet Battle World Quests with your Sharptalon Hatchling.
english.description:
<Your sharptalon hatchling flaps its wings excitedly and squawks at you. It appears to want to do something together as a team!>

<To learn, your hatchling must be at your side before you begin a battle, must be your first pet to enter the battle, and cannot die in battle.>
english.completion: <The hatchling emits a loud "baroo!" It seems to like doing things with you quite a lot! It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 血眼小队
text.objectives: 用你的血眼雏龙完成3个宠物对战世界任务。
text.description:
<你的血眼雏龙在你脚边转来转去，差点把你绊倒。它似乎是想参加集体活动！>

<为了有所领悟，开始战斗前，你的雏龙必须在你身边，必须是你的宠物里第一个进入战斗的，且不能在战斗中死亡。>

<Your bloodgazer hatchling runs in a circle around your feet, nearly tripping you. It appears to want to do something together as a team!>

english.completion: <The hatchling beams at you. It seems to like doing things with you quite a lot! It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

text.title: 未知的答案
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳找到裘碧卡·碎影。
text.description: 你有没有注意到，裘碧卡最近变了很多？我知道她一向冷漠，但她最近似乎变得更加沉默寡言了。$b$b我猜她还在想着议会前首领坎雷萨德。裘碧卡之前一直坚定地认为应该继续放逐他，直到她被燃烧军团所俘虏，成为了他们的阶下囚。$b$b没人知道他的命运如何，而这显然让我们的朋友感到不安了。她告诉我的最后一件事，是她在阿苏纳发现了他的踪迹。别让她独自踏上这段旅程。
text.completion: Shinfel should not have told you of my suspicions. This is my burden to bear.$B$BNevertheless, I am glad you are here. It would seem my fears are founded.

english.title: Answers Unknown
english.objectives: Find Jubeka Shadowbreaker within Azsuna.
english.description: Have you noticed a change in Jubeka's demeanor? I know she's not the warmest of warlocks, but I fear she's been more withdrawn than usual.$B$BI imagine her mind lingers on Kanrethad, the council's one-time leader. Jubeka was steadfast in her commitment to keeping him banished, until the Burning Legion took her as their prisoner.$B$BHis fate is unknown, and it's clearly troubling our friend. The last thing she said to me, was that she felt his presence in Azsuna. Don't let her travel this path alone.
english.completion: Shinfel should not have told you of my suspicions. This is my burden to bear.$B$BNevertheless, I am glad you are here. It would seem my fears are founded.

text.title: 铲除邪教
text.objectives: 进入邪火洞窟，消灭绿火教派的成员。
text.description: 坎雷萨德的诱惑很强。即使他不在这个世界，依然有人想不惜代价地接近他，分享他的力量。$b$b法罗纳尔这就有这么一群狂热分子在孜孜不倦地想让坎雷萨德回归。这都是我从俘虏口中得知的。$b$b我们不能让他们得逞，$n。去找到他们的营地，然后大开杀戒吧。$b$b我会留在这里，看看能不能搞清他们的其他企图。
text.completion: Can it be true? Does some sliver of my friend remain within that wretched demon?

english.title: Cult Culling

english.description: The lure of Kanrethad is strong. Even when not in this world, there are those who wish to be near him at any cost, hoping to share in his power.$B$BA group of these fanatics are here in Faronaar, working tirelessly to bring Kanrethad back, I've learned as much from my prisoner.$B$BWe cannot let them succeed, $n. Find their compound and kill as many of them as you can.$B$BI will remain here and see what else I can learn about their intentions.
english.completion: Can it be true? Does some sliver of my friend remain within that wretched demon?

text.title: 窃取力量之源
text.objectives: 收集5个邪能水晶。
text.description:
我的俘虏很多嘴，$n。他告诉我，绿火教派正在驾驭邪能，想用它结束坎雷萨德的放逐。

他们正在营地里给邪能水晶供能，用它们储存大量的邪能魔力。如果没有足够的力量来举行仪式，神秘学者就很难成功。

去偷走他们的邪能水晶，但不要将其摧毁。这么强大的东西，我们总能用得上。
text.progress: Have you obtained the fel crystals?
text.completion: Excellent work, as always, Netherlord. This should certainly buy us some time.

english.title: Stealing the Source of Power
english.objectives: Collect 5 Fel Crystals.
english.description:
My prisoner is a chatty one, $n. He tells me that the Cult of the Green Flame is harnessing fel energy to fuel their efforts of bringing Kanrethad back from banishment.

Within their compound they are powering fel crystals that can hold a great amount of fel magic. Without the proper power to perform their ritual, the occultists will have a tough time succeeding in their task.

Steal their fel crystals, but don't destroy them. We can always find a use for something so powerful.
english.progress: Тебе удалось добыть кристаллы Скверны?
english.completion: Excellent work, as always, Netherlord. This should certainly buy us some time.

text.title: 消耗邪能
text.objectives: 驾驭邪能水晶的力量，并使用它们的能量消灭法罗纳尔的恶魔。
text.description:
对坎雷萨德的放逐很快就会结束，他也会回到我们的世界。

我们必须不惜一切代价，防止燃烧军团染指他和他的力量。

如果我的老朋友依然健在，也许我们可以把他救回来。

你拿到的水晶能吸收邪能。我们可以利用这个特性，把吞噬了坎雷萨德的魔法吸走。

但是首先，我们必须先耗尽它们的能量。为此，你可以驾驭水晶的力量，用它们的能量来消灭恶魔。
text.progress: Have the crystals been depleted?
text.completion: Thank you, Netherlord. I will keep these crystals safe until they are needed.$B$BWhen we find Kanrethad, we will be ready.

english.title: Expending Fel Energy
english.objectives: Harness the power of the Fel Crystals and expend their energy by killing demons within Faronaar.
english.description:
Soon Kanrethad's banishment will fade, and he will return to our world. 

We must keep him, and his power, out of the Legion's hands at any cost.

If my old friend is still in there somewhere, perhaps we can bring him back.

The crystals you recovered feed on fel energy. We can use the ravenous crystals to siphon away the magic that consumes Kanrethad.

But first, their power must be depleted. To do so, you will need to harness the power of the crystals and use their energy to kill demons.
english.progress: Кристаллы опустошены?
english.completion: Thank you, Netherlord. I will keep these crystals safe until they are needed.$B$BWhen we find Kanrethad, we will be ready.

text.title: 前往破碎海滩
text.objectives: 前往破碎海滩。
text.description: 看来坎雷萨德的扭曲信徒已经开始在破碎海滩上举行仪式了。$b$b我们必须马上行动，绝不能让坎雷萨德变成燃烧军团的武器。$b$b我们的助祭正在待命，只要你准备好了，就可以在破碎海滩进行召唤仪式。
text.completion: You're here, Netherlord! Quickly, there's no time to lose!

english.title: To the Broken Shore
english.objectives: Head to the Broken Shore.
english.description: It would seem that Kanrethad's twisted followers have begun their ritual on the Broken Shore.$B$BWe must act quickly. The Burning Legion cannot be allowed to use Kanrethad as their weapon.$B$BWe have acolytes on standby, ready to perform a ritual of summoning on the Broken Shore when you're ready.
english.completion: You're here, Netherlord! Quickly, there's no time to lose!

text.title: 坎雷萨德的命运
text.objectives: 使用邪能水晶吸取坎雷萨德身上的邪能。
text.description: 我能感觉到他的存在，虚空领主！坎雷萨德就在这里！他的信徒在附近的小径旁设立了营地。此时此刻，他们正在进行仪式，想把他召唤回来。$b$b快，拿上这些邪能水晶，在坎雷萨德周围摆成一圈。$b$b如果摆放的位置正确，水晶就会连接起来，并开始吸收邪能。$b$b去吧，晚了就来不及了！
text.completion: I have lived with a heavy heart since the day I fulfilled my promise to banish Kanrethad. I never thought I'd live to see the day he would be returned to us.$B$BI thank you, Netherlord. You have lifted the burden of guilt from my shoulders, and in doing so, prevented the Legion from gaining control of one of our own.

english.title: The Fate of Kanrethad
english.objectives: Use the Fel Crystals to siphon fel energy from Kanrethad.
english.description: I can feel his presence, Netherlord! Kanrethad is here! His followers have set up camp in the nearby pass, and are performing the ritual to bring him back as we speak.$B$BQuickly, take the fel crystals. Arrange them in a circle around Kanrethad.$B$BIf placed correctly, the crystals should link together and begin to siphon the fel energy.$B$BNow go, before it's too late!
english.completion: I have lived with a heavy heart since the day I fulfilled my promise to banish Kanrethad. I never thought I'd live to see the day he would be returned to us.$B$BI thank you, Netherlord. You have lifted the burden of guilt from my shoulders, and in doing so, prevented the Legion from gaining control of one of our own.

text.title: The Call of Battle
text.description:
These demons have no honor! Rather than meet us in glorious, open-battle; they hide behind their barricades and siege weapons.

The Valarjar have come for the glory of battle and we will not be turned away by cowardly tactics!

Destroy their cannons and bring down their barriers, so that our valiant Valarjar may face them in the true spirit of battle! When the dust of battle clears, the corpses of demons shall litter the ground... and the Valarjar will stand triumphant!

english.title: The Call of Battle
english.description:
These demons have no honor! Rather than meet us in glorious, open-battle; they hide behind their barricades and siege weapons.

The Valarjar have come for the glory of battle and we will not be turned away by cowardly tactics!

Destroy their cannons and bring down their barriers, so that our valiant Valarjar may face them in the true spirit of battle! When the dust of battle clears, the corpses of demons shall litter the ground... and the Valarjar will stand triumphant!

text.title: 残损武器
text.objectives: 把严重损坏的黑暗长矛带给安戈洛环形山的覆苔营地的考赞。
text.description: 你发现的长矛绝对带有某些巨魔的设计特征，是另一种锻造工艺的产物。$b$b也许安戈洛环形山这里的某个营地里有人对此有更多的了解。
text.completion: Ay mon, whatcha got der in your hands?$B$BDat be da Darkspear! Ya found it?!

english.title: Weapon No More
english.objectives: Bring the Badly Broken Dark Spear to Ko'Zan at Mossy Pile in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: The spear you found certainly has the makings of troll designs from other blacksmithing crafts.$b$bPerhaps somebody at one of the camps here in Un'Goro will know more about it.
english.completion: Ay mon, whatcha got der in your hands?$B$BDat be da Darkspear! Ya found it?!

objectiveDetails.description: 与大法师克萨伦谈一谈
与大法师克萨伦谈一谈

text.title: Infiltration Plans
text.objectives: Take the plans to the Council of the Six in Dalaran.
text.description: While the text is hard to follow and covered in demonic runes, it appears to be plans to infiltrate Dalaran. The Council of the Six will want to see this.

english.title: Infiltration Plans
english.objectives: Take the plans to the Council of the Six in Dalaran.
english.description: While the text is hard to follow and covered in demonic runes, it appears to be plans to infiltrate Dalaran. The Council of the Six will want to see this.

text.title: 逆向锻造
text.objectives: 拆解损坏的黑暗长矛。
text.description: 我还以为再也见不到这东西了！$b$b虽然它已经不是以前的样子了。啊，兄弟，我如果拿着这东西露面的话，会有大麻烦的。$b$b你可以帮我修理一下吗？我没有设计图，因为，你看，我来这里的第一天夜里，那些生物就过来把我的东西都偷走了。$b$b你觉得怎么样？帮兄弟一把好吗？$b$b如果你弄明白了它的材料，就可以修好它了。我可以把它的材料细节写下来。
text.completion: Dem's some mighty fine materials dat was made of. No wonda' da boss wants it so bad.

english.title: Reverse Blacksmithing
english.objectives: Deconstruct the Broken Darkspear.
english.description: And 'ere I thought I'd never see dis ting again!$b$bAlthough, it don't look like it used to. Aw mon, I'm gonna be in big trouble if I show up wit dis in my hand.$b$bDo ya tink you could help me fix it? I don't have da plans for it, cause you see, da first night I spent here, da creatures came up and stole all me tings.$b$bBut whadd'ya say? Help a bruddah out?$b$bI tink if you can figure out what it's made from, den you can fix it and I can write down da details on how it's made.
english.completion: Dem's some mighty fine materials dat was made of. No wonda' da boss wants it so bad.

text.title: 以牙还牙
text.objectives: 消灭安戈洛环形山的生物，获得$1oa个偷来的魔化瑟银锭，$2oa个半吊子的强力魔精，$3oa片钙化双帆龙鳞和$4oa个漂白的剑龙尖刺。集齐后交给考赞。
text.description: 我在这个营地待了一段日子了，所以我清楚，安戈洛环形山这里就可以找到这些材料。$b$b是时候好好回敬一下那些家伙了。从它们身上把东西抢过来，就像它们抢我的东西一样！至少你还是可以帮我这个忙的，对吧，兄弟？$b$b我就在这里等你把东西带回来。
text.progress: Thieving worms gonna get what dey deserve!
text.completion: Oh mon, I wish I could'a seen da look on their faces when you pummled dem!$B$BNow dat we have all da materials, we just need to put it together.

english.title: A Taste of Their Own Medicine
english.objectives: Kill creatures around Un'Goro Crater and retrieve $1oa Stolen Enchanted Thorium Bars, $2oa Mostly Powerful Mojos, $3oa Calcified Diemetradon Scales, and $4oa Bleached Stegodon Spikes. Bring them to Ko'Zan when you're done.
english.description: I been at dis camp for some time now, an' I know for a fact dat dose materials can be found right here in Un'Goro.$b$bTime ta give da creatures here some payback. Take from dem just like dey took from me! At least, you could do dat for me, right bruddah?$b$bI'll just wait here for ya to return wit' all da stuff.
english.progress: Thieving worms gonna get what dey deserve!
english.completion: Oh mon, I wish I could'a seen da look on their faces when you pummled dem!$B$BNow dat we have all da materials, we just need to put it together.

text.title: 诺瑞莎
text.objectives: 拯救诺瑞莎。
text.description: 她还在里面，$n。诺瑞莎，我的妻子。$b$b我们在外头等着出击时，她就在大步道。天知道她出什么事了！$b$b求求你，朋友，我担心她会遭遇不测。请告诉她，希望就在城外。$b$b我们在大步道南面有座小房子，就在水之园旁边。现在局势如此疯狂，她应该会呆在那里。
text.completion: I cannot possibly thank you enough. We will be reunited, and I will see we are never separated again.
text.end: 拯救诺瑞莎。

english.title: Noressa
english.objectives: Rescue Noressa.
english.description: She is still in there, $n. Noressa, my wife.$b$bShe is in the Promenade while we wait outside, preparing to strike. Who knows what has happened to her?$b$bPlease, friend, I fear the worst. Tell her there is hope outside.$b$bWe had a small house in the south of the Grand Promenade, by the water gardens. She will probably be there during this madness.
english.completion: I cannot possibly thank you enough. We will be reunited, and I will see we are never separated again.
english.end: Rescue Noressa.

text.title: 保住小命
text.objectives: 使用考赞身边的熔炉重新制作黑暗之矛。
text.description: 既然你是个熟练的铁匠，还是由你来做这把长矛比较好。这里的熔炉你可以随意使用。$b$b我会把你的工序记录下来，这样长矛和设计图就都到手了！
text.completion: Dat's it, mon! Ya did it!$B$BI tink before I head off back to da Isles, I'll be making a few extra copies of dees plans, just in case.$B$BI'll make ya a copy too, in case I be needing your help wit' making another one.

english.title: Saving My Head
english.objectives: Use the forge near Ko'Zan to recreate the Darkspear.
english.description: Seeing as how you're a blacksmith, I figured it'd be best if ya made da spear. You can use dis forge here to do what ya need to to do.$b$bI'll start writin' down what ya do and den we'll have us both da spear and da recipe!
english.completion: Dat's it, mon! Ya did it!$B$BI tink before I head off back to da Isles, I'll be making a few extra copies of dees plans, just in case.$B$BI'll make ya a copy too, in case I be needing your help wit' making another one.

text.title: Scrolls of the Faldrottin
text.objectives: Take the scrolls to the Council of the Six in Dalaran.
text.description:
While it is definitely odd that a demon would carry a scroll of vrykul writings, what is even more interesting are the contents. 

The writings appear to reference a vrykul prophesy of one who would unite the Tideskorn against the Burning Legion. This information should be brought to the Council of Six immediately.

english.title: Scrolls of the Faldrottin
english.objectives: Take the scrolls to the Council of the Six in Dalaran.
english.description:
While it is definitely odd that a demon would carry a scroll of vrykul writings, what is even more interesting are the contents. 

The writings appear to reference a vrykul prophesy of one who would unite the Tideskorn against the Burning Legion. This information should be brought to the Council of Six immediately.

text.title: 拒捕
text.objectives: 前往邪魂堡垒的灵魂引擎，使用枯法者来拆除能量源。
text.description:
你的发现没有让人失望，$n。

去灵魂引擎吧，使用我们的新武器拆除能量源。
text.completion: Oculeth will be quite pleased with your findings. As you know, he's been working diligently on a new device for the withered.

english.title: Resisting Arrest
english.objectives: Use the withered to dismantle the Power Source inside the Soul Engine at Felsoul Hold.
english.description:
Your findings do not disappoint, $n.

Make your way to the soul engine and use our newly acquired weapons to dismantle the power source.
english.completion: Твои находки порадуют Окулета. Как тебе уже известно, он усердно работает над новым устройством для иссохших.

text.title: 邪魂实验
text.objectives: 在邪魂堡垒测试枯法者对邪能魔法的抵抗能力。
text.description:
安达丽斯控制枯法者的能力实在是一大威胁。如果我们要提高枯法者对这些效果的抵抗能力，就得在用这种魔法构筑的环境里尝试。

马上到邪魂堡垒去吧。你到了之后，我会派一些枯法者来帮助你。记住，你得待在那里，直到确定实验获得了理想的效果为止。
text.completion: The withered seem to be adapting quite well.

english.title: The Felsoul Experiments
english.objectives: Test the withered's resistance against fel magic at Felsoul Hold.
english.description:
Andaris's control over the withered poses a real threat. If we are to increase the withered's resistance against these effects, we must do so in an environment built from this very magic.

Head for Felsoul Hold at once. When you arrive, I will send withered to aide in your efforts. It is of the utmost importance you do not leave until you are certain the experiments yield the appropriate results.
english.completion: Иссохшие вполне неплохо приспособились.

text.title: 邪脉断绝
text.objectives: 前往深红林地的邪脉岗哨，消灭$2oa个邪脉部队成员，以及他们的首领瓦提斯·阿玛兰。
text.description: 邪脉精灵已经开始把黑手伸向城外了。他们在深红林地东边的营地引起了我们的注意。这个岗哨的首领瓦提斯·阿玛兰直接听命于安达丽斯。$B$B是时候了，让我们来测试一下枯法者的训练成效以及欧库勒斯的新设备。不能再让他们更进一步了，$n。$B$B到那个营地去，使用这颗宝珠完成一次斩首行动吧。该轮到我们出击了。
text.completion: Our efforts have proven quite successful. I believe we are just about ready to make our stand.

english.title: Felborne No More
english.objectives: Slay $2oa Felborne and their leader, Valthis Ama'ran, at the Felborne Outpost in Crimson Thicket.
english.description: The Felborne have begun to expand their grasp beyond the city's reach. A camp to the east in the Crimson Thicket is of a particular interest to us. Their outpost leader, Valthis Ama'ran, serves Andaris directly.$B$BNow is the time to put our withered training and Oculeth's device to the test. We cannot allow them to advance any further, $n.$B$BHead for the camp and use the orb to sever the head of the beast. The time has come to begin our advance.
english.completion: Наши усилия принесли плоды. Думаю, мы вполне готовы оказать сопротивление.

text.title: 调查城市
text.objectives: 利用高级传送道标，调查苏拉玛城的谕令平台。
text.description:
这还真是一波三折啊！呃……好吧，其实也没这么严重。

我恐怕还得再请你回城去搜集一次情报。但这次不是一般的情报收集工作——而是信息提取！

我需要特定的坐标，才能将我的传送器校准到最精确的状态。但不幸的是，获得这些情报后，我们还需要花大量时间来梳理它们。但没关系，在这段时间里，我们还有很多事情可以忙。
text.completion: I will begin analyzing this data at once.$B$BFor now, let us turn our attention to more... <Oculeth touches his fingertips together in succession.>$B$B...interesting technological advances.

english.title: Survey the City
english.objectives: Use the Advanced Telemancy Beacon to survey the Terrace of Order in Suramar City.
english.description:
Never a dull moment! Well... perhaps this is not entirely true.

I'm afraid I must ask you once more to return to the city to gather information. But this is not just any information - this is information extraction!

I require specific coordinates to allow me to focus my teleportations with extreme accuracy. It will, unfortunately, take a bit of time to dig through the information once retrieved, but no matter. We have plenty else to do in the meantime.
english.completion: Я немедленно приступлю к анализу полученных данных.$B$BА пока обратим внимание на более... <Окулет складывает пальцы домиком.>$B$B...интересные достижения технического прогресса.

text.title: 不稳定性
text.objectives: 前往欧库勒斯的测试间收集传送笔记和$3oa个废弃的宝珠。
text.description: 为了进一步研究，我得请求你从我废弃已久的测试间里找回几件特别的物品。$b$b我保证，那里除了少数不稳定的元素，基本还算是……安全。$b$b去我的测试间找到传送器吧。你到了之后，我会把它的隐形设备关掉的。
text.completion: Wonderful! Now the fun begins. You should speak with Thalyssra, I believe she is ready for more... testing.

english.title: Experimental Instability
english.objectives: Gather the Telemancy Notes and $3oa Discarded Orbs from Oculeth's Test Chamber.
english.description: In order to advance our studies I must ask you to recover a few particular items from my long-forgotten chambers.$B$BI assure you it is... mostly safe there, aside from a few unstable elements.$B$BMake your way to my workshop and locate the teleporter. I'll disable its cloaking device when you arrive.
english.completion: Beautiful! The fun is about to begin! Talk to Talisroy, I think she's ready for new... trials.

objectiveDetails.description: （可选）使用传送门前往沙尔艾兰
使用传送门前往欧库勒斯的测试间

text.title: 传送扩张
text.objectives: 在沙尔艾兰与欧库勒斯谈一谈。
text.description:
光是理解邪能魔法可能还不够，$n。

去跟欧库勒斯谈谈，我们要从多方面来努力。我听说他有些……独特的计划。
text.completion: Let us begin.

english.title: Telemantic Expanse
english.objectives: Speak with Oculeth in Shal'Aran.
english.description:
Understanding fel magic alone may not be enough, $n.

Speak with Oculeth about diversifying our efforts. I hear he's got something... unique planned for us.
english.completion: Приступим.

text.title: 烧毁战利品
text.objectives: 烧毁$1oa份黑帆宝藏。
text.description: 老实跟你说吧，我来这儿是有原因的。之前出了点乱子。我喝了点小酒，赌了点小钱，但朗姆酒的劲儿有点大……你懂的。然后，我好像说了些不该说的话，动了不该动的手，然后……老实说那时候完全迷迷糊糊的。从那之后，我在那里就不怎么受待见了。$b$b但他们拿走了我的东西！那些骗人的，肮脏的老……嗯哼。你可不可以拿上这个火把，然后……把他们的财物烧掉？我谢谢你了。
text.progress: Ну что, ты все $gсделал:сделала;?
text.completion: Thank ye, me friend. I feel better knowin' I have been avenged.

english.title: Loot and Plunder!
english.objectives: Burn $1oa Blacksail Booty.
english.description: I'm bein' honest here matey, I've got me own motives fer bein' here. Last time there was a bit of a debacle. Some drinkin', some gamblin', and a bit too much rum if ye catch me meanin'. Some words were said, some fists were thrown and... honestly it was quite a haze. I'm not the most welcome pirate here after that.$b$bBut they took me stuff! These lyin', dirty ol'... ahem. Could ye just take this torch and... burn their belongin's? I'd be grateful.
english.progress: Ну что, ты все $gсделал:сделала;?
english.completion: Спасибо тебе. Теперь я знаю, что отмщен, и мне станет легче.

text.title: REUSE
text.objectives: Burn $1oa Blacksail Booty.

english.title: REUSE
english.objectives: Burn $1oa Blacksail Booty.

text.title: 克丽萨的飞鸟
text.objectives: 在宠物对战中击败克丽萨。
text.description: 我获得了艾泽拉斯最珍奇的一种食腐鸟。你有胆量挑战它们吗？
text.completion: There are feathers everywhere! What a mess.

english.title: Crysa's Flyers
english.objectives: Defeat Crysa in a pet battle.
english.description: I have obtained some of the most exotic species of carrion bird ever seen on Azeroth. Do you think you can stand up to them?
english.completion: There are feathers everywhere! What a mess.

text.title: 勇气试炼：失落军团
text.objectives: 在勇气试炼团队副本中收集1000个瓦拉加尔灵魂碎片。
text.description:
虽然你的当务之急是击败海拉，但我还有其他事有求于你。海拉有一种能力，可以窃取并腐化我的瓦拉加尔的灵魂。她的爪牙会占有这些灵魂并腐化他们。我敢肯定，最强大的瓦拉加尔灵魂肯定都在海拉手中。你一定要找到这些失落的灵魂，并把他们带回来给我。

只要你完成任务，我就会从英灵殿的军械库里拿出神圣的护甲来奖励你。
text.progress: Bring me the souls of my lost Valarjar. Only then will I reward you with the blessed armor you desire.
text.completion: With these souls returned to the Halls of Valor my forces return to their former strength. As promised, the bounty is yours.

english.title: Trial of Valor: The Lost Army
english.objectives: Gather 1000 Valarjar Soul Fragments within the Trial of Valor Raid.
english.description:
While Helya's defeat is your primary objective, I require more of your aid. Helya has gained the ability to steal and corrupt the souls of my Valarjar. Her minions hold these souls, corrupting them. I am certain Helya herself hordes the greatest Valarjar souls to herself. You must recover these lost souls, then return them to me.

Do this and I will reward you with blessed guard from the hall's armory.
english.progress: Give me back the souls of the dead Valariars. Only then will you receive the much-desired blessed armor.
english.completion: With these souls returned to the Halls of Valor my forces return to their former strength. As promised, the bounty is yours.

text.title: 冲锋陷阵！
text.objectives: 带领天启四骑士冲锋陷阵，对抗燃烧军团。
text.description: 时候到了，死亡领主！我们的斥候已经标出了一大群恶魔，就在离这里不远的地方。带领我们走向胜利吧，让这些恶魔看看亡灵的力量！
text.completion: Now we have proven the might of the Ebon Blade to the Legion. The ability to take down so many demons without fear of death... that is the power that we hold. We shall see many more demons fall to our blades, and we shall strike them down for Azeroth.$B$BSuffer well.

english.title: We Ride!
english.objectives: Lead the Four Horsemen in the battle against the Burning Legion.
english.description: The time has come, Deathlord! Our scouts have marked a large amassing of demons not far from here. Lead us to victory, and show these demons the power of undeath!
english.completion: Now we have proven the might of the Ebon Blade to the Legion. The ability to take down so many demons without fear of death... that is the power that we hold. We shall see many more demons fall to our blades, and we shall strike them down for Azeroth.$B$BSuffer well.

text.title: 人人都爱看搏击
text.objectives: 参加5场搏击俱乐部比赛。
text.description:
纸条上写着：

“你不该到处宣扬搏击俱乐部的事，尤其不该对那些勇士多嘴。但既然你已经那么做了，我想偶尔让他们来打几场比赛也无妨，但你最好先证明自己是个真正的拳手！”
text.completion: Ok, I'll let your champions come and prove themselves in the ring. If they manage to win themselves a fight, come talk to me again and we can see about letting them fight harder brawls.

english.title: Everyone Loves a Good Fight
english.objectives: Compete in 5 Brawls.
english.description:
The note reads:

"You shouldn't have blabbed about the brawlers, especially to those champions. Now that you have though, I suppose it's ok that they fight here on occasion, but you better prove yourself a true brawler first!"
english.completion: Хорошо, я позволю твоим защитникам выступить на ринге. Если они смогут победить, вернись ко мне, и мы попробуем подобрать для них соперников посильнее.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成搏击俱乐部的比赛
