text.title: 海拉之角
text.objectives: 在冥狱深渊消灭敌人，强化海拉之角。
text.description:
$n，我们需要采取一切必要手段来扩充我们的军队。克瓦迪尔受到的诅咒已经没救了，但他们还是强大的战士，是不可忽视的资源。

他们必须永远服从海拉，哪怕她已经死了也一样。如果我们可以用她的声音来召唤他们，就能让他们听命于我们了！

我们从海拉的尸体上找到了海拉之角。强化它，这样就能在我们需要时召唤克瓦迪尔了。
text.completion: Revenge is sweet. The kvaldir will be forced to obey us, now!

english.title: Helya's Horn
english.objectives: Kill enemies in Helheim to empower Helya's Horn.
english.description:
$n, we need to bolster our army by any means necessary. The kvaldir are cursed beyond redemption, but they are fierce warriors and are a resource we should not overlook. 

They are eternally bound to obey Helya even through her death. If we can call them using her voice, they will follow us instead! 

We recovered Helya's Horn from her corpse. Empower it so you can call the kvaldir when we have need of them.
english.completion: Revenge is sweet. The kvaldir will be forced to obey us, now!

text.title: 元素萨满祭司：莱维娅·劳伦斯的窘境
text.objectives: 在城里打听莱维娅·劳伦斯的情报。
text.description:
莱维娅·劳伦斯曾是肯瑞托的成员。由于涉足暗影魔法，她被赶出了达拉然。但她对这里的街道太熟悉，我们很难真正阻止她进入这座城市。

莱维娅失踪了，我对此极为关注。她的研究可能已经引起了燃烧军团的注意。这种事以前也发生过。如果她的知识落入了燃烧军团的手中，情况就会很危险。

她最后一次出现是在铭文师的殿堂。去那里打听一下，看看能不能找到她的去向。

|cFF660000专精：元素萨满|r
text.completion: So it seems that Levia has fallen under the spell of a succubus' seduction. I fear her time alone as an outcast must have left her vulnerable to such tactics. I cannot help but feel some guilt for her turning down this path.$B$BIn any case, Levia is in great danger. She must be found!

english.title: Elemental: The Folly of Levia Laurence
english.objectives: Ask around the city for information on Levia Laurence.
english.description:
Levia Laurence was once a member of the Kirin Tor. Dabbling in shadow magic got her banned from the city, but she knows the streets too well to keep her out for good.

Levia has disappeared, and I'm gravely concerned. Her work may have attracted the attention of the Legion. It has before. It would be very dangerous if her knowledge fell into their hands.

She was last seen at the Scribe's Sacellum. Ask around there and see if you can pick up her trail.

|cFF660000Specialization: Elemental Shaman|r
english.completion: So it seems that Levia has fallen under the spell of a succubus' seduction. I fear her time alone as an outcast must have left her vulnerable to such tactics. I cannot help but feel some guilt for her turning down this path.$B$BIn any case, Levia is in great danger. She must be found!

objectiveDetails.description: 在魔术旅馆打听莱维娅的消息
在好战的秘法师打听莱维娅的消息
在铭文师的殿堂打听莱维娅的消息

text.title: 初识恶魔法术
text.objectives: 激活三个正确的符文，帮助雷特森·焰怒完成法术，稳定传送门。
text.description:
莱维娅肯定是用了这些符文来协助她进行仪式。就算她真有茉德拉说的那么厉害，在恶魔法术方面也只是个新手，这些符文一定是用来稳定传送门的。

我需要你帮忙搞清楚，激活哪些符文才能重现她的仪式。这个房间里有几本关于符文魔法的书。她肯定为了举行仪式而读过这些书。

一旦你激活了符文，我就会完成法术。
text.progress: Хватит слоняться туда-сюда! Помоги мне разобраться с ритуалом!
text.completion: I'm pleasantly surprised, $C. Without your quick thinking, your mage friend would be lost to Agatha.$B$BThe portal is stabilized, and should lead to the mage's location.

english.title: Dabbling in the Demonic
english.objectives: Activate the correct three runes to help Rittsyn Flamescowl complete the spell to stabilize the portal.
english.description:
Levia must have used these runes to aid her ritual. Even if she is as powerful as Modera says, she was a novice in demonic magic, so the runes must have helped stabilize the portal.

I'll need you to find out what runes need to be activated to recreate her ritual. There are several books on runic magic in this room, which she no doubt studied for her ritual.

Once you have activated the runes, I will complete the spell.
english.progress: Хватит слоняться туда-сюда! Помоги мне разобраться с ритуалом!
english.completion:
Я приятно удивлен, |3-6($c). Если бы не твоя находчивость, у твоей приятельницы не было бы шансов бежать из плена Агаты.

Что ж, портал стабилизирован, и он должен привести тебя к Левии.

text.title: 引诱失败
text.objectives: 击败阿加莎。
text.description:
茉……茉德拉派你来的？

不……你必须……离开！阿加莎随时都可能回来！

保命……要紧……
text.completion: Disgusting! I can't believe I let myself fall under the spell of such a creature! $B$BI was such a fool! She made me think she really cared about me. In the end, it seems nothing I thought I knew about Agatha was true!

english.title: Unlikely Seduction
english.objectives: Defeat Agatha.
english.description:
Mo... Modera sent you?

No...  you must... leave!  Agatha will be back any moment!

Save... yourself...
english.completion:
Омерзительно! Поверить не могу, что ее чары сработали! 

Что за глупость! Она заставила меня думать, что заботится обо мне. Но все оказалось ложью!

text.title: 邪能迷情
text.objectives: 返回达拉然找大法师茉德拉。
text.description:
那个肮脏的鬼母！要不是因为太虚弱，我一定要潜进池子狠狠教训她一顿！

<莱维娅深吸了一口气，冷静下来。>

阿加莎迟早会用上从我这里偷走的力量。我们最好在那之前离开这里。
text.completion: So Levia is safe? That is a relief, though I wish we could have reached her sooner. An imp mother is bad enough - I can't imagine what Agatha will be capable of with Levia's power. And who knows what secrets Levia shared while under her thrall?$B$BI'm afraid that this battle may not be over yet.$B$BFor now, we should celebrate whatever victories we can get. Thank you for your assistance, $n.

english.title: Fel-Crossed Lovers
english.objectives: Return to Archmage Modera in Dalaran.
english.description:
That vile imp mother! If I wasn't so weakened I would dive down that pool and give her a piece of my mind!

<Levia takes a deep breath to regain her composure.>

It's only a matter of time until Agatha can make use of the power she stole from me. We had best not be here when she does.
english.completion:
Значит, Левия в безопасности? Отрадно знать, хоть нам и стоило связаться с ней раньше. Мать бесов – это и так плохо, а уж на что Агата будет способна с силой Левии... Да и кто знает, какие тайны Левия выдала ей в плену?

Боюсь, с этой проблемой еще не покончено.

Но пока мы можем порадоваться твоему успеху. Спасибо за помощь, $n.

text.title: 荣耀的再会
text.objectives: 与艾瑞莉娅谈一谈，然后向奥丁复命。
text.description: 你做得很好，战争领主$n。我们返回苍穹要塞吧。奥丁一定很想听到你胜利的消息。
text.completion: You have done all that I hoped, and more, Battlelord $n.

english.title: A Glorious Reunion
english.objectives: Speak to Aerylia, then report to Odyn.
english.description: You have done well, Battlelord $n. Let us return to Skyhold. Odyn will want to hear of your success here.
english.completion: You have done all that I hoped, and more, Battlelord $n.

text.title: 审判降临
text.objectives: 使用大领主的审判，决定谁有资格成为白银之手新兵。
text.description: 我们对破碎海滩的持续攻势吸引了很多圣骑士的注意，他们都想在你的麾下战斗。其中有几个特别出色的，但是最后还得由你做决定。$b$b那些新兵都在礼拜堂外的营地里，等待你的审判。
text.completion: Your judgment is firm and fair, Highlord.$B$BThese new recruits will learn much under your command.$B$BThough I am beginning to wonder, if my worthiness was tested, would I be found lacking?

english.title: Judgment Awaits
english.objectives: Use Highlord's Judgment to determine the worth of Silver Hand Recruits.
english.description: Our ongoing offensive within the Broken Shore has drawn the interest of many paladins who wish to fight under your leadership. Some are more worthy than others, but only you can be the judge of that.$B$BThe new recruits are lingering in the camp just outside the chapel, awaiting your judgment.
english.completion: Your judgment is firm and fair, Highlord.$B$BThese new recruits will learn much under your command.$B$BThough I am beginning to wonder, if my worthiness was tested, would I be found lacking?

text.title: 月牙家族遗物
text.objectives: 在暗影沼泽找回月牙家族遗物。
text.description:
我说话算话，这就是那把月牙钥匙。它可以打开我的家族宝箱，但里面已经没什么值钱的东西了。

你会把找到的东西都交给德拉丝的，对吧？这些都是我们祖传的东西，不管是否值钱，都应该由我们家族保管。
text.completion: I know the name Nerus. He's a distant relative of mine, but why would he hold on to fel trinkets?$B$BThe answer to that question might be found within this scroll, but it appears to be blank.

english.title: Moonfang Family Relics
english.objectives: Recover Moonfang family relics from within Shadowfen.
english.description:
As promised, here is the crescent key that will open my family's lockboxes, though nothing of value remains.

I trust whatever you find you'll deliver to Delas? Our ancestor's things, whatever their worth, should remain in our family.
english.completion: I know the name Nerus. He's a distant relative of mine, but why would he hold on to fel trinkets?$B$BThe answer to that question might be found within this scroll, but it appears to be blank.

text.title: 解读符文
text.objectives: 从破碎群岛的恶魔身上收集$1oa份魔血。
text.description:
这个卷轴有点蹊跷。在一般人看来，它是完全空白的。但当我把它举到强光下时，却发现有符文的微光一闪而过。

跟绝大多数恶魔符文一样，我得用魔血才能解除卷轴上面的魔法，正是这种魔法掩盖了卷轴上的信息。
text.progress: I will need to submerge the scroll in demon blood in order for the runes to reveal themselves.
text.completion: It should only take a moment for the runes to appear once I apply the purified blood.

english.title: Runic Reading
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Fel Blood from demons throughout the Broken Isles.
english.description:
There is something curious about this scroll. It appears to be an empty page to the untrained eye, but I can see a shimmer of runes appear briefly when I hold it up to the light.

As with most demonic runes, I will need fel blood to undo the magic that's been used to conceal whatever message is within this scroll.
english.progress: Чтобы увидеть руны, мне нужно пропитать свиток кровью демонов.
english.completion: It should only take a moment for the runes to appear once I apply the purified blood.

text.title: 邪能石的毁灭
text.objectives: 摧毁邪能石吊坠。
text.description: <德拉丝惊讶得合不拢嘴，卷轴从她手上滑落，掉到了地上。>$b$b怎么可能……这些符文……详细记载了燃烧军团和我的祖先签订的一份契约。这笔黑暗的交易保护我的祖先在生前不会被恶魔侵扰，但他们死后的灵魂就会归燃烧军团所有。$b$b这个邪能吊坠就是这份契约的象征，一旦戴上就无法摘下。$b$b快，$n。你得用你的神器毁掉这件该死的首饰！
text.completion: If you were strong enough to destroy the pendant that bound my spirit to the Burning Legion, then there might be hope for my ancestors.

english.title: Felstone Destruction
english.objectives: Destroy the Felstone Pendant.
english.description: <Delas' mouth drops open as the scroll falls from her hands and onto the floor.>$B$BThis cannot be... the runes... they detail a pact between the Burning Legion and my ancestors. A dark deal that would grant my ancestors protection from demons in this life, but in return, their spirits would belong to the Legion.$B$BThis fel pendant is an embodiment of the pact, and cannot be removed once worn.$B$BQuickly, $n. You must use your artifact to destroy that cursed piece of jewelry!
english.completion: If you were strong enough to destroy the pendant that bound my spirit to the Burning Legion, then there might be hope for my ancestors.

text.title: 背誓者
text.objectives: 前往破碎海滩，消灭誓缚者佐拉克。
text.description: 许多年以前，我跟一个人签下了一份契约。我当时觉得，他跟我没什么区别。他承诺的保护美好得几乎不真实，但是我当时还是不顾一切地签下了契约。$b$b我用鲜血写下名字后，恐惧魔王佐拉克就现出了真身。$b$b只要他还活着，我的祖先就会被燃烧军团所束缚，我们的敌人就可以聚集起一支受其操控的军队。$b$b快去破碎海滩，消灭誓缚者佐拉克。只要他一死，他对我的祖先的掌控就会消失。
text.completion: With Zorak dead, my ancestor's spirits can finally be free of their curse.

english.title: Oath Breaker
english.objectives: Head to the Broken Shore and slay Oathbinder Zorak.
english.description: Many years ago I made a pact with a man I thought not to be unlike myself. His promise of protection seemed too good to be true, but it was a deal I was desperate to make.$B$BIt wasn't until I had signed in blood that the dreadlord Zorak revealed himself.$B$BAs long as he lives, my ancestors will remain bound to the Burning Legion, allowing our enemies to amass an army of unwilling soldiers.$B$BHead to the Broken Shore and slay Oathbinder Zorak. His death will break the hold he has over my ancestors.
english.completion: With Zorak dead, my ancestor's spirits can finally be free of their curse.

text.title: 终结新月诅咒
text.objectives: 在新月废墟摧毁邪缚之魂的邪能吊坠，让他们获得自由。
text.description:
我们必须尽一切努力，打破我祖先所遭受的诅咒。

燃烧军团在废墟里建起营地以收容我们的亡者，准备利用那份多年以前签订的可怕契约。

我所有的祖先身上都有一条吊坠，将他们与恶魔领主联系在一起。这吊坠是拿不下来的，但是按照你之前所展示的那样，只要有强大的力量，就能把吊坠摧毁。

终结这个纠缠着我祖先的诅咒吧，让他们的灵魂获得自由！
text.completion: What you have done for my family will never be forgotten.$B$BThe spirits of the Moonfang family will forever be in your debt.

english.title: Ending the Crescent Curse
english.objectives: Free Felbound Spirits in Crescent Ruins by destroying their fel pendants.
english.description:
We must do whatever we can to break the curse that befalls my ancestors. 

The Burning Legion have set up camp within the ruins that house our dead, ready to make good on the dreadful pact that was drafted so long ago.

Each of my ancestor's is burdened with a pendant that binds them to their demonic overlords. It cannot be removed, but as you have shown, with enough power it can be destroyed. 

End the curse that plagues my ancestors and set their spirits free!
english.completion: What you have done for my family will never be forgotten.$B$BThe spirits of the Moonfang family will forever be in your debt.

text.title: 盒装谜题
text.objectives: 把神秘的盒子交给达拉然的博学者达瑞妮斯。
text.description:
<你发现了一个神秘的盒子。它设计风格非常陌生，但无疑非常古老。

这个盒子的表面镶嵌着魔法符文。虽然没有生效，但它的作用或许值得调查一下。

如果你把它拿给达拉然的博学者达瑞妮斯看看，她或许可以告诉你更多的情况。>
text.completion: <Dariness peers at the artifact you hand her.>$B$BA most interesting design! It reminds me of an ancient curio I read about long ago while still in training. I doubt it could be that though. Such a device has never been found.$B$BHmm, I wonder if it still works. Only one way to find out...

english.title: Cubic Conundrum
english.objectives: Take the Mysterious Cube to Dariness the Learned in Dalaran.
english.description:
<You find a mysterious cube. Its design is unfamiliar, but unmistakably ancient. 

The cube's surface is inlaid with magical runes. Though inert, its properties may be worth investigating.

Perhaps if you show it to Dariness the Learned in Dalaran, she could tell you more about it.>
english.completion: <Dariness is looking closely at the artifact you brought her. >$b$bHow interesting! It reminds me of an ancient curiosity that I read back in my academic years. Although I doubt it's really her, no one's ever found such a device...$b$bUm... I wonder if it still works. There is only one way to find out...

text.title: 盒装魔流
text.objectives: 从苏拉玛获得300份远古魔力。
text.description: 要想了解这个盒子的作用，就得为它充能。唔，我有个主意……$b$b夜之子都很垂涎一种物质，相信你绝对不陌生，那就是远古魔力。它们和这么古老的遗物正相配。收集足够的魔力，然后我们就能试着让它恢复运转了。$b$b在苏拉玛小心点！要是把这个奇特的盒子弄丢了，让它再次成为回忆，那就太可惜了。
text.completion: I trust you obtained all the ancient mana we need to infuse the cube?

english.title: Cubic Currents
english.objectives: Obtain 300 Ancient Mana from Suramar
english.description: To determine this cube's purpose, we need to power it up. Hmm, I have an idea...$b$bThe Nightborne covet a substance you are no doubt familiar with called ancient mana. Should be just the thing for a relic this old. Gather a sufficient quantity and we'll attempt to get it working.$b$bBe careful in Suramar! It would be a shame if this curious cube were lost and became a memory once more.
english.completion: Тебе удалось добыть достаточно древней маны для наполнения куба?

text.title: 携锤傍身
text.objectives: 前往搏击俱乐部。
text.description: 你的勇士在搏击俱乐部战胜了战锤议会。将这个”徽记“带去搏击俱乐部作为证据。
text.completion: Hey not bad, they beat the Council huh? Sure, they can advance to the next level.

english.title: We Brought the Hammer
english.objectives: Go to the Brawler's Guild.
english.description: Your champions found success in the brawl against the Warhammer Council. Bring this "token" to the Brawler's Guild as proof.
english.completion: Hey not bad, they beat the Council huh? Sure, they can advance to the next level.

text.title: 清洁工作
text.objectives: 将断裂的扫帚柄带回搏击俱乐部。
text.description: 你的勇士胜利凯旋了。他们声情并茂地讲述了自己是怎么把清洁工比尔扫地出门的。
text.completion: You think you guys are tough, beating up a janitor and all? Well ok, I suppose I'll get you into the next fight.

english.title: Cleaning Up
english.objectives: Return the Broken Broom Handle to the Brawler's Guild.
english.description: Your champions return successful. They tell a grand tale of how they really cleaned up against Bill the Janitor.
english.completion: You think you guys are tough, beating up a janitor and all? Well ok, I suppose I'll get you into the next fight.

text.title: 战斗！
text.objectives: 加入任意战场并获胜。
text.description:
你的勇士已经完成对战场的探索，胜利归来了。他们送来的报告上详细陈述了狂野的冒险，九死一生的事迹与辉煌的荣耀。征战沙场时，局势总是瞬息万变，帮手还是越多越好。

你愿意响应号召吗？
text.progress: Ну, как твои дела на поле боя?
text.completion: Well done! Battlegrounds are certainly no place for the weak.$B$BWith your success, your champions will now look for more opportunities for you to prove your worth.

english.title: To Battle!
english.objectives: Join and win in any battleground.
english.description:
Your champions have returned from exploring the battleground with a report detailing wild adventures and death-defying feats of strength and honor. In these ever shifting battles of conquest, more assistance is always required.

Will you answer the call?
english.progress: Ну, как твои дела на поле боя?
english.completion: Well done! Battlegrounds are certainly no place for the weak.$B$BWith your success, your champions will now look for more opportunities for you to prove your worth.

text.title: 情势危急
text.objectives: 加入任意战场并获胜。
text.description: 冲突仍在继续。广阔的战场始终需要你的支援。加入战斗，击败敌人，为你的阵营赢得荣光吧。
text.progress: Ну, как тебе поле боя?
text.completion: Well done!

english.title: Desperate Times
english.objectives: Join and win in any battleground.
english.description: The conflict continues. As always, your assistance is needed in the great battlegrounds. Join the fray, defeat your enemies, and win glory for your faction.
english.progress: Ну, как тебе поле боя?
english.completion: Well done!

text.title: 寻找伊利丹·怒风
text.objectives: 前往阿苏纳的伊利达雷哨所找食魂者阿莱利。
text.description: 伊利达雷的预言者，食魂者阿莱利，一直在寻找伊利丹的灵魂。如今，她认为自己已经发现了它的下落，并请你帮忙将它找回来。$b$b去阿苏纳的伊利达雷哨所找到阿莱利，并尽你所能帮助她吧。$b$b如果萨格拉斯真的计划使用伊利丹的躯体作为容器回归艾泽拉斯，那么为了阻止黑暗泰坦，我们就必须让伊利丹的灵魂回归他自己的身体里！
text.completion: The naaru heard my call? Interesting...$B$BVery well, let's get to work. We've found Illidan's soul - finally - and it's not where we expected it to be held.

english.title: The Hunt for Illidan Stormrage
english.objectives: Seek out Allari the Souleater at Illidari Stand in Azsuna.
english.description: Allari the Souleater, an oracle of the Illidari, has been on the hunt for Illidan's soul for quite some time. She now believes that she has discovered its location and requires your assistance in its recovery.$B$BFind Allari at Illidari Stand in Azsuna and aid her in any way possible.$B$BIf Sargeras truly plans to use Illidan's body as a vessel for his own return then returning Illidan's soul to his body is integral in preventing the dark titan from returning to our world!
english.completion: The naaru heard my call? Interesting...$B$BVery well, let's get to work. We've found Illidan's soul - finally - and it's not where we expected it to be held.

text.title: 伊利达雷的灵魂棱镜
text.objectives: 从《军团再临》的地下城的最终首领身上获得40个徘徊之魂碎片。$b$b地下城难度越高，获得徘徊之魂碎片的几率越高，数量越多。
text.description: 唉，为了不给你增加压力，我现在还不能把主人灵魂的下落告诉你，$n。首先，我们得先制造一个足够强大的灵魂棱镜，这样才能容纳主人那无穷无尽的混沌能量。$b$b要达到这个目标，我需要这个世界上的强大生物留下的徘徊之魂碎片。给我带来足够数量的碎片带给我，我就可以制造强大的灵魂棱镜，承载主人的灵魂——至少可以坚持到把灵魂转移到纳鲁身上为止。
text.completion: The Soul Prism of the Illidari is ready for use.$B$BIllidan's soul was plucked from the Nether - stolen - and taken to the underworld. A place known as Helheim.

english.title: Soul Prism of the Illidari
english.objectives: Claim 40 Lingering Soul Fragments from the final bosses of Legion dungeons.$B$BHigher difficulty dungeons provide a greater chance and quantity of Lingering Soul Fragments.
english.description: Alas, I will not burden you with the location of the master's soul just yet, $n. First we must craft a soul prism powerful enough to hold the master's boundless chaotic energies.$B$BTo do this I require lingering soul fragments from powerful beings found across this world. Bring me enough and I will craft a soul prism capable of holding the soul of the master - at least long enough to transfer into the naaru.
english.completion: The Soul Prism of the Illidari is ready for use.$B$BIllidan's soul was plucked from the Nether - stolen - and taken to the underworld. A place known as Helheim.

text.title: 勇气试炼：过去与未来的暗影之王
text.objectives: 在勇气试炼团队副本中击败海拉，然后使用伊利达雷的灵魂棱镜，获得伊利丹的灵魂。
text.description: 虽然寻找主人的身体困难重重，但我们最终还是发现，它就在苏拉玛的暗夜要塞。我们的情报显示，古尔丹正在为暗夜井做最后的准备，打算使用它的力量，将萨格拉斯的灵魂引入伊利丹的身体。$b$b要想阻止他，唯一的办法就是让伊利丹的不朽之魂回到他自己的身体里。$b$b带上伊利达雷的灵魂棱镜，进入冥狱深渊击败海拉。然后对伊利丹的灵魂使用棱镜，并把它交给圣光之心。
text.completion: <Light's Heart illuminates brightly and seemingly consumes the Soul Prism.>
text.completed: 把伊利达雷的灵魂棱镜交还给你职业大厅中的圣光之心。

english.title: Trial of Valor: The Once and Future Lord of Shadows
english.objectives: Defeat Helya in the Trials of Valor raid and then use the Soul Prism of the Illidari to claim Illidan's Soul.
english.description: While tracking the master's physical body proved challenging, we were able to locate it in the Nighthold of Suramar. Our intelligence reports that Gul'dan is making final preparations to the Nightwell in order to use its power to usher the soul of Sargeras into Illidan's body.$B$BThe only way to stop that from happening is to put Illidan's own immortal soul back.$B$BTake the Soul Prism of the Illidari and venture to Helheim. Defeat Helya and use the prism on Illidan's soul! Return it to Light's Heart.
english.completion: <Light's Heart illuminates brightly and seemingly consumes the Soul Prism.>
english.completed: Return the Soul Prism of the Illidari to Light's Heart in your Order Hall.

objectiveDetails.description: 获得伊利丹·怒风的灵魂

text.title: 暗夜要塞
text.objectives: 将圣光之心交给达拉然紫罗兰城堡的卡德加。
text.description: 伊利丹的灵魂在圣光之心里很安全。把这个容器交给卡德加，然后按以下指示行动：$B$B在古尔丹企图撕裂天空，把黑暗泰坦带进我们的世界时，召唤这个容器的力量，释放伊利丹的灵魂，让他回归自己的身体。$b$b去吧，$n，我们没时间了。黑暗的仪式就要开始了。
text.completion: I... I will do my best, Battlelord. You will - of course - have to do the hard work and lead the assault on the Nighthold!$B$BFOR AZEROTH!

english.title: The Nighthold
english.objectives: Deliver Light's Heart to Khadgar at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
english.description: Illidan's soul rests safely within Light's Heart. Take this vessel and deliver it to Khadgar with the following instructions:$B$BWhen Gul'dan attempts to tear the sky asunder and bring the dark titan into our world, call forth the power of this vessel and release Illidan's soul into his body.$B$BGo now, $n. We do not have much time. The dark ritual will begin soon.
english.completion: I... I will do my best, Battlelord. You will - of course - have to do the hard work and lead the assault on the Nighthold!$B$BFOR AZEROTH!

text.title: 赢得荣誉
text.objectives: 参加竞技场比赛并获胜。
text.description: 这封信邀请你参加艾泽拉斯有史以来最宏大的活动之一——竞技场大赛。斗士们在此赢得荣光，他们的名字会被所有人铭记，至少在下个赛季开始前是如此。
text.completion: Congratulations are in order I hear?

english.title: Win the Crowd
english.objectives: Fight and win in the arena.
english.description: The letter invites you to fight in one of the greatest events in the history of Azeroth. The grand arena battles, where fighters win glory and honor, and everyone will remember their names. Or at least until the next season.
english.completion: Congratulations are in order I hear?

text.title: 战争之岛
text.objectives: 完成阿什兰的任务。
text.description:
你的勇士又伤又累地回来了。他们将一面旗帜交到了你手上。这令你产生了不祥的预感，但同时又涌起了对战斗的渴望。他们向你报告了一座名叫阿什兰的岛屿，英雄们在岛上征战不休。那里的战事十分胶着，双方你争我夺，努力争取占据上风。

阿什兰需要你的帮助，你愿意响应号召吗？
text.completion: Ashran is no place for the faint of heart. You did well.

english.title: An Island of War
english.objectives: Complete the quests in Ashran.
english.description:
Your champions return weary and wounded. They bear a banner which, when placed in your hands, gives you a sense of foreboding, but also a surge of battle lust. They report to you of an island named Ashran, where heroes are constantly waging a war. The tides push back and forth, each side feinting and thrusting, always trying to gain the upper hand.

Ashran needs your help, will you answer the call?
english.completion: Ashran is no place for the faint of heart. You did well.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成阿什兰的任务“杀光他们！”

text.title: 冰霜法师：扭曲的双子
text.objectives: 前往达拉然的魔术旅馆寻找卡兰姆·法师之矛。
text.description:
我的一位老朋友，卡兰姆·法师之矛请我帮忙寻找他的兄弟莱斯特。卡兰姆担心莱斯特在研究黑暗力量，希望能够阻止他。

莱斯特原本在肯瑞托接受训练，但他过于渴望力量，因此转而研究起了禁忌的通灵法术。他的行为暴露后，就被肯瑞托开除了。

去魔术旅馆找卡兰姆，看看有什么可以帮忙的。

|cFF660000专精：冰霜法师|r
text.completion: You come from the Kirin Tor? So you'll help me find my brother?

english.title: Frost: The Twisted Twin
english.objectives: Meet with Karam Magespear at the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.
english.description:
I have a request from an old friend, Karam Magespear, to help find his brother, Raest. Karam fears that Raest is dealing with dark powers, and wishes to stop him.

Originally Raest trained with the Kirin Tor, but such were his aspirations of power that he turned to the forbidden art of Necromancy. He was discovered and expelled from our order.

Find Karam in the Legerdemain Lounge and see if you can lend a hand.

|cFF660000Specialization: Frost Mage|r
english.completion: You come from the Kirin Tor? So you'll help me find my brother?

text.title: 阴影中传来的消息
text.objectives: 搜查魔术旅馆上层的房间，寻找有关莱斯特·法师之矛下落的线索。
text.description:
我知道我兄弟曾经行差踏错，可我担心他现在可能已经卷入了某种难以想象的邪恶事件里。他最近开始跟某个黑暗的邪教秘密接触，这个邪教就隐藏在达拉然的居民当中。

我长途跋涉来到这里，就是为了劝他不要再继续错下去，可他完全不为所动。现在，他干脆失踪了。

我上次看到他，是在楼上的一个房间里。我在那里没发现任何线索，但是你可能会比我走运些。
text.progress: Have you found something?
text.completion: A letter? From one of the cultists? $B$BThat could be the lead we need!

english.title: Message from the Shadows
english.objectives: Search the upper room in the Legerdemain Lounge for a clue to Raest Magespear's location.
english.description:
I know my brother has been misguided in the past, but I fear that he may have fallen in with an unthinkable evil. He recently began meeting in secret with a dark cult, hidden amongst the people of Dalaran.

I travelled here to try to convince him of the error in his ways, but he would not be shaken from his course. Now, he has disappeared. 

When I last saw him, Raest was staying in a room upstairs. I was unable to find any clues there, but you might fare better.
english.progress: Ну что, удалось что-нибудь найти?
english.completion: Записка? От сектантки? $B$BВозможно, именно она нам поможет!

text.title: 下水道的秘密
text.objectives: 询问达拉然下水道里的下水道贱民，寻找更多有关莱斯特·法师之矛下落的情报。
text.description:
所以我兄弟跑去跟这些邪教徒举行某种仪式了？难怪他跑了，但这毫无帮助……

等等！这封信提到了这个“虚空之誓”教派的一些教徒正在下水道里搜集材料。如果我们动作够快，或许还能找到他们！
text.progress: Any leads, $n?
text.completion: Well, this definitely says... something.

english.title: Secrets in the Underbelly
english.objectives: Question the Underbelly Lowlifes in the Underbelly to find more information about Raest Magespear's location.
english.description:
So my brother has gone off to perform some ritual with these cultists? That explains why he left, but still not to where...

Wait! This letter mentions some of these "Nethersworn" cultists seeking reagents in the Underbelly. Perhaps we still may be able to find them if we hurry!
english.progress: $gFound:Found; anything useful, $n?
english.completion: Ну... хоть что-то.

text.title: 议会的智慧
text.objectives: 前往达拉然的紫罗兰城堡，将虚空之誓宣言交给大法师卡莱。
text.description:
我很抱歉，$n，但是我对此毫无头绪。我向来不擅长猜谜。

我们应该把这份邪教徒的文稿拿给大法师看看。或许他能看出些什么。
text.completion: What's this, a cultist's manifesto? $B$BSo Raest has really gone down a dark path, hasn't he?

english.title: The Wisdom of the Council
english.objectives: Bring the Nethersworn Manifesto to Archmage Karlain in the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
english.description:
I'm sorry, $n, but I can't make heads nor tails of this. Riddles have never exactly been my strength.

We should take this cultist's writings to the archmage. Perhaps he could shed some light on this.
english.completion: Что это еще такое? Манифест сектантов? $B$BВыходит, Рейст и правда обратился к тьме...

text.title: 薄弱点
text.objectives: 前往破碎海滩的邪裂洞穴寻找卡兰姆·法师之矛。
text.description:
虽然我从来没听说过这个“虚空之誓”教派，但这个宣言里说的肯定没好事。

不过我的确有所猜测。这上面提到的“肌肤最轻薄之处”，我认为可能是指艾泽拉斯和扭曲虚空之间的屏障最薄弱的地方——萨格拉斯之墓。

我们的军队在破碎海滩建立起要塞后，莱斯特和他的那些邪教徒盟友就有机会接近那座墓穴了。我建议你们去阻止他们。
text.completion: My brother is here!

english.title: Where it's Thinnest
english.objectives: Meet Karam Magespear at Felbreach Hollow in the Broken Shore.
english.description:
Though I have never heard of this "Nethersworn" cult, what this manifesto speaks of can't be good.

I do have a theory, however. The writing speaks of "the place its skin is thinnest." I think they might be referring to the place where the veil between Azeroth and the Twisting Nether is weakest - the Tomb of Sargeras. 

With our forces having established a foothold at the Broken Shore, this would be an opportune time for Raest and his cultist allies to reach the tomb. I would suggest you stop them.
english.completion: Мой брат здесь!

text.title: 裂解符文
text.objectives: 通过邪裂洞穴中的结界，面对莱斯特·法师之矛。
text.description:
我兄弟和他的邪教徒正在这个洞窟的另一头举行某种仪式。我想去干扰仪式的进行，但我兄弟留下的魔法结界挡住了道路。

如果你能找到穿过结界的办法，我们就能及时阻止他了！
text.completion: We're too late, the rift has closed!$B$BWe'll have to find another way to get to him.

english.title: Runes of Rending
english.objectives: Bypass the wards in Felbreach Hollow and confront Raest Magespear.
english.description:
My brother and his cultists are engaged in some kind of ritual at the far end of the cave. I tried to intervene, but my brother has left magical wards to block the way.

If you can find a way past them, we may be able to stop him in time!
english.completion: Мы опоздали, разлом закрылся!$B$BДолжен быть другой способ найти Рейста!

text.title: 棋差一招
text.objectives: 返回达拉然的紫罗兰城堡向卡德加复命。
text.description:
看来莱斯特已经逃走了，但是至少他的邪教徒已经构不成威胁了。

我们该回肯瑞托了。他们应该可以帮我们计划下一步行动。
text.completion: So Raest escaped? This is unfortunate. $B$BStill, I will rest easier knowing the Nethersworn cultists will no longer skulk in the streets of Dalaran. I thank you for that.$B$BThe Kirin Tor will set out at once to figure out how we can reach Raest in the Twisting Nether. I will send for you when we find a way to reach him.

english.title: One Step Behind
english.objectives: Return to Khadgar in the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
english.description:
It looks like Raest is out of our reach, but at least his cultists should prove less of a threat.

We should return to the Kirin Tor. They should be able to help us plan our next move.
english.completion: Так значит, Рейст сбежал? Как неудачно вышло.$B$BНо я буду спать спокойно, зная, что сектанты культа Пустоты больше не шастают по улицам Даларана. Спасибо тебе.$B$BКирин-Тор незамедлительно займется поисками местоположения Рейста в Круговерти Пустоты. Я пришлю за тобой, когда у нас будет решение.

text.title: 夜之子学徒
text.objectives: 前往深红林地寻找奥术师莱娜。
text.description:
如果你不介意走点远路的话，我很乐意向你介绍我的新学徒。她目前正在野外侦察一处邪脉反抗军的飞地，那些人已经宣誓效忠军团。

身为第一个加入提瑞斯秘法会的夜之子，她肯定很想证明一下自己的实力！
text.completion: I've heard so much about you, Archmage $n. It is a pleasure to finally meet you!

english.title: The Nightborne Apprentice
english.objectives: Meet Arcanist Ryanna in the Crimson Thicket.
english.description:
I would be happy to introduce you to my new apprentice if you do not mind traveling a bit. She is currently in the field keeping an eye on an enclave of Felborne resistance fighters who have sworn loyalty to the Legion. 

As the first nightborne to join the Tirisgarde, I am sure she is eager to prove her skills!
english.completion: Supreme Mage $n! I've heard so much about you! Very nice to finally meet you in person!

text.title: 占卜之眼
text.objectives: 在启迪平台检查$1oa个暮色卫队占卜宝珠。
text.description:
直到不久之前，莉莉丝一直定期从暗夜要塞发来魔法情报。她向来谨慎，这些情报都隐藏得很好——只有最警觉的占卜师才有可能侦测出来。

王宫里是不可能有这样的人……暗夜井对他们的干扰太大了……

对了！启迪平台！暮色卫队肯定在那里设立了监听哨站。

检查一下占卜宝珠，寻找莉莉丝的情报线索。我们必须搞清楚她想告诉我们什么！
text.completion: So they did intercept her messages! I hope Ly'leth is okay...$B$BWe must investigate this breach she spoke of immediately!

english.title: Those Scrying Eyes
english.objectives: Inspect $1oa Duskwatch Scrying Orbs in the Terrace of Enlightenment.
english.description:
Until recently, Ly'leth was sending magical messages to us regularly from within the Nighthold. She took care to hide these messages - only the most vigilant scryers could have detected them.

They could not be within the palace... too much interference from the Nightwell...

Of course! The Terrace of Enlightenment! The Duskwatch must have set up a listening post there.

Check the scrying orbs for traces of Ly'leth's messages. We must learn what she was trying to tell us!
english.completion: Так значит, они все-таки перехватили ее послания! Надеюсь, с Ли'лет ничего не случилось...$B$BМы должны как можно скорее осмотреть этот пролом, о котором она хотела нам сообщить!

objectiveDetails.description: 检查暮色卫队占卜宝珠

text.title: 重返卡拉赞：盒装焦镜
text.objectives: 从卡拉赞的魔力吞噬者身上获得法力焦镜。
text.description:
该死！远古魔力好像没用。我得好好想想，集中精神……$b$b等等，没错！集中！我们得把远古魔力的能量集中起来，才能激活这个盒子。$b$b
我听说，卡拉赞有头法力浮龙能够集中自己的能量。那或许就是我们所需要的东西！$b$b但请小心点，我的线人说，这头法力浮龙硕大无朋！
text.completion: You've done it! Was the wyrm truly gargantuan? Oh, nevermind, size is relative...$B$BLet us get this focus into the cube and see what it does!

english.title: Return to Karazhan: Cubic Cynosure
english.objectives: Obtain a Mana Focus from the Mana Devourer within Karazhan
english.description: Drat! The ancient mana doesn't seem to be working. I need to think the problem through, focus and...$b$bWait, that's it! Focus! We need to focus the energy of the ancient mana to activate the cube.$b$bI've heard tell of a mana wyrm in Karazhan with the means to focus its powers. Might be just what we need!$b$bWatch out, though. My sources tell me this wyrm is humongous!
english.completion: У тебя получилось! Что, змей и правда оказался гигантским? Впрочем, это неважно. Размер – понятие относительное... $b$bДавай-ка лучше установим эту сферу в куб и посмотрим, что получится!

text.title: 盒装聚合
text.objectives: 激活神秘的盒子
text.description:
成功了！盒子的魔力恢复了！我已经等不及想看看它的功能了！

你为它奔波了那么久，激活它的荣誉应该属于你。你想试试吗？
text.completion: <Something about the power coursing through the cube urges you to take it into your possession.>

english.title: Cubic Coalescing
english.objectives: Activate the Mysterious Cube
english.description:
Success! The cube's magic has been restored! I'm excited to see what it does!

Since you did all the legwork, you should have the honor of activating it. Care to give it a try?
english.completion: <It feels like the cube is pushing you to pick it up. >

text.title: 做好准备
text.objectives: 使用大领主达里安·莫格莱尼旁边的黑锋之门，然后找到米妮瓦·悲鸦。
text.description: 死亡领主，我们发现了一件传世之宝，它意义重大，力量非凡。霜牙的挽具出现在了冰冠堡垒。我们一定要拿到它，不能让它落入别人的手中。$b$b我想你肯定愿意亲自去把挽具取回来吧？我们已经派了个人先去侦察，她的名字叫做米妮瓦·悲鸦。你以前见过她的，对吧？她给我们留下了深刻的印象，我们相信，在你的指点下，她一定会变得更加强大。$b$b我会为你开启一座黑锋之门。你最好去那里见她。
text.completion: Deathlord! The vrykul have the harness!

english.title: Making Preparations
english.objectives: Take the Death Gate near Highlord Darion Mograine, then meet Minerva Ravensorrow.
english.description: Deathlord, we have uncovered an heirloom of great significance and power. Rimefang's harness has appeared in Icecrown Citadel. We must obtain it, rather than let it fall into the hands of others.$b$bI assume you'd like to retrieve the harness personally? We've sent one of our own, Minerva Ravensorrow, ahead to scout. You've met her before, yes? She has impressed us greatly, and we believe she can become quite powerful under your tutelage.$b$bI will open a death gate for you. It is best you meet her there.
english.completion: $gLord:Lord; death! The Vraicles have taken the harness!

text.title: 多米尔之翼
text.objectives: 骑上多米尔，前往破碎海滩。
text.description: 时候就要到了，$p。我们的部队新增了这些龙之后，就做好了突袭破碎海滩的准备。有一支庞大的恶魔分遣队出现在了我们的一个营地附近。他们人多势众，已经令我们的盟友疲于应付了。$b$b我们这种不惧死亡，而且具有秘密武器的人正是对付这些恶魔的最佳人选，不是吗？$b$b乘上多米尔吧。我们到那儿见。
text.completion: Let's show the Legion true power.

english.title: On Daumyr's Wings
english.objectives: Ride Daumyr to the Broken Shore.
english.description: The time is nigh, $p. With these new dragons in our army, we are prepared for our assault on the Broken Shore. A large detachment of demons have appeared near one of our camps, and there are far too many of them for any of our allies to overcome.$b$bWho better to defeat these demons than those without fear of death? Those with quite the large secret weapon?$b$bTake Daumyr. We will meet you there.
english.completion: Let's show the Legion true power.

text.title: 双重保险
text.objectives: 在破碎海滩与艾萨斯见面。
text.description:
一台构造体原型机？这下我们的问题就能解决了，真有创意！

现在，我们大概不用释放卡萨纳提尔就能引导他的力量了，但是我还想在尝试前增加一层防护措施，以防万一。我才不会落人口实呢！

你准备好后，就到破碎海滩来找我吧！
text.completion: Let us get to work, shall we?
text.completed: 在破碎海滩与艾萨斯见面。

english.title: Redundancy
english.objectives: Meet Aethas on the Broken Shore.
english.description:
A construct progenitor? What a creative solution to our problem!

We probably could channel Kathra'natir's power without releasing him now, but I want to add another layer of protection before we try, just in case. I will not have anyone accusing me of subterfuge!

Meet me on the Broken Shore when you are ready.
english.completion: Ну что, приступим?
english.completed: Meet Aethas on the Broken Shore.

text.title: 活在当下
text.objectives: 将阿坎多尔的果实交给沙尔艾兰的一名苏拉玛难民。
text.description:
感谢你能来，外来者。很高兴再次见到你。

我在城里遇到了一些麻烦，需要你的帮助，但首先……

让我们谈谈希望。

<塔莉萨指了指阿坎多尔。>

阿坎多尔的果实确实能帮我的人民摆脱暗夜井。但是，它的生长速度只有这么快。我们需要一段时间才能推广这种疗法。

我认为，理应让你来帮我分发成熟的果实。请拿着这颗果实，将它交给任意一名难民。
text.completion: I will ask this of you again, as more fruit is ready.$B$BFor now, we have some disturbing news to discuss.

english.title: One Day at a Time
english.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
english.description:
Thank you for coming, outlander. It is good to see you again.

I have a situation in the city that needs your attention, but first... 

Let us talk of hope.

<Thalyssra gestures toward the arcan'dor.>

The fruit of the arcan'dor can truly free my people from the Nightwell. However, it only grows so fast. It will take time to distribute this cure.

I think it only right that you help me pass out the fruit as it is ready. Please take this, and give it to anyone.
english.completion: Когда поспеют новые плоды, я снова обращусь к тебе с той же просьбой.$B$BА пока нам с тобой нужно обсудить кое-какие тревожные новости.

text.title: 继续治疗
text.objectives: 将阿坎多尔的果实交给沙尔艾兰的一名苏拉玛难民。
text.description:
由于残月酒馆发生的事件，这里的难民更急于获得阿坎多尔的赐福，永远摆脱暗夜井。

幸好，树上又结出了更多的果实。我想再请你帮忙，把这颗果实交给沙尔艾兰的任意一个难民。

等你完成这个任务后，我们再来讨论城里的局势发展。希尔格林报告说，奥露乐很有天分，他们二人疏散市民的行动已经取得了不错的进展。
text.completion: Good, now to set our attention to those still suffering within the city.

english.title: Continuing the Cure
english.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
english.description:
Given the events at the Waning Crescent, the refugees here are more eager than ever to receive the gift of the arcan'dor and be free of the Nightwell forever. 

Fortunately, the tree has borne more fruit. Again, I ask that you honor us by giving this fruit to anyone here in Shal'Aran.

When you are finished, we shall discuss further developments within the city. Silgryn reports that Arluelle has proven a fine student, and the two are making progress in evacuating citizens.
english.completion: Хорошо. Теперь мы должны позаботиться и о тех несчастных, что еще остаются в городе.

text.title: 莉莉丝的消息
text.objectives: 将阿坎多尔的果实交给沙尔艾兰的一名苏拉玛难民。
text.description:
阿坎多尔又结出了新的果实。你来得也正是时候——莉莉丝发来了情报，她似乎有了关于凡瑟尔的线索。如果我们能找到他的话，他早就该享受这份赐福了。

在我破译莉莉丝的情报时，请将这颗果实发给沙尔艾兰的任意一位平民吧。
text.completion: There. I certainly hope Ly'leth has good news...

english.title: A Message From Ly'leth
english.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
english.description:
The arcan'dor bears fruit once again. Just in time, too - Ly'leth has sent us a message, and it seems she may have a lead on Vanthir. He is long overdue for this gift, assuming we manage to find him.

Give a fruit to another citizen here in Shal'Aran while I finish decrypting Ly'leth's message.
english.completion: Done. I really hope that Li'let wanted to tell us the good news ...

text.title: 会前进食
text.objectives: 将阿坎多尔的果实交给沙尔艾兰的一名苏拉玛难民。
text.description:
有凡瑟尔在，这里的人全都精神大振。我敢说，有些人已经开始享受起这份新的自由了，虽然他们依然怀念自己挚爱的那座城市。

在将城市还给大家前，我是不会罢休的。

现在，你跟我要去参加一场重要的会议。但在离开前，我们再分发一次阿坎多尔的果实吧。

我希望大家知道，虽然我暂时离开了，但我绝不会抛弃他们。
text.completion: Very well, let us go.

english.title: Eating Before the Meeting
english.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
english.description:
Having Vanthir around has done much to lift the spirits of the people here. I dare say some have begun to relish their newfound freedom, even if they miss their beloved city.

I will not rest until I can give it back to them.

You and I have an important meeting to attend. Before we go, let us distribute more of the arcan'dor's fruit. 

I want people to know that although I must leave for now, I have not abandoned them.
english.completion: Отлично, мы готовы отправляться.

text.title: 供养起义军
text.objectives: 将阿坎多尔的果实交给沙尔艾兰的一名苏拉玛难民。
text.description:
每天都有更多的夜之子逃离苏拉玛，加入我们的行列。

我们的军队正在壮大。有了像你这样的大英雄，以及部落和联盟军队的帮助，我们胜利的希望越来越大。

帮我分发更多阿坎多尔的果实吧——每颗果实都意味着，又有一个生命摆脱了暗夜井的奴役！

之后，我们再来看看怎么协助我们的新盟友围攻苏拉玛城。
text.completion: Good. Now let us see to business at the warfront.

english.title: Feeding the Rebellion
english.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
english.description:
More nightborne flee Suramar every day to join our cause.

Our ranks are swelling, and with the aid of great heroes like yourself and the armies of the Horde and Alliance, our chances have never been better.

Help me hand out more fruit of the arcan'dor - each one is a life free from slavish dependence on the Nightwell!

Afterwards, we shall speak on how best to assist our new allies in their siege.
english.completion: Хорошо. Теперь мы можем спокойно заняться нашими делами на фронте.

text.title: 统一战线
text.objectives: 将阿坎多尔的果实交给沙尔艾兰的一名苏拉玛难民。
text.description:
我们的起义军战士已经武装起来了，而且士气高昂——就连联盟和部落的精灵也不再争吵了。

我们就快准备好了，马上就可以向苏拉玛城进军。

把这周的果实分发出去吧，然后我们就可以开始准备了。
text.completion: The time has come.

english.title: A United Front
english.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
english.description:
Our rebel fighters have been armed and morale is high - even the Alliance and Horde elves have ceased their squabbling.

We are nearly ready to march on the city.

Hand out this week's fruit, and then we can begin preparations.
english.completion: It's time.

text.title: 攻城之前
text.objectives: 将阿坎多尔的果实交给沙尔艾兰的一名苏拉玛难民。
text.description:
我在暗夜要塞渡过了那么多年的研究生涯……

我从来没有想到自己有一天得杀回那里。

时间紧迫。战斗马上就要开始了。

不过，按照我们的传统，请先把这颗阿坎多尔的果实交给一个难民。
text.completion: Just in time. We are ready to begin.

english.title: Before the Siege
english.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
english.description:
So many years of my life spent studying within the Nighthold... 

Never had I considered that I would one day have to fight my way back in.

Time is short. The battle will be upon us soon. 

Please, continue our tradition and feed another refugee the fruit of the arcan'dor.
english.completion: Ты очень вовремя. Можем начинать.

text.title: 顾问与奥术师
text.objectives: 将阿坎多尔的果实交给沙尔艾兰的一名苏拉玛难民。
text.description:
艾利桑德新任命的这个首席奥术师，这个叫……安达丽斯的，如果她跟传闻说的一样危险，那莉莉丝很可能斗不过她。

对不起，我不应该长他人志气。但我们收到了一个坏消息。

请帮我分发一下最近这批阿坎多尔的果实，然后我们来讨论这个消息。
text.completion: I am glad we can still cure my people, but... I have troubling news.

english.title: The Advisor and the Arcanist
english.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
english.description:
This new First Arcanist appointed by Elisande. This... Andaris. If she is as dangerous as I have heard, then Ly'leth may well be lost.

I am sorry, I should not entertain such thoughts. It is just that we have received a troubling message.

Help me distribute the latest batch of the arcan'dor fruit, then we will discuss the message.
english.completion: Я очень рада, что мы можем дать моим собратьям свободу, но... У меня плохие новости.

text.title: 品尝自由
text.objectives: 将阿坎多尔的果实交给沙尔艾兰的一名苏拉玛难民。
text.description:
我们已经做好了万全的准备。只要把瓦尔托伊的计划付诸实践，我们就可以进攻秩序大殿，了结安达丽斯了。她绝对想不到，我们会训练枯法者来对抗邪能魔法，她的傲慢会招致她的灭亡。

来吧，我们最后再来分发一次果实。
text.completion: Very well. Let us begin.

english.title: A Taste of Freedom
english.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
english.description:
We are as ready as we will ever be. Once we put Valtrois' plan into action, we can attack the Sanctum of Order and put an end to Andaris. She will never expect us to have trained our withered against fel magic, and her hubris will be her downfall.

Come, let us feed the people one last time.
english.completion: Хорошо. Приступим.

text.title: 起义
text.objectives: 跟沙尔艾兰的首席奥术师塔莉萨谈一谈。
text.description: 首席奥术师塔莉萨收到了有关堕夜精灵起义军的坏消息，她需要你的帮助。$b$b到苏拉玛的沙尔艾兰去见她吧。
text.completion: Welcome hero. Your arrival could not have been better timed.

english.title: Insurrection
english.objectives: Speak with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
english.description: First Arcanist Thalyssra has received dark tidings regarding the Nightfallen rebellion and requires your assistance.$b$bJourney to Shal'Aran in Suramar and meet with her.
english.completion: Welcome hero. Your arrival could not have been better timed.

text.title: 起义：失踪人员
text.objectives: 跟沙尔艾兰的首席奥术师塔莉萨谈一谈。
text.description: 首席奥术师塔莉萨请你帮忙寻找失踪的同胞。$b$b她从一个意想不到的盟友那里获得了线索。$b$b快到苏拉玛的沙尔艾兰去见她吧。
text.completion: Welcome hero. Your arrival could not have been better timed.

english.title: Insurrection: Missing Persons
english.objectives: Speak with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
english.description: First Arcanist Thalyssra has requested your aid in searching for her missing people.$b$bShe has a lead from a very unexpected ally.$b$bMeet with her at Shal'Aran in Suramar.
english.completion: Welcome hero. Your arrival could not have been better timed.

text.title: 起义：残月渐圆
text.objectives: 跟沙尔艾兰的首席奥术师塔莉萨谈一谈。
text.description: 首席奥术师塔莉萨发来消息：她已经联络上了莉莉丝，正需要你的帮助。$b$b快去苏拉玛的沙尔艾兰，尽你所能帮助她吧。
text.completion: You are going to want to hear this.

english.title: Insurrection: Waxing Crescent
english.objectives: Speak with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
english.description: First Arcanist Thalyssra has sent word: there has been communication from Ly'leth. Your help is needed.$b$bJourney to Shal'Aran in Suramar and lend what aid you can.
english.completion: You are going to want to hear this.

text.title: Insurrection: An Elven Problem
text.objectives: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
text.description: The Alliance and Horde have arrived in Suramar. First Arcanist Thalyssra needs your help in providing an introduction.$b$bMeet with Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
text.completion: It would seem the elves have returned to Suramar.

english.title: Insurrection: An Elven Problem
english.objectives: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
english.description: The Alliance and Horde have arrived in Suramar. First Arcanist Thalyssra needs your help in providing an introduction.$b$bMeet with Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
english.completion: It would seem the elves have returned to Suramar.

text.title: 起义：备战
text.objectives: 前往沙尔艾兰找首席奥术师塔莉萨。
text.description: 难民如潮水般涌入沙尔艾兰，很多人都愿意加入塔莉萨的起义军。$b$b他们需要武器、训练，以及一切有能力的人提供的帮助。$b$b快去沙尔艾兰，伸出你的援手吧。
text.completion: This is an unexpected problem, but we have more soldiers than food or weapons.

english.title: Insurrection: Crafting War
english.objectives: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
english.description: Refugees are flooding in to Shal'Aran, and many are willing to fight for Thalyssra's rebel army.$b$bThey need weapons, training and help from anyone who can provide it.$b$bGo to Shal'Aran and lend your assistance.
english.completion: This is an unexpected problem, but we have more soldiers than food or weapons.

text.title: 起义：进军苏拉玛
text.objectives: 前往沙尔艾兰找首席奥术师塔莉萨。
text.description: 首席奥术师塔莉萨传来消息：是时候发动对苏拉玛的突袭了。部落、联盟、肯瑞托和堕夜精灵的部队已经齐聚一堂。$b$b等你一到，他们就会开始突袭。$b$b快去沙尔艾兰向首席奥术师塔莉萨报到，准备战斗吧。
text.completion: The time for our attack has come. It is time for us to take back Suramar from Elisande and her demonic allies!

english.title: Insurrection: March on Suramar
english.objectives: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
english.description: First Arcanist Thalyssra has sent word: the time has come to launch our assault on Suramar. The elven armies of the Horde, Alliance, Kirin Tor and Nightfallen are assembled.$b$BThey only await your arrival to begin their assault.$b$bReport to Shal'Aran and meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra and prepare for battle.
english.completion: The time for our attack has come. It is time for us to take back Suramar from Elisande and her demonic allies!

text.title: 起义：艾利桑德的反击
text.objectives: 前往沙尔艾兰找首席奥术师塔莉萨。
text.description: 精灵联军已经准备好围攻暗夜要塞的城门了。$b$b向沙尔艾兰的首席奥术师塔莉萨报到，开始围攻。
text.completion: The time for our attack has come. It is time for us to take back Suramar from Elisande and her demonic allies!

english.title: Insurrection: Elisande's Retort
english.objectives: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
english.description: The combined forces of the elves stand ready to begin their siege on the gates of the Nighthold.$b$bReport to First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran to begin the siege.
english.completion: The time for our attack has come. It is time for us to take back Suramar from Elisande and her demonic allies!

text.title: Insurrection: As Strong As Our Will
text.objectives: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
text.description: In the wake of Elisande's attack, the need is stronger than ever to add to the ranks of the Nightfallen rebellion.$b$bPlans are in motion that may help with this in an unconventional way.$b$BReport to First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran for more details.
text.completion: Thank you for coming. Your skills will prove to be invaluable for this next part of our plan.

text.title: 重返卡拉赞：书虫
text.objectives: 整理卡拉赞图书馆。
text.description: 在灵体状态下，我第一次安全地进入了塔楼。但我得说，那里实在是太乱了！$b$b我需要有人帮忙完成我的打扫清单。我们先从图书馆开始吧。那些发霉的书籍肯定会招来法力浮龙的！$b$b请把掉在地上或者干脆飞起来的书本放回书架上。如果发现有法力浮龙在啃食书页……就把它们踩死！
text.completion: You were HOW small? Gracious! That must have complicated things.$B$BIt looks like there are more books on the floor than when we started. It's as if the books keep jumping off the shelves or something...$B$BThis is going to be harder than I thought!

english.title: Return to Karazhan: Book Wyrms
english.objectives: Clean up the Karazhan Library.
english.description: My incorporeal condition has allowed me to enter the tower safely for the first time. I must say, it's a bit of a shambles in there!$b$bI could use some help tackling my cleaning checklist. We should start with the library. All those musty tomes are bound to attract mana wyrms!$b$bPlease shelve any books that have fallen to the floor, or worse, taken flight. And if you find mana wyrms nibbling at the pages... step on them!
english.completion: You were HOW small? Gracious! That must have complicated things.$B$BIt looks like there are more books on the floor than when we started. It's as if the books keep jumping off the shelves or something...$B$BThis is going to be harder than I thought!

objectiveDetails.description: 将会飞的书本放入书架

text.title: 重返卡拉赞：重启清洁工
text.objectives: 关闭馆长，并找到备用动力水晶盒。
text.description: 守护者麦迪文制造馆长是为了守护卡拉赞，但那玩意儿现在恐怕已经疯了。超期服役就可能导致各种故障。$B$B请你到展览馆去关闭馆长。然后在那里找一找，取一个备用动力水晶盒回来给我。$b$b虽然我只有一些基本知识，但应该也能为它更换动力源。等我们把动力装置换好后，就可以让馆长帮忙清理这座塔楼了。
text.progress: Did you find the box of spares?
text.completion: The box is empty? Drat!$B$BI may be a mage, but I'll never be able to copy Medivh's motivator crystal enchantment!

english.title: Return to Karazhan: Rebooting the Cleaner
english.objectives: Disable the Curator and find the Box of Spare Motivator Crystals.
english.description: The Guardian Medivh created the Curator to watch over Karazhan, but I fear the unit is behaving erratically. Prolonged periods of operation may have caused a malfunction.$B$BPlease go up to the Menagerie and disable the Curator. Also, search the area for a box of spare motivator crystals and return to me.$b$bEven with my basic knowledge I should be able to replace its motivator, and we can enlist the Curator's help in cleaning up the tower.
english.progress: Did you find the box of spares?
english.completion: The box is empty? Drat!$B$BI may be a mage, but I'll never be able to copy Medivh's motivator crystal enchantment!

text.title: 重返卡拉赞：新马掌
text.objectives: 把一盒“新”马掌拿给卡拉赞的铁匠库雷恩。
text.description: 到目前为止，我的卡拉赞大扫除计划还没有什么振奋人心的成果。该换个思路了。$B$B穿新鞋不能走老路……新鞋……马掌，对了！塔楼外面有一盒弃置的马掌。要找个愿意送货上门的快递员可不容易……毕竟伤亡率有点偏高。$b$b如果你愿意的话，拿上盒子，把它交给马厩里的库雷恩吧。路过阿图门的地盘时要小心。那个猎手对外来者不太友善。
text.progress: How did it go?
text.completion: Oh dear. My fault entirely!$B$BI should have ensured the horseshoes were in good shape before having you deliver them.$B$BThe humidity out here is a real killer!

english.title: Return to Karazhan: New Shoes
english.objectives: Deliver the Box of 'New' Horseshoes to Koren the Blacksmith in Karazhan.
english.description: Thus far my Karazhan cleanup project hasn't exactly been a rousing success. Time to try something new.$B$BNew, as in new shoes... horseshoes, that is! A box of horseshoes was left outside the tower. It's a problem finding a delivery person willing to set foot inside... mortality rates being what they are.$B$BIf you would, grab the crate and take it to Koren in the stables. Just be careful passing Attumen. The huntsman doesn't take kindly to outsiders.
english.progress: How did it go?
english.completion: Oh dear. My fault entirely!$B$BI should have ensured the horseshoes were in good shape before having you deliver them.$B$BThe humidity out here is a real killer!

text.title: 重返卡拉赞：停工的压力
text.objectives: 在观众中收集积极评价，帮助达里乌斯恢复旧剧目演员的自尊心，缓解罗密欧和朱丽叶的对立情绪，从某位新演员那里偷一束玫瑰送给铁皮人以满足他的虚荣心，并在象棋室找到偷了小红帽斗篷的替补演员。
text.description: 大家都很喜欢歌剧院的新剧目……但老剧目的那些演员例外。他们的自尊心受到了伤害，气氛也变得紧张起来！$B$B罗密欧和朱丽叶都恨不得毒死对方了。$B$B铁皮人因为无人欣赏而痛哭流涕，都生锈了。$b$b小红帽的斗篷被一个怨气冲天的替补演员偷走了，然后那家伙就跑去下棋了。$b$b演员嘛，就喜欢闹情绪，对吧？我们得让他们打起精神，以防观众哪天又想怀旧了。请帮帮我，让他们的冷静下来！
text.progress: How did it go?
text.completion: I can't believe you found what we needed!$B$BUh, not that I doubt you, it's just... well, this is the first time one of my projects has actually worked out.$B$BAnyway, I think delivering these items to the actors will ease tensions for a while.$B$BThis is a momentous day!

english.title: Return to Karazhan: High Stress Hiatus
english.objectives: Help Darius soothe the old casts egos by finding a Positive Review amongst the audience members to simmer tensions between Romulo and Julianne, stealing a Bouquet of Roses from one of the new acts for Tinhead's vanity and finding where the understudy stashed Little Red's cape in the Chess room.
english.description: The new plays in the opera house have been well received by everyone... except cast members of the older shows. Egos are bruised and tensions are running high!$B$BRomulo and Julianne are ready to poison each other.$B$BTinhead is rusting with tears over his lack of adoration.$B$BLittle Red's cape was stolen by a disgruntled understudy, who ran off to play chess of all things.$B$BActors, am I right? We need them ready to perform in case the audience demands a revival. Please, help me calm their nerves!
english.progress: How did it go?
english.completion: I can't believe you found what we needed!$B$BUh, not that I doubt you, it's just... well, this is the first time one of my projects has actually worked out.$B$BAnyway, I think delivering these items to the actors will ease tensions for a while.$B$BThis is a momentous day!

text.title: 重返卡拉赞：清理蛛网
text.objectives: 把仆役宿舍的蜘蛛清理干净。
text.description: 我承认……虽然已经是幽灵了，但我还是怕蜘蛛，怕得要死。那些腿！还有滴着口水的獠牙！还有粘乎乎的网，从它们的……那个里射出来……$b$b<达里乌斯扭了扭身子，做了个不雅动作。>$b$b不过，像你这样能拯救世界的大英雄肯定不怕它们。这很好，因为有一大群蜘蛛已经占据了仆役宿舍。$b$b你会搞定它们的，对吧？如果不彻底铲除它们，它们还会继续繁殖的。
text.completion: You got every single spider, right?$B$BEither way, I'll just check that one off the list. No need to check up on your work.$B$B<Darius makes a squinched-up face.>

english.title: Return to Karazhan: Clearing Out the Cobwebs
english.objectives: Clean out spiders from the Servant's Quarters.
english.description: I admit it... even as a spirit, I am deathly afraid of spiders. All those legs! Dripping fangs! Sticky webs coming out of their...$b$b<Darius does a squirming sort of shimmy that is uncomfortable to watch.>$b$bI'm sure a world-saving hero like you doesn't mind them, though. Which is good, since a whole brood of spiders has taken over the Servant's Quarters.$b$bYou'll handle this, right? If you don't get them all, they'll keep multiplying.
english.completion: You got every single spider, right?$B$BEither way, I'll just check that one off the list. No need to check up on your work.$B$B<Darius makes a squinched-up face.>

text.title: 挑骨头
text.objectives: 将烧焦的碎骨带给达里乌斯。
text.description: 古老的能量依然在这些烧焦的碎骨上延烧。达里乌斯一定很乐意检查这些骨头并听听你是怎么击败夜之魇的。
text.completion: Nightbane has been defeated! I'm in awe!$B$BMany years have passed since the blue dragon Arcanagos was slain by the corrupted Medivh. Archmage Alturus sought out the remains of the fallen dragon in an effort to study the Guardian's power. $B$BIn retrospect, maybe not the best idea. $B$BYour help has been invaluable.$B$BI still have a lot of work ahead to clean up Karazhan, but for now I dare ask no more of you. Thank you again for your assistance, $n.

english.title: No Bones About It
english.objectives: Take the Charred Bone Fragments to Darius.
english.description: The Charred Bone Fragments still smolder with ancient power. Darius would be extremely interested in examining them and hearing of your defeat of Nightbane.
english.completion: Nightbane has been defeated! I'm in awe!$B$BMany years have passed since the blue dragon Arcanagos was slain by the corrupted Medivh. Archmage Alturus sought out the remains of the fallen dragon in an effort to study the Guardian's power. $B$BIn retrospect, maybe not the best idea. $B$BYour help has been invaluable.$B$BI still have a lot of work ahead to clean up Karazhan, but for now I dare ask no more of you. Thank you again for your assistance, $n.

text.title: 身先士卒
text.objectives: 与凯拉·光刃谈一谈，然后选择飞往马顿。
text.description:
这几个月，马顿一直都风平浪静。我很好奇，燃烧军团为什么突然想起来攻击我们了？也许是为了报复我们毁掉了他们在破碎海滩的战舰……

我们最好亲自下去，拯救一下世界，你觉得呢？
text.completion: Good, you made it.

english.title: Taking Charge
english.objectives: Talk to Kyra Lightblade and choose to fly down to Mardum.
english.description:
Mardum has been quiet for months. I wonder why the Legion is attacking us now? Could be in retaliation for destroying their battleship on the Broken Shore...

We had better head down ourselves and save the day, don't you agree?
english.completion: Ты $gприбыл:прибыла;! Отлично.

text.objectives: 带上这一小撮毛发回到搏击俱乐部。
text.description: 你的勇士带回了一小撮染着血迹，乱成一团还臭烘烘的毛发。
text.completion: I can't believe you beat him! Meatball was so impressed he now insists he wants to work for you. Hope you don't regret it!

text.title: 稳定苏拉玛
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛完成10个世界任务。
text.description:
艾利桑德的计划起了反效果。她以为残月酒馆的行动可以杀一儆百，扑灭起义。

恰恰相反，她点燃了夏多雷的怒火，比我之前所做的努力还有效果。

我们必须团结一致，继续与艾利桑德和燃烧军团做斗争，整个苏拉玛都是我们的战场。

要用行动告诉人民，希望犹存——依然有英雄愿意为他们战斗！
text.completion: Thank you, $n. Every day we come closer to freedom for Suramar.

english.title: Stabilizing Suramar
english.objectives: Complete 10 world quests in Suramar.
english.description:
Elisande's plan has backfired. She thought to stamp out our rebellion by making an example of the Waning Crescent. 

Instead, she ignited the flame of the shal'dorei better than I ever could.

We must maintain a cohesive campaign against Elisande and the Legion by fighting them in every corner of Suramar. 

Show the people that there is still hope - that there are still heroes willing to fight for them!
english.completion: Спасибо тебе, $n. C каждым днем Сурамар все ближе к тому, чтобы снова обрести свободу.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成苏拉玛的10个世界任务

text.title: 全线出击
text.objectives: 在你的职业大厅完成5个任务。
text.description:
我们马上就能围攻大门了。你实在是劳苦功高，$n。

但别忘了，你还是$ct。你的军队需要你的指挥。没有人能独力对抗军团。

继续履行你的职责吧。领导艾泽拉斯的$c，胜利必将到来。
text.completion: Leadership is a difficult burden, $n.$B$BWe must often split our attention - be sure to keep the big picture in mind.

english.title: Fighting on All Fronts
english.objectives: Complete 5 missions from your Order Hall.
english.description:
We are nearly ready to siege the gates. Your efforts here have been monumental, $n.

But let us not forget that you are also the $ct. Your forces rely on you to command them. No single person can stand against the Legion.

Continue your duty. Guide the $cs of Azeroth, and victory will be assured.
english.completion: Ответственность командира – тяжкое бремя, $n.$B$BЧасто нам приходится отвлекаться то на одно, то на другое, и в эти минуты важнее всего постоянно держать в голове общую картину происходящего.

text.title: 行动：传送门
text.objectives: 关闭3个军团传送门。
text.description: 这场入侵很严重，但像你这样的屠魔者是无所不能的。该让这对武器见见血了！
text.completion: That was surprisingly easy...

english.title: Operation: Portals
english.objectives: Close 3 Legion portals.
english.description: This is a serious invasion, but nothing a Slayer like you can't handle. Time to put those weapons to work!
english.completion: Это оказалось на удивление просто...

text.title: 侦察小队
text.objectives: 找到赛丝诺女士和10个伊利达雷斥候。
text.description:
我们会停下工作，专心寻找失踪的斥候和赛丝诺女士。我猜她可能不想被我们找到。

尽力而为吧，$n！
text.completion: You got most of our scouts out alive. And Lady S'theno appears somewhat chastened, at least. Well done!

english.title: Scouting Party
english.objectives: Find Lady S'theno and 10 Illidari Scouts.
english.description:
We will have our work cut out for us finding the missing scouts and Lady S'theno. I suspect that one does not wish to be found.

Do your best, $n!
english.completion: Почти всех разведчиков удалось вытащить живыми. Да и леди С'тэно, похоже, в неплохом настроении. Спасибо тебе!

text.title: 重返阿彻鲁斯
text.objectives: 返回阿彻鲁斯向大领主达里安·莫格莱尼复命。
text.description: 相比我们上次见面时，你又成长了许多，$n。现在挽具已经到手了，让我们看看莫格莱尼有没有使用挽具的计划吧。
text.completion: Welcome back, Deathlord. I see you were successful.

english.title: Return to Acherus
english.objectives: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine in Acherus.
english.description: You've grown a lot since we last met, $n. Now that we have the harness, let's see if Mograine has a plan to use it.
english.completion: С возвращением, |3-6($ct). Вижу, все прошло удачно.

text.title: 邪能之槌号防御战
text.objectives: 使用伊利达雷传送门返回邪能之槌号。
text.description: 我们得马上返回邪能之槌号！
text.completion: That was quite a hit you took...$B$BFrankly, I'm amazed that the Fel Hammer didn't self destruct when we fired her weapons. We are lucky to be alive.

english.title: Defense of the Fel Hammer
english.objectives: Use the Illidari Gateway to return to the Fel Hammer.
english.description: We need to get back to the Fel Hammer ASAP!
english.completion: Ничего себе взрыв... $b$bПросто удивительно, что "Молот Скверны" не самоуничтожился, когда мы дали залп из его орудий. Просто чудо, что мы все остались живы!

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“邪能之槌号防御战”场景战役

text.title: 帮助盟友
text.objectives: 对患病的抗魔联军战士使用传染病疫苗。
text.description:
不幸的是，你的许多盟友都在这片被邪能腐蚀的海滩上参加了战斗。

他们中有很多人都感染了疫病，所以始终无法在战斗中占据上风。

拿上疫苗，用它去帮助你的盟友吧。

我和罗兰会在这里救治伤患的。
text.completion: Your allies have you to thank for their lives.

english.title: Administering Aid
english.objectives: Apply the Contagion Counteragent to sickly Legionfall Fighters.
english.description:
Unfortunately, it would seem many of your allies have already taken to fighting on these fel corrupted shores. 

They will never be able to gain the upper hand in battle while so many are suffering from the contagion. 

Take the counteragent and use it to administer aid to your allies. 

Roland and I will handle the injuries here.
english.completion: Your allies have you to thank for their lives.

text.title: 奇怪的传染病
text.objectives: 前往至高岭寻找艾萨莱斯特。
text.description: 我注意到，有种奇怪的疫病正在至高岭的一小片海滩上肆虐。$b$b当地的部族担心染上这种暂时无药可救的疾病，已经放弃了那里。$b$b我们有位牧师在穿越那一带时，她的伙伴病倒了。她请求了教团的协助。去找到她吧，大祭司，然后尽你所能，防止这种疾病继续传播。
text.completion: Ah, good. So the Conclave received my request. I didn't expect they'd send their leader!

english.title: A Curious Contagion
english.objectives: Find Aelthalyste in Highmountain.
english.description: It has been brought to my attention that a rather curious contagion is spreading through a small coastal region within Highmountain.$B$BThe local tribes have abandoned the area for fear of catching this ailment that currently has no known cure.$B$BOne of our own was traveling through the area when her companion fell ill. She has requested the Conclave's assistance. Seek her out, High Priest, and do whatever you can to stop this sickness from spreading.
english.completion: Прекрасно. Значит, до Конклава дошла моя просьба о помощи. Не думала, что они направят ко мне своего лидера!

text.title: 收集标本
text.objectives: 在至高岭的西部海岸周围的气态邪能池中收集密封的标本。
text.description:
如你所见，我的伙伴病得很厉害。

他一定是染上了那些牛头人得的病。他们整个营地的人都感染了！

这种病的起源似乎是邪能，而且所有已知的疗法都没有效果。

我一直在孜孜不倦地寻找治疗方法，但罗兰恐怕等不了这么久了。

我需要帮手。去从源头找点样本来，应该可以加速我的研究。

记住，千万不要直接接触病原体。漂浮术应该会很有用。
text.progress: Do you have the samples I've requested?
text.completion: I hope you handled these samples with care, $n. I wouldn't forgive myself if I was responsible for getting the High $C sick.

english.title: Sampling the Source
english.objectives: Collect Contaminated Specimens from pools of Gaseous Fel around the western coast of Highmountain.
english.description:
My companion has fallen terribly ill, as you can see. 

He must have caught whatever these taurens had. Their entire camp has been wiped out!

It appears to be fel in origin, and impervious to all known treatments. 

I've been working tirelessly to find a cure, but I don't think Roland here has much time left. 

I could use an extra hand. Some samples from the source should speed things up. 

Just be sure to avoid direct contact with the contagion. Levitate should be helpful.
english.progress: Ты $gпринес:принесла; образцы?
english.completion: Надеюсь, ты $gбыл осторожен:была осторожна;, $n. Я себе не прощу, если $gверховный жрец:верховная жрица; заболеет.

text.title: 淘气的林精
text.objectives: 对黑蹄山地羊使用驱散魔法，让淘气的林精显形，然后收集荧光粉。
text.description: 很少有人知道，林精用来恶作剧的粉末具有治疗效果。$b$B炼金圈子里有些人拒绝接受这个说法，但他们之所以反对，只是因为他们自己没法弄到这种罕见的原料。$b$b林精经常用幻象隐藏自己，规避侦测。$b$b附近的山羊身上都散发着奇怪的微光，说不定就是林精假扮的。$b$b去驱散它们身上的一切魔法，让它们现出真身吧。
text.progress: Have you acquired the Shimmering Dust I so desperately need?
text.completion: Thank you, $n. I thought those goats seemed a little strange.

english.title: Mischievous Sprites
english.objectives: Use Dispel Magic on Soothoof Hillstriders to reveal Mischievous Sprites and collect their Shimmering Dust.
english.description: It's a little-known secret that the dust sprites use for their various tricks has restorative properties.$B$BSome within the alchemy community balk at this claim, but they only refute it because they've never been able to get their hands on the rare ingredient.$B$BSprites often shroud themselves in illusions to avoid detection.$B$BThe nearby goats have a curious shimmer about them that suggests they may be sprites in disguise.$B$BDispel whatever magic surrounds them to reveal their true form.
english.progress: Тебе удалось добыть мерцающую пыль? Она мне очень нужна.
english.completion: Спасибо тебе, $n. Эти козлы показались мне какими-то странными.

text.title: 蹒跚的样本
text.objectives: 对蹒跚的行尸使用束缚亡灵，然后使用尸体采集器收集样本。
text.description: 这种邪能疫病好像分为三个阶段。$b$b早期的特征是持续咳嗽，并产生痰液。$b$b到了中期，皮肤会变成病态的绿色。$b$b晚期受害者会发生彻底的变形，成为一具无意识的行尸。我相信在这个阶段里可以收集到关于这种疾病的绝大多数信息。$b$b我有一种装置，可以安全储存样本。但是要想收集样本，就必须先把受害者束缚起来。
text.completion: While there is no hope of curing those who have reached stage III, at least they will be able to provide crucial information about how the contagion works.

english.title: Shambling Specimens
english.objectives: Use Shackle Undead on Shambling Corpses in order to collect specimens with the Corpse Collector.
english.description: This fel contagion appears to have three stages.$B$BThe first is marked by a persistent, phlegmy cough.$B$BThe second shows the skin turning a sickly shade of green.$B$BThe third involves a complete transformation where the victim turns into a mindless corpse. It is within this stage that I believe the most information about the sickness can be gathered.$B$BI have a contraption that can safely store the specimens, but they will need to be shackled before they can be collected.
english.completion: К сожалению, мы не можем вылечить больных на третьей стадии, но, по крайней мере, с их помощью мы получим ценную информацию об эпидемии.

text.title: 制造解药
text.objectives: 把魔法灌注到未经实验的解药中，然后对罗兰·阿博纳斯使用。
text.description: 我用上了你帮我收集的东西，希望能制造出可靠的解药。现在里面只差某种强大的魔力了，我希望你能帮忙提供一点。$b$b合剂就放在我的炼金台上。$b$b请抓紧时间，$n。罗兰每时每刻都在不断衰弱。
text.progress: Я пойду на что угодно, лишь бы найти лекарство от этой заразы.
text.completion: Brilliant work, $n. For a moment I thought I'd need to find a new companion.

english.title: Crafting a Cure
english.objectives: Infuse the Untested Cure with magic before administering it to Roland Abernathy.
english.description: I used what you gathered for me to craft what I hope will be a reliable cure. The only thing that's missing is some powerful magic, which I hope you'll be able to provide.$B$BThe concoction is there on my alchemy table.$B$BPlease hurry, $n. Roland grows weaker by the minute.
english.progress: Я пойду на что угодно, лишь бы найти лекарство от этой заразы.
english.completion: Прекрасно, $n. Хотя мне на секунду показалось, что придется искать нового помощника.

objectiveDetails.description: 向未经实验的解药添加暗影魔法
向未经实验的解药添加神圣魔法

text.title: 妥善保管
text.objectives: 把传染病疫苗交给虚空之光神殿的阿隆索斯·法奥。
text.description: 看来，要治好这种疫病，关键是保持圣光与暗影魔法的微妙平衡。显然这种解药还要再加工一下，减少讨厌的副作用，比如死亡。$b$b在此期间，请把传染病疫苗带回虚空之光神殿妥善保管吧。我会努力寻找这种疫病的源头的。
text.progress: What do we have here?
text.completion: This cure could not have come at a better time.

english.title: Safekeeping
english.objectives: Take the Contagion Counteragent to Alonsus Faol in Netherlight Temple.
english.description: It would seem that a delicate balance of holy and shadow magic is the key to curing this contagion. Obviously the remedy will need a bit of work to reduce undesired side effects, like dying.$B$BIn the meantime, take the counteragent back to Netherlight Temple and keep it safe. I will work diligently on discovering the source of this contagion.
english.progress: Что тут у нас?
english.completion: Противоядие? Как раз вовремя!

text.title: 前往破碎海滩
text.objectives: 前往破碎海滩。
text.description: 从破碎海滩的战斗中，我们得到了情报。这种疫病源头的准确位置是在西侧的一个岛上。$b$b我们有许多盟友都被感染了。必须马上行动，确保疫情不再扩散。
text.completion: You're here, High $C! Quickly, there's no time to lose!

english.title: To the Broken Shore
english.objectives: Head to the Broken Shore.
english.description: We've received word from those fighting on the Broken Shore. It seems the source of the contagion can be pinpointed to a specific island off the western coast.$B$BMany of our allies have already been infected. We must work quickly to ensure that the contagion doesn't spread.
english.completion: $ct! Hurry up, we don't have much time!

text.title: 防疫工作
text.objectives: 消灭腐蚀者欧祖克并摧毁他的邪能散播器，从而遏制疫病。
text.description:
我追查到了疫病的源头，就在这片海滩上。燃烧军团正在使用邪能散播器催生有传染性的魔藤，所有接触到的人都会得病。

消灭腐蚀者欧祖克和他的邪能散播器，这样就可以控制疫病的传播了。
text.completion: I believe our combined efforts have effectively eradicated the fel contagion from Azeroth.$B$BWell done, $n.

english.title: Countering the Contagion
english.objectives: Counter the contagion by killing Ozzuk the Corrupter and destroying his fel spreaders.
english.description:
I have tracked the source of the contagion to these very shores. The Burning Legion are using fel spreaders to pump out infectious fel creep, causing anyone who comes into contact with it to become sick.

Take out Ozzuk the Corrupter and his fel spreaders so that the contagion can be contained.
english.completion: I believe our combined efforts have effectively eradicated the fel contagion from Azeroth.$B$BWell done, $n.

text.title: 泰坦之触
text.objectives: 将$1oa个阿曼苏尔的精华带给奥法工匠维迪尔。
text.description: 天哪！你获得了一件传说物品来帮助你冒险。我很久以前就设想过一个理论，就是这种物品是直接从泰坦身上抽取力量，而这正是验证我的猜想的好机会！$b$b据说暗夜井直接从阿曼苏尔之眼抽取力量，而经过这么多世纪的密切接触，我相信泰坦的力量如今就流淌在暗夜要塞的居民体内。给我带一些这种能量的残片来，我可以用它们强化你的装备。
text.progress: Aman'Thul has likely been slain for countless aeons, yet his power lingers. How is this possible?
text.completion: Marvelous! It is such a joy to work with such magnificent craftsmanship. Please, come see me again should you find another such masterpiece.

english.title: Touch of a Titan
english.objectives: Bring $1oa Essences of Aman'Thul to Arcanomancer Vridiel.
english.description: Oh my! You've managed to acquire an item of legend to carry on your adventures. I've long theorized that such items draw their power directly from the titans, and this may prove to be a chance to test such speculation!$b$bIt is said that the Nightwell draws power from the Eye of Aman'Thul, and after centuries in close proximity I believe that titan's power now dwells within the inhabitants of the Nighthold. Bring me remnants of this energy, and I will empower your equipment.
english.progress: Aman'tul died many ages ago, but his power still remains in this world. How is this possible?
english.completion: Beautiful! It's a pleasure to work with such impeccable samples. If you get another such masterpiece, be sure to show it to me.

text.title: 泰坦之触
text.objectives: 将$1oa个阿曼苏尔的精华带给奥法工匠维迪尔。
text.description: 使用泰坦的力量或许是击退燃烧军团的唯一方法。给我再带些这样的力量来，我们击败古尔丹的胜算就会增加。
text.progress: Aman'Thul has likely been slain for countless aeons, yet his power lingers. How is this possible?
text.completion: I count myself fortunate to be able to work with the heroes who fight for our world's survival.

english.title: Touch of a Titan
english.objectives: Bring $1oa Essences of Aman'Thul to Arcanomancer Vridiel.
english.description: Harnessing the strength of the titans may be the only thing that lets us push back the Burning Legion. Bring me more of this power, and we will improve your odds of defeating Gul'dan.
english.progress: Aman'Thul has likely been slain for countless aeons, yet his power lingers. How is this possible?
english.completion: I count myself fortunate to be able to work with the heroes who fight for our world's survival.

text.title: 消磁
text.objectives: 完成试练，净化飞碟中冗余的能量。
text.description: 这些飞碟在辐射出能量！这肯定是它们互相靠近的缘故。我们必须把它们从这里拿走，以免它们继续共鸣，在这座神圣的殿堂里造成灾难性的后果。$b$b我要把它们送到我知道的一个地方，我们可以在那里控制它们的能量，防止任何形式的爆炸。我说的就是永恒之眼。$b$b我们可以在那里安心完成安东尼达斯未竟的工作。你准备好离开的话就跟我说一声。
text.completion: To say you've earned your archmage status would be an understatement. Your success today proves that you were born one.$B$BNow mount your new vessel and ride against the Legion with all the might of your knowledge.

english.title: Dispersion of the Discs
english.objectives: Complete the trial to purge the excess energy from within the disc fragments.
english.description: These discs are radiating with power! It must be their proximity to one another. We must take them from here should they resonate further and cause a catastrophe in these sacred halls.$b$bI'll send them to the one place I know where we can reign their energies in, preventing any sort of explosion. I'm speaking of the Eye of Eternity.$b$bThere we will be able to safely finish what Antonidas was unable to complete. Speak with me again when you're ready to leave.
english.completion: Ты не просто $gзаслужил:заслужила; титул верховного мага. Ты $gбыл рожден:была рождена; для того, чтобы стать им.$b$bА теперь обрушь на Легион всю мощь своих талантов и познаний, и пусть новообретенное транспортное средство поможет тебе в этом.

text.title: 堕夜精灵的命运
text.objectives: 与欧库勒斯谈一谈，然后前往暗夜要塞找塔莉萨。
text.description: 你从暗夜要塞凯旋归来后不久，塔莉萨就因要事而赶回了王宫。$b$b她要你去王宫见她。$b$b你准备好去见她了就告诉我一声。
text.progress: Спасибо, что $gоткликнулся:откликнулась; на призыв.
text.completion: Thank you for being here, $n.$B$BUltimately the Nightborne must shape their own destiny, regardless of the help we have received from Outlanders like yourself.$B$BIt is no easy burden we bear, but Elisande has shown us that we must stand alone, without the Nightwell, to properly rejoin the world.$B$BThank you for all you have done for us.

english.title: Fate of the Nightborne
english.objectives: Speak to Oculeth and meet Thalyssra in the Nighthold.
english.description: Shortly after your victorious return from the Nighthold, urgent business took Thalyssra back to the palace.$b$bShe has requested that you meet her there.$b$bSpeak to me when you are prepared to join her.
english.progress: Спасибо, что $gоткликнулся:откликнулась; на призыв.
english.completion: Хорошо, что ты здесь, $n.$b$bВ конечном счете ночнорожденные должны сами решить свою судьбу, не полагаясь на помощь чужаков – даже на твою.$b$bМы несем тяжкое бремя, но пример Элисанды показал, что нам нужно покончить с зависимостью от Ночного Колодца и снова стать частью окружающего мира.$b$bСпасибо тебе за все, что ты для нас $gсделал:сделала;.

text.title: 宝藏大师伊克里格德
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个邪翼吞噬者。
text.description: 登上舰船，然后消灭魔蝠。

english.title: Treasure Master Iks'reeged
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Felwing Devourers.
english.description: <TEMP> Board the ship then kill fel bats.

objectiveDetails.description: 将100枚虚空碎片带给伊克里格德

text.title: 夏多雷护符
text.objectives: 从暗夜要塞的艾利桑德身上收集4个时光回响（普通难度）。
text.description: 建造暗夜要塞时，我的人民铸造了一块护符，用它就可以进入这些大厅。有了护符的力量，我们就可以畅通无阻地穿过王宫，直接面对大魔导师了。利用暗夜井碎片的力量，我们就可以找到护符，结束这场愚蠢的战争……

english.title: Talisman of the Shal'dorei
english.objectives: Collect 4 Echoes of Time from Elisande in The Nighthold on Normal Difficulty.
english.description: When the Nighthold was built, my people forged a talisman that allowed access to these halls. With the talisman's power, one could traverse the palace unhindered, taking the fight directly to the magistrix. Using fragments of the Nightwell's power, we could locate the talisman and end this foolish war...

text.title: 夏多雷护符
text.objectives: 从暗夜要塞的艾利桑德身上收集4个时光回响（英雄难度）。
text.description: 建造暗夜要塞时，我的人民铸造了一块护符，用它就可以进入这些大厅。有了护符的力量，我们就可以畅通无阻地穿过王宫，直接面对大魔导师了。利用暗夜井碎片的力量，我们就可以找到护符，结束这场愚蠢的战争……
