With the talisman's power, one could traverse the palace unhindered, taking the fight directly to the magistrix. Using fragments of the Nightwell's power, we could locate the talisman and end this foolish war...

text.title: 做好准备！
text.objectives: 在破碎海滩的伊利达雷营地与赛丝诺女士谈一谈。
text.description:
燃烧军团的舰船暂时撤退了。但他们迟早会再次发动攻击，我们必须做好准备。

我们得立即进行维修！赛丝诺女士带队去搜寻零件了。为了能留在地面上，她什么都愿意做，哈！

她正在破碎海滩等你。
text.completion: About time, Sslayer $n. We have work to do.

english.title: We Must be Prepared!
english.objectives: Talk to Lady S'theno at the Illidari Camp on the Broken Shore.
english.description:
The Legion ships are gone, for now. It's only a matter of time before they attack again, and we must be prepared.

We need to get going on repairs immediately! Lady S'theno took the lead on the search for parts. That one will do anything to remain on solid ground, ha! 

She is waiting for you on the Broken Shore.
english.completion: Наконец-то, $gис-с-стребитель:ис-с-стребительница; $n. У нас очень много дел.

objectiveDetails.description: 破坏军团灵魂收割计划

text.title: 黑暗信物
text.objectives: 把维罗娜拉的备用兜帽带给死亡猎手莫戈斯。
text.description: 鲜花……是挺不错的。$B$B<维罗娜拉嗅了嗅其中一朵黑玫瑰。>$B$B我有一顶多余的兜帽。不是什么好东西，但莫戈斯或许愿意接受它。$B$B但请别让他抱什么希望。我不过是投桃报李而已。$B$B如果你能保守这个秘密，我会非常感激的。向仰慕者赠送礼物并不是黑暗游侠该做的事。
text.completion: Velonara asked you to deliver this to me personally?$B$B<Moorgoth's eyes sparkle as he grins from ear to ear.>$B$BShe DOES care! She DOES care!$B$B<Moorgoth settles down and clears his throat.>$B$BThat was kind of her. Say, it is a nice hood. I bet I could mass-produce this and offer it to my fellow dark ranger aficionados.$B$BWould you like to browse my wares?

english.title: Dark Memento
english.objectives: Bring Velonara's spare hood to Death Hunter Moorgoth.
english.description: The flowers were... a nice gesture.$b$b<Velonara sniffs one of the black roses.>$b$bI have a spare hood. Nothing fancy, but perhaps Moorgoth would like to have it.$b$bJust don't let him get his hopes up or anything. I'm merely repaying a kindness.$b$bI would appreciate it if you kept all this between us. Giving presents to admirers falls a bit outside the dark ranger rules of conduct.
english.completion: Velonara asked you to deliver this to me personally?$B$B<Moorgoth's eyes sparkle as he grins from ear to ear.>$B$BShe DOES care! She DOES care!$B$B<Moorgoth settles down and clears his throat.>$B$BThat was kind of her. Say, it is a nice hood. I bet I could mass-produce this and offer it to my fellow dark ranger aficionados.$B$BWould you like to browse my wares?

text.title: 驾驭力量
text.objectives: 消灭安德约·驯龙者，夺回霜牙的挽具。
text.description: 这些蠢货正在使用霜牙的挽具之力来控制冰霜巨龙。他们的首领安德约正坐在龙母背上嘲笑我们。$b$b他的生命到此为止了。
text.progress: This harness will bring us great power!
text.completion: During my training, Mograine told me of what we could achieve with this harness. I look forward to the results.

english.title: Harnessing Power
english.objectives: Kill Andjor Dragontamer and retrieve Rimefang's Harness.
english.description: These fools are using the power of Rimefang's harness to subjugate the frost wyrms. Their leader, Andjor, sits inside on the back of the broodmother and mocks us.$b$bHe should breathe no longer.
english.progress: Эта упряжь даст нам великую силу!
english.completion: Когда я училась, Могрейн рассказывал мне, чего может достичь владелец этой упряжи. Не терпится это увидеть.

text.title: 灭绝斯维德克
text.objectives: 消灭并复活$1oa个斯维德克维库人。
text.description: 据我所知，这里的秩序是这样的。凡人走进冰冠堡垒，被残酷地干掉，然后复活成天灾军团。$b$b这些蠢货居然妄想在这里肆无忌惮地行动，然后全身而退。既然他们行事如此无脑，就让他们真的变成无脑的行尸好了。
text.completion: Watching those vrykul shamble off mindlessly made my dead heart go "pitter patter".

english.title: Severing the Sveldrek
english.objectives: Kill and raise $1oa Sveldrek vrykul.
english.description: So here's the order of things, as far as I've been told. Mortal walks into Icecrown. Mortal is brutally defeated. Mortal gets raised as Scourge.$b$bThese fools can't expect to trounce in here, do whatever they want, and leave without any consequence. Time to make them truly as mindless as they act.
english.completion: Когда я вижу, как трупы этих врайкулов бесцельно бродят по цитадели, мое мертвое сердце почти что трепещет от радости.

text.title: 酒厂之乱
text.objectives: 帮阿麦找到酒仙布兰琪，并守卫风暴烈酒酿造厂。
text.description:
我们遭遇了偷袭。恐怕酒仙布兰琪已经被俘，甚至可能已经……

请帮帮我，大宗师！
text.completion: How could this have happened to us; to me? I never thought I would die so young... and so violently...$B$BWe have tried to Detox our fallen friends, but this poison is too advanced.$B$BI cannot rest while our order's very survival is still at stake. I am so sorry I let you down, Grandmaster $n.

english.title: Panic at the Brewery
english.objectives: Help Almai find Brewmaster Blanche and defend Stormstout Brewery.
english.description:
We were not prepared for a surprise attack. I fear Brewmaster Blanche has been captured, or worse...

Please help me, Grandmaster!
english.completion: Как это могло произойти с нами... со мной? Кто бы мог подумать, что я умру так рано... и так мучительно...$b$bМы пытались спасти отравившихся товарищей, но яд оказался слишком сильным.$b$bМоей душе не будет покоя, пока судьба нашего ордена под угрозой. Прости меня, великий мастер $n.

objectiveDetails.description: 与泰克泰克交谈，前往风暴烈酒酿造厂

text.title: Breaching the Sanctum
text.objectives: Speak with Oculeth to start the assault.
text.description: It is time. Valtrois is ready to destroy the barrier guarding the breach in the Sanctum. I will teleport you to the breach, then it falls on you to secure the area.$b$bTake these telemancy orbs. If you find you need support, use them to summon Withered.$b$bWe must strike before the enemy can ready new defenses. Let me know when you are ready and we will begin.

english.title: Breaching the Sanctum
english.objectives: Speak with Oculeth to start the assault.
english.description: It is time. Valtrois is ready to destroy the barrier guarding the breach in the Sanctum. I will teleport you to the breach, then it falls on you to secure the area.$b$bTake these telemancy orbs. If you find you need support, use them to summon Withered.$b$bWe must strike before the enemy can ready new defenses. Let me know when you are ready and we will begin.

text.title: 暴风之怒
text.objectives: 消灭盾憩岛上的燃烧军团部队。
text.description:
我们没时间做准备了，该行动了！

跟我来，小家伙。有你帮我瞄准，我们就能用雷霆与闪电净化这座小岛了！
text.completion: Today will not be your end, hero. The Legion threatens the Gates of Valor and without the power you wield they will surely fall.

english.title: The Storm's Fury
english.objectives: Destroy the Burning Legion forces within Shield's Rest.
english.description:
No longer do we have time to prepare, the moment of action is upon us!

Come with me, little one. With you guiding my aim we shall cleanse this isle by thunder and lightning!
english.completion: Когда-нибудь ты встретишь свою погибель, но не сегодня. Легион угрожает Вратам Доблести, и если ты не вмешаешься, то они падут.

text.title: 防护战士：伊利达雷的援手
text.objectives: 在达拉然街道上找到考瓦斯·血棘。
text.description:
还好，在揭穿燃烧军团潜入城市的阴谋这件事上，我们并不是在孤军奋战。$b$b伊利达雷的考瓦斯·血棘正独自在城市街道中巡逻，想找出最近几次袭击的幕后主使。$b$b我并不是很信任这些“恶魔猎手”，但是他们至少还是对得起这个名号的。我建议你去找她，看看她发现了些什么线索。绝对不能让燃烧军团再次发动攻击。

|cFF660000专精：防护战士|r
text.completion: You - I've seen you out on the isles.$B$BWe need to move quickly!

english.title: Protection: Aid of the Illidari
english.objectives: Find Kor'vas Bloodthorn in the streets of Dalaran.
english.description:
Thankfully, we are not quite alone in uncovering the Legion's plots to infiltrate the city.$B$BKor'vas Bloodthorn of the Illidari has taken to patrolling the city streets on her own to find the source behind the recent attacks.$B$BI do not entirely trust these 'demon hunters', but they have at least proved adept at their namesake. I suggest you find her and see what she has uncovered before the Legion strikes once more.

|cFF660000Specialization: Protection Warrior|r
english.completion: Я помню тебя, ты $gбыл:была; на островах.$B$BНужно действовать как можно быстрее!

text.title: 收集情报
text.objectives: 询问达拉然银行里的市民，查出被盗物品。
text.description: 燃烧军团派出了一个又一个恶魔，想要闯入城市中的肯瑞托金库，但我们不知道他们到底想要什么。$b$b看来这次他们终于成功了。$b$b我们得搞清楚他们偷走了什么，而且要快，不能让他们有机会使用偷走的东西。$b$b去调查一下生还者，看看有没有情报——我则会使用我的幽灵视觉，确保没有零散的恶魔潜伏在附近。
text.completion: No... no, no, no, no!$B$BNot good. Not good at all.

english.title: Gathering Information
english.objectives: Question citizens in the Bank of Dalaran to find out what was stolen.
english.description: The Legion has sent one demon after another to try to break into the Kirin Tor vaults in the city, but we don't know what they're after.$B$BLooks like they finally made it in.$B$BWe need to find out what was taken, and quickly, before they get a chance to put whatever it is to use.$B$BProbe any survivors for information - I'll use my spectral sight to make sure there aren't still any straggling demons lurking about.
english.completion: О нет!$B$BПлохи дела. Совсем плохи.

text.title: 证实猜测
text.objectives: 在达拉然找到先知维伦。
text.description: 那颗心脏是魔王库鲁尔仅存的部分——他曾经是燃烧军团最强大的督军之一。$b$b许多年前，库鲁尔的大军差点就降临黑暗之门，歼灭艾泽拉斯远征外域的部队。好在我们伊利达雷在他发动攻势前把他截住了。$b$b我担心燃烧军团是打算用那颗心脏来加快库鲁尔在虚空中的复活速度。我们必须立刻找到先知维伦——只有他才能确定这一点。
text.completion: Kruul must not be allowed entrance into this world.

english.title: Confirming Suspicions
english.objectives: Find Prophet Velen in Dalaran.
english.description: That heart is the last remaining piece of Highlord Kruul - once one of the Legion's best warlords.$B$BMany years ago Kruul's armies nearly descended upon the Dark Portal to crush the Azerothian assault on Outland. We Illidari intercepted before he could strike.$B$BI fear that the Legion aims to use the heart to hasten Kruul's resurrection in the nether. We must find the Prophet Velen at once - only he can tell us for sure.
english.completion: Нельзя позволить Круулу попасть в этот мир.

text.title: 异界穿梭
text.objectives: 在外域的命运阶梯建立一座通往扭曲虚空的传送门。
text.description: 库鲁尔擅长诅咒，但是他的力量还没有完全成形。他的爪牙拿到了他的心脏，可以加快他在虚空的重生速度。$b$b我们时间紧迫。$b$b快去荒芜的外域找到库鲁尔倒下的地方，也就是命运阶梯——那里与他的灵魂联系最为紧密。你得在那里打开通向他的世界的道路。$b$b我要为接下来的战斗做好准备。祝你好运，勇士。
text.completion: We must strike before Kruul reaches his full strength, but we're going to need help.

english.title: Between Worlds
english.objectives: Establish a portal to the Twisting Nether at the Stair of Destiny in Outland.
english.description: Kruul boasts damnation, but his power has not yet fully manifested. His minions have taken his heart to hasten his rebirth in the nether.$B$BWe do not have much time.$B$BGo to the place of Kruul's fall at the Stair of Destiny in desolate Outland, where the link to his soul is strongest. There you must pry open the way to his realm.$B$BI must prepare for the battle to come. Good luck, champion.
english.completion: Мы должны нанести удар, пока Круул не вернул себе силу, но для этого нам понадобится помощь.

objectiveDetails.description: 与命运阶梯的考瓦斯谈一谈
（可选）使用传送门前往地狱火半岛

text.title: 魔王归来
text.objectives: 在扭曲虚空中击败魔王库鲁尔。与军事顾问维多利亚对话即可前往。
text.description: 我有一封考瓦斯给你的信，她还告诉了我如何送你过去。$b$b我可以把你传送到他们身边开始战斗，但你需要一些虚空碎片才能打开进入扭曲虚空的道路。$b$b你拿到足够的虚空碎片后，请告诉我，然后你就能开始了。
text.completion: Kruul will never again threaten our world, or any other.$B$BProphet Velen sends his thanks, Archdruid.

english.title: The Highlord's Return
english.objectives: Defeat Highlord Kruul in the Twisting Nether. Speak with War Councilor Victoria to get there.
english.description: I have a missive for you from Kor'vas, as well as instructions for getting you there.$b$bI can teleport you to them to begin the fight, but you will need some Nethershards to force your way into the Twisting Nether.$b$bWhen you have enough, speak with me and you can begin.
english.completion: Kruul will never again threaten our world, or any other.$B$BProphet Velen sends his thanks, Archdruid.

text.title: 暗夜要塞：暗影议会首领
text.objectives: 击败暗夜要塞的古尔丹。
text.description:
就在我们说话的同时，古尔丹正在利用暗夜井的力量，想把萨格拉斯拉入我们的世界。

集结你的伙伴，杀出一条路，登上暗夜要塞之巅。

我会准备好圣光之心，然后在合适的时候加入战斗。

只要齐心协力，我们就可以彻底终结古尔丹。
text.completion: A fitting end.

english.title: The Nighthold: Lord of the Shadow Council
english.objectives: Defeat Gul'dan in The Nighthold.
english.description:
As we speak, Gul'dan is using the Nightwell's power to pull Sargeras into our world.

Gather your companions and fight your way to the top of The Nighthold.

I will prepare Light's Heart and join you when the time is right.

Together, we will put an end to Gul'dan once and for all.
english.completion: A fitting end.

text.title: 阿曼苏尔之眼
text.objectives: 帮助卡德加传送阿曼苏尔之眼。
text.description:
我们虽然赢得了这场战斗，但对抗燃烧军团的战争还远未结束。

为了阻止恶魔的浪潮席卷艾泽拉斯，我们必须使用创世之柱，封印萨格拉斯之墓。

<卡德加低头凝视着阿曼苏尔之眼。>

这恐怕……没那么容易。

我或许能用阿曼苏尔之眼本身的力量将它传送到达拉然。我想这是唯一的办法了！

english.title: The Eye of Aman'Thul
english.objectives: Aid Khadgar in transporting the Eye of Aman'Thul.
english.description:
The battle is won, but the war is far from over.

In order to stem the tide of demons flooding into Azeroth, we must use the Pillars of Creation to seal the Tomb of Sargeras.

<Khadgar peers down at the Eye of Aman'Thul.>

That... might be difficult to carry.

Perhaps I can use the power of the Eye itself to teleport it to Dalaran. I suppose there is only one way to find out!

text.title: 神王谕令
text.objectives: 在史诗难度下击败英灵殿的神王斯科瓦尔德。
text.description: 我们的斥候从风暴峡湾发来的报告很让人不安。$b$b神王斯科瓦尔德从古尔丹那里得到了新指令。然后，斯科瓦尔德的军队就加大了进攻的火力。$b$b我们一定要掌握古尔丹的详细指令，$n。$b$b可是，虽然获得了新命令，神王依然在纠缠泰坦守护者奥丁。去英灵殿，截住斯科瓦尔德，你或许能搞清楚他的军团主子到底要他去干什么。

english.title: Edict of the God-King
english.objectives: Defeat God-King Skovald in Halls of Valor on Mythic difficulty.
english.description: Our scouts send troubling reports from Stormheim.$b$bGod-King Skovald has received a new directive from Gul'dan. In response, Skovald's forces have stepped up their attacks.$b$bWe must know the details of Gul'dan's message, $n.$b$bDespite his new orders, the god-king remains obsessed with the titan keeper Odyn. Intercept Skovald in the Halls of Valor and you may determine what his Legion masters have demanded of him.

text.title: 哀嚎的小动物
text.objectives: 在哀嚎洞穴击败萌芽的永生孢子。
text.description: 很高兴你能来，$n。$b$b自从纳拉雷克斯苏醒，洞穴中就传出了轻微的哀嚎声。起初，我们怀疑是有什么变异的小动物活了下来。进一步调查后，我们发现它们生长繁殖的情况远超我们的想象。这可能与永生者沃尔丹的尸体有关，但我们无法确定。所以我们想派你进去看看。$b$b我最近还看到有可疑的脚印一直延伸到洞穴里。我们可能有伴儿了，小心点。
text.completion: Yes, I saw the shadowy character as well, he ran right past me. Probably a tauren, but we can't be sure. Keep a look out for him, something tells me we're just beginning to unravel this mystery.
text.completed: 返回北贫瘠之地的哀嚎洞穴向穆雅妮复命。

english.title: Wailing Critters
english.objectives: Defeat the Budding Everliving Spore in Wailing Caverns.
english.description: I'm glad you're here, $n.$B$BTiny wails have been heard in the caverns for some time since Naralex was awakened. At first, we suspected that some deviate critters had survived. Upon further investigation, we found them to be growing and multiplying beyond our wildest expectations. The corpse of Verdan the Everliving may have something to do with it, we're not sure. That's why we're sending you in.$B$BI've also seen suspicious footprints leading into the caverns recently. We may not be alone, be careful.
english.completion: Yes, I saw the shadowy character as well, he ran right past me. Probably a tauren, but we can't be sure. Keep a look out for him, something tells me we're just beginning to unravel this mystery.
english.completed: Return to Muyani at the Wailing Caverns in Northern Barrens.

objectiveDetails.description: 让穆雅妮送你进入哀嚎洞穴

text.title: 回到林地
text.objectives: 向梦境林地的伦萨·巨蹄复命。
text.description: 你的表现真是太棒了。既然我们已经干掉了指挥官，德鲁伊和半神应该暂时都安全了。复仇则是额外的惊喜。$b$b我们回去向伦萨复命吧，把我们的战绩告诉他。
text.completion: We have asked a lot of you over the last few months, $n. You not only rose to our expectations, but surpassed them. By killing Katith'rax, you have stopped the attacks against our ancients.$B$BYou deserve the position of Archdruid of the Dreamgrove. I am honored to be your colleague, and expect us to do much for the world. Together.

english.title: Grovebound
english.objectives: Return to Rensar Greathoof in the Dreamgrove.
english.description: Now THAT was some good stuff right there. Now that we've taken out the commander, the druids and the ancients should be safe for a while. Revenge was an added bonus.$b$bWe should get back to Rensar and tell him what we accomplished.
english.completion: We have asked a lot of you over the last few months, $n. You not only rose to our expectations, but surpassed them. By killing Katith'rax, you have stopped the attacks against our ancients.$B$BYou deserve the position of Archdruid of the Dreamgrove. I am honored to be your colleague, and expect us to do much for the world. Together.

text.title: 自然的先锋
text.objectives: 向梦境林地的伦萨·巨蹄复命。
text.description: $n，你必须返回梦境林地，把我遇袭的消息带回去。告诉其他德鲁伊，除非我们设法阻止燃烧军团，否则这种针对我们的进攻还会不断发生。$b$b感谢你的帮助。我感觉邪能正在离开我的身体，虽然痊愈可能还需要一点时间。
text.completion: What news do you have of the attack on Aviana's shrine?

english.title: Nature's Advance
english.objectives: Return to Rensar Greathoof in the Dreamgrove.
english.description: $n, you must return to the Dreamgrove and bring the news of my attack. Tell the other druids that aggressions such as this will continue against us unless we find a way to stop the Legion.$b$bI thank you for the aid. I feel the fel energies leaving my veins, though it may take some time.
english.completion: What news do you have of the attack on Aviana's shrine?

text.title: First Win of the Day (Random BG)

english.title: First Win of the Day (Random BG)

text.title: 事态紧急
text.objectives: 在守护者圣殿找到梅瑞尔的客人。
text.description: 大法师，$n！有贵客到访。你有空时，请到我的房间来一趟。
text.completion: I have been unfairly maligned by many. I am glad the Tirisgarde does not fall prey to petty rumors!

english.title: An Urgent Situation
english.objectives: Find Meryl's visitor in the Hall of the Guardian.
english.description: Archmage, $n! We have an important guest. Please meet me in my chamber when you have a moment.
english.completion: Мое имя не раз незаслуженно чернили. Как хорошо, что Стражи Тирисфаля не обращают внимания на клевету!

text.title: 酿酒问题
text.objectives: 指引风暴烈酒酿酒师把庆祝美酒分发到寺院的阳台，笑鹤酒馆的门前，以及习武场附近。
text.description:
你好，大宗师。我特别擅长酿造高难度的酒，我和阿麦一直在和风暴烈酒酿造厂合作，为教派酿造风暴蜜酒。

其实，我们已经开始投入生产了！

这件喜事值得聚会庆祝一下，你同意吧？我们带来了足量的优质庆祝美酒，人人有份！
text.completion: Whew. Celebration brew is..*hic* shtronger than I remembered it to be. *urp*

english.title: A Brewing Situation
english.objectives: Direct the Stormstout Brewers to distribute Celebration Brew to the temple balcony, in front of the Laughing Crane, and near the troop training grounds.
english.description:
Greetings, Grandmaster. I'm an expert at producing tricky brews, and Almai and I have been working with Stormstout Brewery to craft Storm Brew for the order. 

In fact, we have already begun production!

That calls for a party, don't you think? We brought enough of my prized Celebration Brew for everyone!
english.completion: Уф... Праздничный мед... *ик* ...уж больно заборист. *буэ*

objectiveDetails.description: 把美酒分发到笑鹤酒馆
把美酒分发到寺院阳台

text.title: 邪能之毒
text.objectives: 使用布兰琪的蒸馏器，然后把药酒分发给8个邪能中毒的弟子。
text.description:
我看看……加点疗伤用的伊瑟拉莱之种，然后是解毒的跌打草，还有提高疾病抵抗力的元素之土。哦，还要加一撮磨碎的邪能根茎来调和一下。

好了，我想这种药酒足以中和燃烧军团的毒素了。它的味道可能很糟糕，但是良药苦口嘛。

快，大宗师$n。我们病得最重的那些朋友已经没多少时间了。
text.progress: Did our Curative Brew work?
text.completion: It makes my heart glad to see our order returning to health.

english.title: Not Felling Well
english.objectives: Use Blanche's Still and then give the Curative Brew to 8 Fel-Poisoned Initiates.
english.description:
Let's see... Yseralline Seed for healing, Bruiseweed for curing poison, and Elemental Earth for disease resistance. Oh and just a touch of ground Felwort for attunement. 

Yes, I think this will counteract the Legion's poison. It will probably taste terrible, but what medicine doesn't?

Hurry, Grandmaster $n. Our most stricken friends don't have much time left.
english.progress: Did our Curative Brew work?
english.completion: Я очень рада тому, что наши монахи пошли на поправку.

text.title: 炼金师科瑞娅
text.objectives: 消灭炼金师科瑞娅。
text.description:
炼金师科瑞娅是邪能要塞里的狂热者首领。看来酒仙布兰琪见到的就是这个蔑魔维库人，她在我们的酒里下了毒。

请把她干掉。
text.completion: Thank you. That's one less demon working against us.

english.title: Alchemist Korlya
english.objectives: Kill Alchemist Korlya.
english.description:
The zealots within the Garrison of the Fel are led by Alchemist Korlya. It seems likely that's the Felskorn Brewmaster Blanche observed poisoning our brew.

Please kill her.
english.completion: Спасибо. Еще одним демоном, строящим нам козни, стало меньше.

text.title: 猛攻军团
text.objectives: 与泰克泰克对话，前往破碎海滩。
text.description:
我拼命抵抗了恶魔，但他们人多势众，即便以我的武艺也……

我重伤倒地时，偷听到恐惧魔王命令一个蔑魔炼金师去污染我的酒，然后再返回破碎海滩。

如果你能拿到一点那种毒药，我们就一定可以调配出解毒剂！
text.completion: Good, you made it!

english.title: Storming the Legion
english.objectives: Talk to Tak-tak to travel to the Broken Shore.
english.description:
I did my best to fight the demons off, but there were too many even for my skill...

As I lay dying, I overheard the dreadlord commanding a Felskorn alchemist to contaminate my brew and then return to the Broken Shore. 

If you could acquire some of the poison, I'm sure we can concoct an antidote!
english.completion: Ты здесь! Прекрасно.

objectiveDetails.description: 与齐普·菲兹邦克谈一谈

text.title: A Giant Problem
text.objectives: Destroy The Ship
text.description: Destroy The Ship

english.title: A Giant Problem
english.objectives: Destroy The Ship
english.description: Destroy The Ship

text.title: 奥术法师：蔑潮的命运
text.objectives: 搜索贾德维克，寻找卷轴中提到的维库人。
text.description:
风暴峡湾的一名斥候昨天送来了一个重大发现——这些古代卷轴。卷轴上记载了一个瓦尔基拉预言，说将有一位新的维库统治者率领蔑潮部族反抗燃烧军团。

但这个维库人可能是斯科瓦尔德的后裔，这样一来事情就麻烦了。

拿上卷轴，找到这个后裔，带她去见瓦尔基拉。我认为，卷轴中提到的流亡者就是贾德维克的维库人，所以从那里开始找比较好。

|cFF660000专精：奥术法师|r
text.completion: Yes, outsider? What business do you have here?

english.title: Arcane: Fate of the Tideskorn
english.objectives: Search Jandvik for the vrykul mentioned in the scrolls.
english.description:
A scout from Stormheim arrived yesterday with a significant discovery - these ancient scrolls. Within they contain a Valkyra prophecy of a new vrykul ruler - one who could turn the Tideskorn against the Legion.

It complicates matters that this vrykul may in fact be Skovald's heir.

Take the scrolls, find the heir, and bring her to the Valkyra. I think the outcasts they refer to are the vrykul of Jandvik, so that would be a good place to start.

|cFF660000Specialization: Arcane Mage|r
english.completion: Yes, outsider? What business do you have here?

text.title: 不情愿的女王
text.objectives: 把希格林带到斯考德-艾希尔的艾尔面前。
text.description:
等等，你怎么知道我的身世的？在这里说话得小心点，有些人知道了我的身世的话就一定会来追杀我。

我不知道你是谁，也不相信自己是什么预言之人。但是，如果你想要消弭我父亲对蔑潮部族造成的伤害，那么我有义务帮助你。

到瓦狄斯丹来见我，$c。我们可以从那里前往斯考德-艾希尔并请求觐艾尔。也许她能指点我们预言的含义。
text.completion: I thank you for bringing Sigryn to me, outsider. She truly is the future of our people.$B$BThough you have already done so much, I would ask another favor of you. Please accompany Sigryn in her challenges. She has grown to trust you, and will need guidance through the trials she must face.

english.title: The Reluctant Queen
english.objectives: Bring Sigryn before Eyir in Skold-Ashil.
english.description:
Wait, how is it you know about my parentage? Be careful what you say around here, there are those who would hunt me down if they knew my bloodline.

I don't know who you are, nor do I believe I'm part of any prophecy. However, if you seek to undo the damage my father has wrought on the Tideskorn, then I feel obliged to assist you.

Meet me in Valdisdall, $c. From there we can make our way to Skold-Ashil and request an audience with Eyir. Perhaps she can shed some light on this prophecy.
english.completion: Сигрин теперь с нами, и за это мне нужно благодарить тебя. Воистину, она – надежда нашего народа.$B$BТебе и так пришлось сделать для нас слишком многое, но я попрошу еще об одной услуге. Помоги Сигрин пройти испытания. Она тебе доверяет и, кроме того, ей понадобится $gнаставник:наставница;.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送希格林前往斯考德-艾希尔
与瓦狄斯丹的希格林谈一谈

text.title: 别惹睡狼
text.objectives: 从怒风兽穴救出戈德林。
text.description: 你看到那些魁梧的艾瑞达了吗？那里就是戈德林所在的兽穴！我不知道里面的燃烧军团想对他做什么，但我知道，我们绝不能让他们得逞。$b$b我们杀进去救出戈德林吧！
text.completion: We did it! We saved Goldrinn!

english.title: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
english.objectives: Save Goldrinn from the Stormrage Barrow Dens.
english.description: You see those big eredar guys? That's the barrow that Goldrinn is in! I don't know what the Legion is doing to him in there, but I'm sure we don't want them to succeed.$b$bLet's get in there and save Goldrinn!
english.completion: We did it! We saved Goldrinn!

text.title: 让骨语闭嘴
text.objectives: 在霍斯瓦尔德击败符文先知法尔加。
text.description:
希格林要想继承王位，就得面对两个对手的挑战——骨语部族的符文先知法尔加和德克加尔部族的维尔布兰德族长。

如果是我的话，就先去霍斯瓦尔德挑战符文先知。他是斯科瓦尔德的亲密盟友，也是个强大的秘术师。如果不能先将他制伏，那么有着骨语部族支持的他就会成为强有力的竞争者。

去吧，以瓦尔基拉的名义，迎接你的命运！
text.completion: The Bonespeakers yield. Our clan will not interfere with Sigryn's claim to the throne.$B$BBe careful of this one, $C. I can see the darkness that consumed Skovald dwelling in this girl's heart. How she has resisted it this far, I do not know.$B$BYou had best hope she can control it.

english.title: To Silence the Bonespeakers
english.objectives: Defeat Runeseer Faljar in Haustvald.
english.description:
Sigryn's claim to the throne will be challenged by two rivals - Runeseer Faljar of the Bonespeakers and Jarl Velbrand of the Drekirjar.

I would begin in Haustvald with the Runeseer. He was a close ally of Skovald and is a powerful mystic. With the Bonespeakers at his charge, he would prove a staunch opponent if he cannot be made to yield.

Go now, and claim your destiny in the name of the Valkyra!
english.completion: Those talking to the bones give up. Our clan will not prevent Sigrin from ascending the throne. But be careful with her, |3-6($c). In this girl's heart, I see the same darkness that swallowed up Scovald. I don't know how she manages to contain it. Hopefully she can keep it under control.

text.title: 驯服德克加尔
text.objectives: 在赫达沙尔击败维尔布兰德族长。
text.description:
骨语者的话让我有点困扰，外来者。他所说的黑暗，也就是斯科瓦尔德的邪能诅咒，也以某种方式传到我身上了吗？

不，这不可能。符文先知一定是弄错了……

来吧，下一场挑战在等待着我。毫无疑问，我同样需要你的帮助才能让他屈服。
text.completion: You have the backing of the Dragon-Riders, but a greater rival to the throne still lives in secret.$B$BThe God-King's son yet lives. My riders spotted him among the outcasts of Vrekt. He would be the true heir to Skovald's throne. $B$BThe vrykul would never follow you were he to contend your claim!

english.title: To Tame the Drekirjar
english.objectives: Defeat Jarl Velbrand in Hrydshal.
english.description:
The Bonespeaker's words trouble me, outsider. The darkness he speaks of, Skovald's fel curse, could he have passed it onto me somehow?

No, it cannot be so. The Runeseer must be mistaken...

Come, the next challenger awaits. I will no doubt need your assistance bringing him to heel as well.
english.completion: Сигрин заручилась поддержкой наездников на драконах, но есть еще один серьезный претендент на трон, который скрывается от людских глаз.$B$BСын Короля-бога все еще жив. Мои наездники засекли его среди отшельников Вректа. Он – подлинный наследник трона Сковальда. $B$BВрайкулы ни за что не последуют за Сигрин, если он оспорит ее притязания!

text.title: 被遗忘的继承人
text.objectives: 前往维克特寻找托瓦德。
text.description:
我弟弟……还活着？

我最后看到他的时候，他已经被刺客团团包围。我无法想像，他究竟是怎么击败他们的……

我们得去维克特。我要亲眼看看我弟弟。
text.completion: I cannot believe that I find my brother alive, only to see him fall by my own blade. $B$BHow can fate be so cruel?

english.title: The Forgotten Heir
english.objectives: Find Torvald in Vrekt.
english.description:
My brother... lives?

The last time I saw him, the assassins were closing in on him. I can't imagine how he defeated them...

We should travel to Vrekt. I would look upon my brother with my own eyes.
english.completion: Поверить не могу: найти своего брата лишь для того, чтобы его убить. $B$BБудь проклята моя судьба!

text.title: 未解的谜团
text.objectives: 前往斯考德-艾希尔的艾尔宝库与希格林会合。
text.description:
无论如何，木已成舟。现在，没有人再和我争夺蔑潮部族的王位了。

但我弟弟的话依旧困扰着我。如果艾尔知道是谁下令杀害了我们一家，那我就有权知道真相。

来吧，我们回去。
text.completion: Sigryn has taken the path of Skovald before her. Only, I fear she is more powerful than her father ever was. $B$BI fear that Sigryn's thirst for revenge may lead to her undoing. Though truly powerful, she would be no match for Odyn.$B$BShe must be stopped before it is too late.

english.title: Unanswered Questions
english.objectives: Join Sigryn at the Vault of Eyir in Skold-Ashil.
english.description:
What is done, is done. There are none left to challenge the throne of the Tideskorn. 

My brother's words still haunt me, though. If Eyir knows who ordered my family killed, I deserve to know it.

Come, let us return.
english.completion:
Сигрин пошла по стопам Сковальда. Вот только, боюсь, она сильнее, чем когда-либо был ее отец. 

Жажда мести может привести ее к гибели. Хотя мощь Сигрин и велика, ей не под стать тягаться с Одином.

Ее нужно остановить, пока еще не поздно.

text.title: 神后之怒
text.objectives: 与军事顾问维多利亚谈一谈，传送到希格林身边并将其击败。
text.description:
$ct，肯瑞托有办法把你传送到英灵殿，追上神王的后裔。大法师卡德加还要我对你再三强调，阻止希格林是非常重要的事，因为根据预言所示，她可能仍是联合蔑潮部族对抗军团的关键。

要把你直接传送进英灵殿的话，需要花费难以置信的巨大能量，所以去之前请确保你已经有了万全的准备。否则我们可能就要等上一段时间才能再次传送了。

你准备好了的话就告诉我。
text.completion: I... thank you for coming for me. I hope you can forgive me for what I've done.$B$B$BI will return to Eyir. I only hope she can grant me her forgiveness as well...

english.title: The God-Queen's Fury
english.objectives: Speak with War Councilor Victoria to be teleported to Sigryn's location and defeat her.
english.description:
$ct, the Kirin Tor have found a way to get you into the Halls of Valor to pursue the God-King's heir. Archmage Khadgar has asked me to stress upon you the importance of stopping Sigryn, as the prophecies hint that she may still be the key to uniting the Tideskorn against the Legion.

It will require an incredible amount of energy to teleport you directly to the Halls, so be sure that you are prepared. It may be some time before we can send you again.

Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.
english.completion: I... thank you for coming for me. I hope you can forgive me for what I've done.$B$B$BI will return to Eyir. I only hope she can grant me her forgiveness as well...

text.title: 艾尔的宽恕
text.objectives: 前往斯考德-艾希尔的艾尔的宝库，见证艾尔对希格林的审判。
text.description:
对于我给你带来的麻烦，我深表歉意。我在这里犯下了大错，恐怕你所有的努力最终都是徒劳。

和我一起回斯考德-艾希尔吧。我会在那里接受艾尔对我的审判。
text.completion: To think, when you met me I had all intentions of living out my days as a farmer. Little did I know that the gods had other plans for me.$B$BThank you, outsider, for showing me my true purpose. I only hope I can live up to Eyir's visions and truly unite the Tideskorn once more.$B$BIf that day comes, the Legion will regret ever setting foot in Stormheim.

english.title: Eyir's Forgiveness
english.objectives: Witness Eyir's judgment of Sigryn in the Vault of Eyir in Skold-Ashil.
english.description:
I'm sorry for everything I've put you through, outsider. After my actions here, I fear all of this may have been in vain.

Come with me back to Skold-Ashil. There I will accept whatever judgment Eyir  deems fit of me.
english.completion: To think, when you met me I had all intentions of living out my days as a farmer. Little did I know that the gods had other plans for me.$B$BThank you, outsider, for showing me my true purpose. I only hope I can live up to Eyir's visions and truly unite the Tideskorn once more.$B$BIf that day comes, the Legion will regret ever setting foot in Stormheim.

text.title: 被污染的兽穴
text.objectives: 在怒风兽穴关闭$1oa个军团传送门。
text.description: 你花的时间太久，于是我便自作主张，提前侦察了兽穴。燃烧军团已经设置了传送门，每分每秒都有越来越多的恶魔从里面出现。我们得关闭这些传送门，这样才能救出戈德林！$b$b我不知道我的常规方法能不能对付得了他们，但我觉得你一定能行！我觉得你的藤艺手艺应该能派得上用场。
text.completion: Now the demons can't call reinforcements. That was great!

english.title: The Befouled Barrows
english.objectives: Close $1oa Legion Portals in the Stormrage Barrow Dens.
english.description: You were taking too long, so I took the liberty to scout out the barrows in advance. The Legion has set up portals, pulling more and more demons through them by the second. We need to shut them down so we can save Goldrinn!$b$bI'm not sure my usual methods are going to do much to take them down, but I think you can do it! I think some nice vine-work is in order.
english.completion: Now the demons can't call reinforcements. That was great!

text.title: 主母的命令
text.objectives: 消灭主母米兰达。
text.description: 那个又大又丑的家伙似乎是这里的指挥官。我们把她干掉吧！
text.completion: What did she say about a distraction?! This isn't sounding good...

english.title: Mother's Orders
english.objectives: Kill Mother Mirenda.
english.description: That big ugly thing looks like it's leading the attack here. Let's take her down!
english.completion: What did she say about a distraction?! This isn't sounding good...

text.title: 共同的敌人
text.objectives: 向紫罗兰城堡的卡德加复命。
text.description:
我还有一件事请你帮忙，外来者。

向你的领袖们回报这里发生的一切。虽然你的人民也许永远不会成为蔑潮部族的真正盟友，但是我们有共同的敌人——为了对抗他们，我们的人民会坚持战斗，直到最后一个人都倒下为止。

当时机到来的时候，我希望能在战场上看到你的身影。
text.completion: Remarkable! So there really was something to that prophecy after all!$B$BI am glad that Sigryn will lead the vrykul instead of the brutes who challenged her. Let us just hope she can unite the Tideskorn under her banner before the Legion has this place overrun.$B$BWell done, $n!

english.title: A Common Enemy
english.objectives: Return to Khadgar in the Violet Citadel.
english.description:
I have one more request to ask of you, outsider.

Return to your leaders and report to them what transpired here.  Though your people may never truly be allies with the Tideskorn, know that we have a common enemy - one which my people will fight to the last vrykul. 

When the time comes, I hope to see you on the battlefield.
english.completion: Remarkable! So there really was something to that prophecy after all!$B$BI am glad that Sigryn will lead the vrykul instead of the brutes who challenged her. Let us just hope she can unite the Tideskorn under her banner before the Legion has this place overrun.$B$BWell done, $n!

text.title: 宠物对战挑战：哀嚎洞穴
text.objectives: 在哀嚎洞穴击败萌芽的永生孢子。
text.description: 哀嚎洞穴里的变异小动物依然在这片潮湿阴暗的地方繁衍，但是我一直在努力压制它们的数量。$b$b我在清理洞穴的时候找到了几只宠物和一些补给。如果你能打破我的纪录，我也许会送你一袋补给。$b$b你必须在不治疗而且不复活任何一只宠物的情况下通关洞穴才能击败我。祝你好运！
text.completion: Wow, that's impressive! Here's the sack of supplies, you earned it! Sorry about the dampness.
text.completed: 返回北贫瘠之地的哀嚎洞穴向穆雅妮复命。

english.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Wailing Caverns
english.objectives: Defeat the Budding Everliving Spore in Wailing Caverns.
english.description: The deviate critters of the Wailing Caverns continue to flourish in the damp darkness, but I've been doing my best to keep their numbers down.$B$BI've found a few pets and supplies while clearing out the caverns, I might be willing to part with a sack of supplies if you can beat my best run.$B$BYou'll have to clear out the cavern without healing or reviving any of your pets to best me. Good luck!
english.completion: Wow, that's impressive! Here's the sack of supplies, you earned it! Sorry about the dampness.
english.completed: Return to Muyani at the Wailing Caverns in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 洞穴的呼唤
text.objectives: 在哀嚎洞穴上方的头骨状岩石处找到穆雅妮。
text.description:
哦，真好，我很高兴你能过来。我们听到了一些让人不安的传闻，据说哀嚎洞穴中有腐蚀滋生。你看起来正是调查这件事的最佳人选。

自从纳拉雷克斯苏醒来后，他的一个学生就一直在监视这这片区域，确保这些变异生物的情况保持在可控范围内。就是她向我们发来了紧急警告。

到哀嚎洞穴上方那颗头骨状的岩石处与她会面，看看你能不能帮她处理这件事。
text.completion: Thank you for coming, I have some interesting news about what's been going on in the Wailing Caverns since Naralex has awakened.

english.title: A Call from the Caverns
english.objectives: Find Muyani in the skull-shaped rock above Wailing Caverns.
english.description:
Oh, good, I'm glad you stopped by. We've heard disturbing rumors of corruption continuing to flourish in the Wailing Caverns. You seem like just the right person to investigate.

Since Naralex's awakening, one of his disciples has been watching over the area to ensure that deviate creatures remain in check. She is the one that has been sending us these dire warnings.

Meet up with her in the eye of the skull-shaped rock above Wailing Caverns and see if you can help her handle this situation.
english.completion: Thank you for coming, I have some interesting news about what's been going on in the Wailing Caverns since Naralex has awakened.

objectiveDetails.description: Speak with Tehd for a disguise

text.title: 扔酒桶
text.objectives: 使用风暴蜜酒摧毁5个邪能酒播撒器。
text.description:
燃烧军团正在用邪能发射器防御蔑魔部族的巢穴。幸好我们还有剩余的风暴蜜酒，这点酒应该足够我们摧毁这些玩意了。

拿上酒桶，朝散播器扔过去，然后你就等着看烟花吧！
text.completion: Blowing up demons never gets old, does it? Ha!

english.title: Barrel Toss
english.objectives: Use Storm Brew to destroy 5 Fel Brew Spreaders.
english.description:
The Legion is defending the Felskorn lair with fel emitters. Fortunately we have Storm Brew to spare, so there should be plenty available with which to destroy them. 

Take this barrel, throw it at the spreaders, and watch them go BOOM!
english.completion: Подрывать демонов всегда весело, не правда ли? Ха-ха!

text.title: 灾难性的影响
text.objectives: 调查苏拉玛。
text.description:
不毁灭整个世界，燃烧军团是不会罢休的。他们的到来对我们的土地产生了灾难性的冲击。如今，连我们的野生动物也受到了影响。

我收到了无数报告，里面都提到被恶魔占领的苏拉玛城周围的林地里有许多生病的动物。

请去那里看看传言是否属实吧。
text.completion: <Nighthuntress Syrenne's pet is too weak to react to your presence.>

english.title: Devastating Effects
english.objectives: Investigate Suramar.
english.description:
The Burning Legion will not rest until they have destroyed everything and everyone. Their presence here has had a devastating effect on our lands, and now it seems our wildlife as well. 

I have heard numerous reports of sickly animals in the thicket that surrounds the demon-infested city of Suramar. 

Make your way there and see if the rumors are true.
english.completion: <Sirenna's night hunter's pet is too weak to respond to you. >

text.title: 缓解伤势
text.objectives: 从深红林地的魔网中采集法力根茎，缓解德宾的伤势。
text.description:
<德宾的伤势很重，难以动弹。>

或许你可以去附近采集一些草药来缓解这头魔刃豹的伤势？
text.completion: <D'Bynn gently nuzzles your hand.>

english.title: Soothing Wounds
english.objectives: Use Manaroot that is foraged from leylines within the Crimson Thicket to soothe D'Bynn's wounds.
english.description:
<D'Bynn's injuries prevent him from moving.>

Perhaps you can forage something nearby that will soothe the manasaber's wounds?
english.completion: < D'Binne's gratefully poking you in the hand. >

text.title: 暗夜女猎手的召唤
text.objectives: 骑上德宾，让它带你找到暗夜女猎手塞琳。
text.description: <德宾听到它主人的声音，立刻警觉起来。它用鼻子紧张地蹭着你的手，要你骑到他背上。>
text.completion: I suppose I have you to thank for saving my beloved companion.

english.title: The Nighthuntress Beckons
english.objectives: Ride D'Bynn and let him lead you to Nighthuntress Syrene's location.
english.description: <D'Bynn becomes alert at the sound of his master's voice. Using his muzzle, he nudges your hand with a sense of urgency, inviting you to hop on his back.>
english.completion: Похоже, мне стоит поблагодарить тебя за спасение моего любимого питомца.

text.title: 夺回控制权
text.objectives: 消灭拷问者瑞林，使用他的控制宝珠释放暗夜女猎手塞琳。
text.description:
一个名叫瑞林的卑鄙小人把我关在这个笼子里，任由我自生自灭。

他正率领着一队夜之子，用邪能魔法腐化和控制这里的野生动物。

燃烧军团的手伸得太长了，我一点也不喜欢。

去干掉他，把他的控制宝珠拿回来，这样我才能离开这个魔法牢笼！
text.completion: I have encountered many outsiders in my time patrolling the city, but never one quite as resourceful as you.

english.title: Taking Control
english.objectives: Kill Torturer Relyn and use his Control Orb to free Nighthuntress Syrene.
english.description:
I've been withering away in this cage, prisoner to a wretch called Reyln.

He leads a group of nightborne that are using fel magic to corrupt and control the native wildlife.

The Burning Legion's reach has already spread too far for my liking.

Kill him and recover his control orb, so I can be released from this arcane prison!
english.completion: Раньше мне доводилось встречать множество чужаков, но таких ловких, как ты – никогда.

text.title: 邪缚野兽
text.objectives: 消灭夜之子诱捕者，解救各种邪缚野兽。
text.description:
这么说，瑞林听命于莱瑟拉？我真是一点也不意外。她与那些在我们城中肆虐的恶魔似乎相处得非常融洽。

我们不能让她顺利腐化苏拉玛的野生动物。我曾发誓保护苏拉玛城不受任何敌人的侵害，哪怕这些敌人就是我们的同胞。

你去解决掉她的诱捕者，我会尽力找出暗夜女猎手莱瑟拉的下落。
text.completion: You continue to surprise me, outsider.

english.title: Felbound Beasts
english.objectives: Kill Nightborne Trappers and free Felbound beasts.
english.description:
So Reyln is taking orders from Lexera? Why am I not surprised. She seemed far too comfortable with the demons who infested our city.

We cannot let her succeed in corrupting Suramar's wildlife. I swore to protect the city of Suramar from all enemies, even those within its walls.

If you can deal with her trappers, I will do my best to track Nighthuntress Lexera down.
english.completion: Я не перестаю тебе удивляться. Спасибо за помощь!

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭夜之子和邪脉诱捕者

text.title: 准备出击
text.objectives: 前往破碎海滩寻找暗夜女猎手塞琳。
text.description:
我跟踪了其中一个诱捕者，他一无所觉地把我带到了破碎海滩。

莱瑟拉就在那里，身边有一大群恶魔和忠心耿耿的夜之子保护。

我没法靠近，但是我看得出，她和她的诱捕者军团正在驯养被邪能腐化的野兽。

这是被自然唾弃的暴行，我们一定要阻止她！

到破碎海滩来找我并做好战斗的准备。我会再收集一些法力根茎。我预感它们会派上用场的。
text.completion: Let's make this quick. It won't be long before more demons come rushing through this pass.

english.title: Ready to Strike
english.objectives: Meet Nighthuntress Syrenne on the Broken Shore.
english.description:
I followed one of the trappers, who unknowingly led me to the Broken Shore. 

Lexera was there, surrounded by an army of demons and loyal nightborne.

I wasn't able to get close, but from what I could tell, she and her army of trappers are taming the fel-corrupted beasts.

It is an abomination of nature, and she must be stopped!

Meet me on the Broken Shore and be ready to strike. I will gather additional manaroot. I have a feeling we'll need it.
english.completion: Покончим с этим поскорее. Скоро долину заполонят орды демонов.

text.title: 违逆自然的下场
text.objectives: 消灭暗夜女猎手莱瑟拉。
text.description:
莱瑟拉和她的诱捕者已经占据了谷地。

她看似柔弱，其实很强大，$n，她的战斗力足以媲美恐惧魔王。你最好不要贸然出手。

我来对付这些恶魔。去吧，找到莱瑟拉，让她尝尝违逆自然的后果。
text.completion: There is no joy when a Nighthuntress falls, but it had to be done. The truth is, she died the moment she aligned herself with the Burning Legion.

english.title: Unnatural Consequences
english.objectives: Kill Nighthuntress Lexera.
english.description:
Lexera and her trappers have taken over the valley.

She is stronger than she looks, $n, and she fights with the strength of a dreadlord. Do not go in unprepared. 

I can handle these demons. Go, find Lexera, and make her feel the consequences of her unnatural endeavors.
english.completion: Мне больно видеть, как умирает одна из нас, но ее смерть была неизбежна. Если уж на то пошло, она погибла, когда приняла сторону Пылающего Легиона.

text.title: 毁灭术士：邪能图腾的骚动
text.objectives: 前往至高岭的迷雾海岸，找到纳瓦罗格。
text.description:
高岭部族从他们的卓格巴尔盟友处收到一份紧急警报。邪能图腾正在将他们的恶魔腐蚀传播给附近的野生动物，还感染了大地本身。我们觉得必须马上调查这件事。$b$b卓格巴尔的首领纳瓦罗格会亲自出马，我们希望你能跟他在邪能图腾的村子附近汇合。

|cFF660000专精：毁灭术士|r
text.completion: Thank you for coming. I am glad you are treating this threat seriously.

english.title: Destruction: Rumblings Near Feltotem
english.objectives: Find Navarrogg at the Misty Coast in Highmountain.
english.description:
The Highmountain have passed along a dire warning from their drogbar allies. The Feltotem are spreading their demonic corruption into the wildlife around them, infecting the land itself. We believe this is something that should be looked into sooner rather than later.$b$bThe drogbar chieftain, Navarrogg, is handling this personally and we'd like you to meet him near the Feltotem village.

|cFF660000Specialization: Destruction Warlock|r
english.completion: Thank you for coming. I am glad you are treating this threat seriously.

text.title: 来找我
text.objectives: 前往至高岭寻找北郡骑士麦斯米兰。
text.description: 麦斯米兰的信纸好像是从船帆上撕下来的布。里面还提到了至高岭北部的海滩。
text.completion: Are you ready to begin?

english.title: Seek Me Out
english.objectives: Look for Maximillian of Northshire in Highmountain.
english.description: The letter from Maximillian is written on something which looks to be torn off a ship's sail. Included are directions to the beach in northern Highmountain.
english.completion: Are you ready to begin?

text.title: 跪下，侍从！
text.objectives: 在麦斯米兰面前跪下。
text.description: 既然我们又要一起旅行，你就得向我下跪。跪下，侍从就得有个侍从的样子！
text.completion: Very good, now we can begin!

english.title: Kneel and Be Squired!
english.objectives: Kneel before Maximillian.
english.description: You must kneel before me if we are to begin our journey together once more. Kneel, squire, and be squired!
english.completion: Very good, now we can begin!

text.title: 朦胧的硬币
text.objectives: 把朦胧的时空扭曲硬币交给永恒岛的织雾者夏儿。
text.description: 一团迷雾包裹着这枚硬币，它从你的手中漂浮了起来。有时，迷雾会暂时散开，露出一枚闪闪发亮的新硬币，但下一刻，它又会变成饱经风霜的沧桑模样。随着硬币落回你手中，你脑海中浮现出一些幻象，那是丛林和云雾缭绕的山峰。穿过重重幻象，你认出了四位至尊天神齐聚于一座小岛上的庭院内。
text.completion: Coins are interesting items. They travel far and wide across the lands, yet this one seems to also travel through time.$B$BThe fact that you found this coin where you did is both an omen and a blessing.

english.title: The Shrouded Coin
english.objectives: Bring the Shrouded Timewarped Coin to Mistweaver Xia on the Timeless Isle.
english.description: A swirling mist envelops the coin and it begins to float above your hand. The mist briefly parts to reveal a shiny new coin, yet in the next instant the coin appears worn from years of exchange. As the coin settles back in to your hand, visions of jungles and mist shrouded peaks waft into your mind, and through the vision you recognize the four Celestials gathered in the courtyard of an island.
english.completion: Coins are interesting items. They travel far and wide across the lands, yet this one seems to also travel through time.$B$BThe fact that you found this coin where you did is both an omen and a blessing.

text.title: 燃烧的鸟
text.objectives: 收集灌邪图腾。
text.description: 邪能图腾在用这些隼龙做实验！他们没有获得想要的结果，就把这些实验品随意抛弃了，任由它们继续毒害其他动物。$b$b我们得收集他们留下的图腾，阻止腐蚀扩散，并查出他们当时在做什么。
text.progress: These animals are unable to be infused with fel magic, but I doubt the Feltotem stopped here.
text.completion: There were quite a few guards as I scouted around. I noticed more strange things on the other side.$B$BLet me see those totems.

english.title: The Burning Birds
english.objectives: Collect Fel Infusing totems.
english.description: The Feltotem are experimenting on these falcosaurs! They didn't get the results that they wanted and have carelessly left their experiments lying around to further poison the animals.$b$bWe should collect their leftover totems to prevent further corruption and to find out what they were doing.
english.progress: Этих животных невозможно заразить магией Скверны, но я сомневаюсь, что племя Тотема Скверны смирилось с неудачей.
english.completion: There are guards all around the village. Besides, I noticed some more strange things there.

objectiveDetails.description: 在邪能图腾附近与纳瓦罗格会面

text.title: 进阶训练
text.objectives: 完成麦斯米兰的任务并消灭“恶魔”，从而成为一等侍从。
text.description:
我可是经历千难万险才来到这里的，侍从。这里充满了危险，有风暴、恶魔、风暴恶魔……我光是回想一下就不寒而栗了。当然，我征服了所有这些危险，但是我本人付出了高昂的代价。所以我需要你的帮助。

你必须冒险前进——不，狂奔前进，找回我的护甲，我的武器，当然，还有我的骏马。只要你成功完成这三项任务，你就可以晋升为一等侍从！

english.title: Further Training
english.objectives: Complete Maximillian's quests and slay "demons" to earn the rank of Squire, First Class.
english.description:
The journey here was perilous, squire. It was fraught with danger. Storms, demons, storm demons... I shudder at the memory. Of course, I overcame all such dangers at great loss to my person. This is where I need your assistance.

You must venture forth--nay, sally forth, and recover my armor, my weapon, and of course my grand steed. Once you have successfully completed these tasks three, will you be promoted to Squire, First Class!

text.title: 骑士的财产
text.objectives: 找回麦斯米兰的护甲。
text.description:
当时，在呼啸的狂风和滔天的巨浪中，我的巨舰颠簸摇摆着。弱小的骑士定然会在恐惧中瑟瑟发抖，无法动弹。可我不会！不仅如此，英勇的我还脱下了护甲，小心地放进了我的麻袋。

你要问既然如此，我为何会只剩下这身朴素的内衣？只有像你这样无知的侍从才会问出这样的问题。我只是担心，如果我的船被掀翻，那我就会沉到海底！哈哈！

不幸的是，那几袋护甲被巨浪掀到了船外。
text.progress: Fetch Maximillians armor.
text.completion: Excellent, you found my armor.

english.title: A Knight's Belongings
english.objectives: Fetch Maximillian's armor.
english.description:
Amidst the squalls and the crashing waves, my mighty ship swayed and tumbled. Lesser knights would have trembled in terror, frozen stiff. Not me! Nay! Heroically, I stripped my armor off my back and stored it safely in my sack. 

Why did I strip down to these simple undergarments, you ask? Only an ignorant squire would. I was wary of sinking to the bottom should my ship fall foul of course! Ha ha! 

Unfortunately, the sacks of armor were thrown overboard by the waves.
english.progress: Fetch Maximillians armor.
english.completion: Excellent, you found my armor.

text.title: 用我的王国换一匹马
text.objectives: 找回多香果。
text.description: 噢，真是祸不单行啊！我登陆后，就骑着我可靠的骏马多香果，前往北方探索一个恶魔盘踞的村子。我在进行调查时，把多香果栓在了一旁，自己步行前进。可等我返回原地时，却发现一只强大的恶魔把她抓住了！看，他就在那里，像骑自己的马一样骑着她。请找到她，让她回到我身边。
text.completion: Pimento! You found him!

english.title: My Kingdom for a Horse
english.objectives: Return Pimento.
english.description: Oh, woe is me! Soon after making landfall I began exploring, riding my trusty steed Pimento into the heart of a demon infested village to the north. While performing my investigations, I tied Pimento up to go further on foot, only to return and discover a powerful demon had captured her! There he was, riding her like she was his own. Please find her and send her back to me.
english.completion: Pimento! You found him!

text.title: 他们偷走了神剑！
text.objectives: 找到神剑并将它还给麦斯米兰。
text.description: 我在附近的恶魔村庄侦察时，遭到了袭击。他们拿走了我的神器！当然，如果我就此离开，这片海岸就无人守卫了。它就在附近的恶魔手里，去吧，杀光他们，把我的神器找回来！
text.progress: Find Maximillians "Artifact" weapon, Excaliberto
text.completion: Yes!

english.title: They Stole Excaliberto!
english.objectives: Find Excaliberto and return it to Maximillian.
english.description: I was scouting the nearby demon village when I was attacked. They took my artifact! Of course, if I leave here, the shore will be undefended. The nearby demons have it. Go, slay them and bring it back to me!
english.progress: Find Maximillians "Artifact" weapon, Excaliberto
english.completion: Yes!

objectiveDetails.description: 找到麦斯米兰的“神器”武器

text.title: 安全保管
text.objectives: 把聚焦之虹还给达拉然的大法师卡雷。
text.description:
还有聚焦之虹的事情。请把它还给你在肯瑞托的朋友，同时请转达我的歉意。

而我嘛，我暂时不会再去追寻神器了。对我来说，被不朽的暗影恶魔附身这种事情，一次就足够了。谢谢你。
text.completion: At last, the Focusing Iris is returned! I will rest easier knowing it is once again safe in the vaults.$B$BI'm sorry to hear about Xylem, though I'm happy he survived the ordeal. He may be eccentric, but his heart is in the right place. $B$BWe can use more allies like him in the wars to come.

english.title: In Safer Hands
english.objectives: Bring the Focusing Iris to Archmage Kalec in Dalaran.
english.description:
There is still the matter of the Focusing Iris. Please return it to  your Kirin Tor friends, with my apologies.

As for myself, I think I'm done chasing artifacts for a while. One possession by immortal shadowy evil is enough for me, thank you.
english.completion: At last, the Focusing Iris is returned! I will rest easier knowing it is once again safe in the vaults.$B$BI'm sorry to hear about Xylem, though I'm happy he survived the ordeal. He may be eccentric, but his heart is in the right place. $B$BWe can use more allies like him in the wars to come.

text.title: 谍报先锋
text.objectives: 跟克拉苏斯平台的奥鲁丹·白云谈一谈，然后飞往破碎海滩。
text.description: 有了火药，我们也该进行下一步计划了。到破碎海滩来见我们吧。$b$b你可以从克拉苏斯平台直接飞到我们的下一个目标地点。我们到那儿见，$ct。
text.completion: Good, you're here. Let's get to work.

english.title: A Bit of Espionage
english.objectives: Speak to Aludane Whitecloud in Krasus' Landing for a flight to Broken Shore.
english.description: With the gunpowder in tow, it's time to move on to our next plan. Meet us on the Broken Shore. $b$bYou can get a flight directly to our next location from Krasus' Landing. We will meet you there, $ct.
english.completion: Отлично. Ты здесь. Теперь можно приниматься за дело.

text.title: 坚守阵地
text.objectives: 消除燃烧军团对雷霆图腾的威胁。
text.description:
虽然我们已经预料到燃烧军团的强势，但我们对他们营地的攻击还是严重激怒了他们，情况远超我的预期。我们的军队正在向雷霆图腾周围的地面和空中集结，想要重新站稳脚跟。

请你尽力削减他们的军力。一旦我们成功守住了雷霆图腾，就会开展计划，发出最后一击。
text.completion: We must remember our allies who have fallen on this day and in their honor, continue our fight.$B$BThe time is upon us, $n. Our riders are ready. Let us show the Burning Legion the true strength of Highmountain.

english.title: Holding Our Ground
english.objectives: Repel the Legion threat from Thunder Totem.
english.description:
Though we anticipated a strong Legion presence, our attacks on their camps have angered their forces even further than anticipated. Our forces rally on both land and in the skies above Thunder Totem in an attempt to regain our footing.

Do what you can to reduce their forces. Once we've secured Thunder Totem we'll begin our plan for a final attack.
english.completion: Мы должны почтить павших в этот день и ради их памяти продолжить битву.$B$BВремя пришло, $n. Наши наездники готовы. Покажем Пылающему Легиону истинную мощь Крутогорья!

text.title: 崛起
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个恶魔，然后登上斜坡顶部。
text.description: 我们到了，$ct。这座岛上有个洞窟，里面全是极其强大的恶魔和他们的首领。如果我们的计划成功，这些恶魔就会如特塞斯所说的那样，被“炸成碎片”。$b$b现在没时间详细解释整个计划了，但是苔丝答应与你同行。首先，你必须登上这面斜坡的顶部。别忘了顺路杀几个恶魔。
text.completion: Easy as pie, Shadowblade. Now is when the plan kicks into action!

english.title: Rise Up
english.objectives: Kill $1oa demons, then reach the top of the ramp.
english.description: Here we are, $ct. On this island is a cavern full of exceptionally powerful demons and their leaders. If our plan succeeds, these demons will be... "blown to smithereens", as Tethys so nicely put it.$b$bThere's no time to explain the plan in full right now, but Tess has agreed to walk you through it. First you must get up to the top of this ramp. Slaughter a few on your way.
english.completion: Easy as pie, Shadowblade. Now is when the plan kicks into action!

text.title: 邪能原料
text.objectives: 获取5瓶液态邪焰，3瓶魔血和3把恶魔尘。
text.description:
我们的斥候在邪能要塞里发现了一个蔑魔营地。我们需要尽可能多的邪能毒药样本，这样才能调配出解药，治好我们中毒的武僧。

凡是看着稍微有点用的东西，你都弄份样本过来吧！
text.progress: Did you find any samples we can use?
text.completion: Let's hope that's enough to brew a cure for our dying monks!

english.title: Fel Ingredients
english.objectives: Acquire 5 Vials of Liquid Felflame, 3 Flasks of Fel Blood, and 3 pinches of Demonic Ash.
english.description:
Our scouts have located a Felskorn encampment within the Garrison of the Fel. We will need as many samples of fel poison as we can find if we are to concoct a cure for our stricken monks.

Take samples of anything that looks remotely useful!
english.progress: Did you find any samples we can use?
english.completion: Let's hope it's enough to make medicine for the dying!

text.title: 腐蚀者之村
text.objectives: 消灭邪能图腾的邪能图腾灌魔者。
text.description:
邪能图腾还在制造这些图腾，以便进一步“实验”。我们还是用传统方法来解决这些灌魔者吧。

他们的死可以纠正许多错误，并且为我们了解他们的终极目标提供线索。
text.progress: These Feltotem need to be dealt with.
text.completion: Tugar... I thought he was dead. He was a nasty Bloodtotem even before the Legion arrived.$B$BWe have to get to him.

english.title: Village of the Corruptors
english.objectives: Kill Feltotem Infusers in Feltotem.
english.description:
The Feltotem continue to create these totems for further "experiments". Let us deal with these infusers in the traditional manner.

Their deaths will right a great wrong and provide clues as to their ultimate goal.
english.progress: Нужно покончить с этими негодяями.
english.completion: Тугар... Я думал, он мертв. Еще до прибытия Легиона он доставлял нам немало хлопот.$b$bЕго нужно найти.

text.title: 崛起
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个恶魔，然后登上斜坡顶部。
text.description: 我们到了，$ct。这座岛上有个洞窟，里面全是极其强大的恶魔和他们的首领。如果我们的计划成功，这些恶魔就会如特塞斯所说的那样，被“炸成碎片”。$b$b现在没时间详细解释整个计划了，但是莉莉安答应与你同行。首先，你必须登上这面斜坡的顶部。别忘了顺路杀几个恶魔。
text.completion: Ah, my blade sings. Time to put this plan into action, Shadowblade.

english.title: Rise Up
english.objectives: Kill $1oa demons, then reach the top of the ramp.
english.description: Here we are, $ct. On this island is a cavern full of exceptionally powerful demons and their leaders. If our plan succeeds, these demons will be... "blown to smithereens", as Tethys so nicely put it.$b$bThere's no time to explain the plan in full right now, but Lilian has agreed to walk you through it. First you must get up to the top of this ramp. Slaughter a few on your way.
english.completion: Мой клинок уже поет победную песнь. Настало время реализовать наш план, |3-6($ct).

text.title: 护盾强化
text.objectives: 在悲泣平台对被击败的邪脉成员使用夜之子灵魂石。
text.description:
再强化一下夜之子灵魂石的护盾也不会有什么损失。为此，我们就得给它灌注能量。

莱娜向我保证，邪能精华完全能满足我们的需求。没错——这个办法很倒胃口。但是，正如辛多雷所说的那样，非常时期需要非常手段。

总之，简单地说就是：我们急需魔法能量，而我们的敌人拥有富余的魔法能量。

去吧，做你该做的事。
text.completion: Good. The Soulstone's shields should be sufficiently strengthened now.

english.title: Shield Amplification
english.objectives: Use the Nightborne Soulstone on defeated Felborne within the Weeping Terrace.
english.description:
It will not hurt to reinforce the Nightborne Soulstone's shield just a bit more, and to do that we must infuse it with energy. 

Ryanna has assured me that fel essence will work beautifully for our needs. Yes - this method IS rather distasteful. However as the sin'dorei well know, desperate times call for desperate measures.

It is as simple as this: we have an urgent need for magical energy, and our enemies possess it in abundance. 

Do what must be done.
english.completion: Хорошо. Теперь щит камня души должен быть достаточно прочным.

text.title: 邪能图腾的威胁
text.objectives: 找到并解决图加·鲜血图腾。
text.description: 要是我知道图加还活着，而且还是这一切的幕后黑手，那我早就警告你了！他的报复心很强，很容易被燃烧军团拉拢。$b$b如果他的邪能实验真的成功了，那我们必须马上阻止他。他正在上面嘲笑我们呢。我们走！
text.completion: That was powerful fel magic. If it is true, if he is raising an army of such beasts... Thunder Totem is in peril!

english.title: The Feltotem Menace
english.objectives: Find and deal with Tugar Bloodtotem.
english.description: If I had known Tugar was alive and behind this I would've alerted you sooner! He is a hateful creature, and an easy recruit to the Legion's cause.$b$bIf he is truly successful with his fel experiments we need to stop him now. He is taunting us from up there. Let's go!
english.completion: Это очень могущественная магия Скверны. Если это правда... если он собирает целую армию этих созданий... Громовому Тотему грозит ужасная опасность!

text.title: 莱莫扎夫人
text.objectives: 消灭莱莫扎夫人。
text.description:
我们的盟友报告说，一伙极其强大的邪脉叛逃者占据了悲泣平台。

他们的首领莱莫扎夫人，以及她的追随者都是古代夜之子魔法的专家。他们几乎能抵挡一切攻击。

但是，我们作为法师，应该可以用法术吸取击败他们。去让他们看看提瑞斯秘法会的力量吧！
text.completion: The Felborne will respect the Tirisgarde now, do you not agree?

english.title: Lady Remor'za
english.objectives: Kill Lady Remor'za.
english.description:
Our allies reported a coven of extremely powerful Felborne abjurers occupying the Weeping Terrace. 

Their leader, Lady Remor'za, and her followers are specialists in ancient nightborne magic and can become nearly invincible to attacks. 

However, as mages, we should be able to defeat them using Spellsteal. Let us show them the power of the Tirisgarde!
english.completion: Теперь присягнувшие Скверне дважды подумают, прежде чем связаться со Стражами Тирисфаля!

text.title: 谁找到就归谁
text.objectives: 在守护者圣殿里打扫出$oa堆奥法之尘。
text.description: 看看这个地方，真是乱糟糟的！到处都是一堆堆的奥法之尘！$b$b<阿卡扎曼扎拉克咧嘴笑着。>$b$b这些可怜的傻瓜都不知道这玩意有多么值钱！$b$b跟你说啊，如果你帮我召唤一些扫把来收集这种粉状黄金，我就把赚来的钱分你一份，咱们二八开，我八你二。
text.completion: Now that's what I'm talking about! You know what they say - where there's mages, there's dust!

english.title: Finders Keepers
english.objectives: Sweep up $oa piles of Arcane Dust in the Hall of the Guardian.
english.description: Would you look at this place? It's a mess! Everywhere you look there's just pile after pile of arcane dust!$B$B<Akazamzarak smiles broadly.>$B$BThese poor saps don't realize what that stuff's worth!$B$BI tell ya what, if you help me summon up some brooms to collect this powdered gold, I'll split the profits with you 80/20.
english.completion: Now that's what I'm talking about! You know what they say - where there's mages, there's dust!
